// The Game tab's Last.fm row, under the songs' settings: Connect (Last.fm's "allow access" page in a popup, lastfm.ts), then who
// scrobbles and Disconnect; under it one line about .fmbot, the Discord bot that shows Last.fm stats.  Not there when the server
// has no Last.fm (its /lastfm is 404).
import { authLink, keepSession, readSession, type LastfmApi } from './lastfm';
import { LASTFM_RESULT, LASTFM_SESSION, localStore } from './prefs';
import { t } from './i18n';

export const FMBOT = 'https://fm.bot/';
const RESULT_FRESH_MS = 10 * 60_000;

export interface LastfmRowDeps {
  api: Pick<LastfmApi, 'key'>;
  log(line: string): void;
  /** the page's short message */
  say(msg: string): void;
}

export class LastfmRow {
  readonly el = Object.assign(document.createElement('div'), { className: 'set lastfm', hidden: true });
  private key: string | null | undefined;      // undefined: not asked yet (or the server did not answer)
  private state: { text: () => string; cls: 'ok' | 'bad' } | null = null;

  constructor(private deps: LastfmRowDeps) {
    this.el.dataset.key = 'lastfm';
    // the popup's page (lastfm-callback.ts) keeps the session and its result: this page hears of it here
    window.addEventListener('storage', e => { if (e.key === LASTFM_RESULT) this.result(); else if (e.key?.startsWith(LASTFM_SESSION)) this.render(); });
    void this.askKey();
  }

  private async askKey() {
    try { this.key = await this.deps.api.key(); } catch (e) { this.deps.log(`[lastfm] the server did not say: ${e}`); }
    this.render();
  }

  /** what the popup did: connected, or why not */
  private result() {
    const r = localStore.getJSON(LASTFM_RESULT) as { result?: string; at?: number } | null;
    if (r !== null) localStore.remove(LASTFM_RESULT);
    if (!r || !r.at || Date.now() - r.at > RESULT_FRESH_MS) return;
    this.deps.log(`[lastfm] connect: ${r.result}`);
    const s = readSession();
    if (r.result === 'ok' && s) { this.state = null; this.deps.say(t('Last.fm connected: scrobbling as {name}.', { name: s.name })); }
    else this.state = { text: () => t('Last.fm didn\'t connect. Try again.'), cls: 'bad' };
    this.render();
  }

  /** the session key stopped working (lastfm.ts Scrobbler) */
  dropped() {
    keepSession(null);
    this.state = { text: () => t('Disconnected: the access was taken back on Last.fm.'), cls: 'bad' };
    this.render();
  }

  private connect() {
    if (!this.key) { void this.askKey(); this.deps.say(t('Last.fm can\'t be reached now. Try again in a moment.')); return; }
    this.state = null;
    const url = authLink(this.key);
    const w = window.open(url, 'lastfm', 'popup,width=480,height=720');
    if (!w) this.deps.say(t('Allow pop-ups for this site, then try again.'));
    this.render();
  }

  private disconnect() {
    keepSession(null);
    this.state = null;
    this.deps.log('[lastfm] disconnected');
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const r = this.el, s = readSession();
    r.hidden = this.key === null && !s;          // (a server without Last.fm; a session kept from before still shows, to disconnect it)
    const label = Object.assign(document.createElement('div'), { className: 'set-label', textContent: 'Last.fm' });
    const help = Object.assign(document.createElement('p'), { className: 'set-help', id: 'set-lastfm-help',
      textContent: t('Scrobbles the songs you hear, EA Trax and your Radio\'s, to your Last.fm profile.') });
    const ctl = Object.assign(document.createElement('div'), { className: 'set-control' });
    const b = Object.assign(document.createElement('button'), { type: 'button', className: 'btn', textContent: s ? t('Disconnect') : t('Connect') });
    b.setAttribute('aria-describedby', 'set-lastfm-help set-lastfm-state');
    b.onclick = () => s ? this.disconnect() : this.connect();
    ctl.append(b);
    const st = Object.assign(document.createElement('p'), { id: 'set-lastfm-state' });
    if (s) { st.className = 'set-state ok'; st.textContent = t('Scrobbling as {name}.', { name: s.name }); }
    else if (this.state) { st.className = `set-state ${this.state.cls}`; st.textContent = this.state.text(); }
    else st.hidden = true;
    // .fmbot: one line, a link of its own
    const bot = Object.assign(document.createElement('a'), { className: 'fmbot', href: FMBOT, target: '_blank', rel: 'noopener' });
    const name = Object.assign(document.createElement('span'), { className: 'fmbot-mark', role: 'img' });
    name.setAttribute('aria-label', '.fmbot');
    const what = Object.assign(document.createElement('span'), { className: 'fmbot-what', textContent: t('Your Last.fm stats in Discord') });
    const go = Object.assign(document.createElement('span'), { className: 'fmbot-go', textContent: t('Add') });
    bot.append(name, what, go);
    r.replaceChildren(label, help, ctl, st, bot);
  }
}

{"id": "AT001761", "source": "archive:A028!/nfsu2-web-public/web/src/app/lastfm.ts", "originalBytes": 9496, "originalSha256": "a4a0513c4a3917f6a5950feede3ce9503b8a1c658acb5cc95824e791c8182226", "originalEncoding": "utf-8", "utf8RangeStart": 0, "utf8RangeEnd": 9496, "utf8TotalBytes": 9496}

// Last.fm: the songs a player hears in the game, EA Trax's and the Radio's, scrobbled to their Last.fm profile.  The server signs
// and forwards the calls (server-rs src/app/lastfm.rs: the API account's secret lives there); the page keeps the session key, on
// this device only.  Connecting: Last.fm's "allow access" page in a popup, which comes back to /lastfm.html (lastfm-callback.ts)
// with a token; that page trades it for the session key and closes.
//
// What counts as heard is the runtime's (radio_proto.h song_*): the time a song was mixed and not paused, and whether it played to
// its end.  Last.fm's rules: a track longer than 30 s is scrobbled once it has been heard half its length or 4 minutes.  An EA Trax
// song's length is not known: it is scrobbled after 4 minutes, or at its end after 30 s.  "Now playing" goes once a song is heard.
import { LASTFM_QUEUE, LASTFM_SESSION, localStore } from './prefs';
import type { Lines, RadioLink, Song } from './radio-link';

export interface Session { name: string; sk: string }
interface Scrobble { artist: string; track: string; album?: string; duration?: number; timestamp: number }
/** the Radio's track served last (radio.ts lastTrack) */
export interface FolderTrack { tags: Promise<Lines>; plaque: Promise<Lines>; seconds: number }

export const AUTH_PAGE = 'https://www.last.fm/api/auth/';
const MIN_S = 30, ENOUGH_S = 240, QUEUE_MAX = 50, RETRY_MS = 120_000;

export function readSession(): Session | null {
  const s = localStore.getJSON(LASTFM_SESSION) as Session | null;
  return s && typeof s.name === 'string' && typeof s.sk === 'string' && s.sk ? s : null;
}
export const keepSession = (s: Session | null) => { if (s === null) localStore.remove(LASTFM_SESSION); else localStore.setJSON(LASTFM_SESSION, s); };

/** /lastfm on this server: its API key (null: the server has no Last.fm), and the calls it signs */
export class LastfmApi {
  async key(): Promise<string | null> {
    const r = await fetch('/lastfm', { cache: 'no-store' });
    if (r.status === 404) return null;
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${r.status}`);
    const j = await r.json() as { key?: unknown };
    return typeof j.key === 'string' && j.key ? j.key : null;
  }
  /** the server's answer: status and body ({error} when refused); throws when it could not be asked */
  async call(body: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<{ status: number; json: Record<string, unknown> }> {
    const r = await fetch('/lastfm', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body) });
    let json: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    try { json = await r.json() as Record<string, unknown>; } catch { /* not JSON: the status says it */ }
    return { status: r.status, json };
  }
}

/** Last.fm's "allow access" page, which sends the player back to /lastfm.html with a token */
export const authLink = (key: string, origin = location.origin) => `${AUTH_PAGE}?api_key=${encodeURIComponent(key)}&cb=${encodeURIComponent(`${origin}/lastfm.html`)}`;

/** a title without its artist in front ("Artist - Title"), as the game's plaque shows it (radio-tags.ts plaqueTags) */
const ownTitle = (t: Lines) => t.artist && t.title.toLowerCase().startsWith(`${t.artist} - `.toLowerCase()) ? t.title.slice(t.artist.length + 3) : t.title;

interface Current {
  seq: number; kind: Song['kind']; lines: Lines | null; duration?: number;
  start: number;                         // unix seconds when it began (now less the time heard at first sight)
  ms: number; ended: boolean; told: boolean; done: boolean;
}

export interface ScrobblerDeps {
  api: Pick<LastfmApi, 'call'>;
  /** the Radio's track served last, null without the Radio */
  folder(): FolderTrack | null;
  /** the session key stopped working (the player took the access back on Last.fm): forgotten here */
  dropped(): void;
  log(line: string): void;
  now?(): number;
}

/** Follows the song playing (tick, about once a second while a game runs) and tells Last.fm. */
export class Scrobbler {
  private cur: Current | null = null;
  private queue: Scrobble[] = (localStore.getJSON(LASTFM_QUEUE) as Scrobble[] | null)?.filter(s => s && typeof s.artist === 'string') ?? [];
  private retryAt = 0;
  private sending = false;
  constructor(private deps: ScrobblerDeps) {}
  private now() { return this.deps.now?.() ?? Date.now(); }

  /** song: the runtime's (null while it writes it); none: no game, or no session */
  tick(song: Song | null, session: Session | null) {
    if (!session) { this.cur = null; return; }
    if (this.queue.length && this.now() >= this.retryAt) void this.flush(session);
    if (!song) return;
    if (!this.cur || song.seq !== this.cur.seq) this.begin(song);
    const c = this.cur!;
    c.ms = song.ms; c.ended = song.ended;
    if (c.kind === 'none' || !c.lines || !c.lines.artist || !c.lines.title) return;
    if (!c.told && c.ms >= 1000) { c.told = true; void this.send(session, 'playing', this.track(c)); }
    const enough = Math.min(ENOUGH_S, c.duration ? c.duration / 2 : ENOUGH_S) * 1000;
    if (!c.done && (c.duration ?? MIN_S + 1) > MIN_S && (c.ms >= enough || (c.ended && c.ms >= MIN_S * 1000))) {
      c.done = true;
      void this.send(session, 'scrobble', { ...this.track(c), timestamp: c.start });
    }
  }

  /** a new song: its lines (the Radio's track: its own tags in place of the plaque's ASCII, when it is the one the game shows) */
  private begin(song: Song) {
    const c: Current = { seq: song.seq, kind: song.kind, lines: song.kind === 'game' ? song.lines : null, start: Math.round((this.now() - song.ms) / 1000),
      ms: song.ms, ended: song.ended, told: false, done: false };
    this.cur = c;
    const t = song.kind === 'folder' ? this.deps.folder() : null;
    if (!t) { if (song.kind === 'folder') c.lines = song.lines; return; }
    void Promise.all([t.plaque, t.tags]).then(([plaque, tags]) => {
      const same = plaque.artist === song.lines.artist && plaque.title === song.lines.title;
      // (a track without an artist shows "Unknown artist" on the plaque: nothing to scrobble)
      c.lines = same ? { artist: tags.artist.trim(), title: ownTitle(tags).trim(), album: tags.album.trim() } : song.lines;
      if (same) c.duration = Math.round(t.seconds);
    }, () => { c.lines = song.lines; });
  }

  private track(c: Current): Omit<Scrobble, 'timestamp'> {
    const l = c.lines!;
    return { artist: l.artist, track: l.title, ...(l.album ? { album: l.album } : {}), ...(c.duration ? { duration: c.duration } : {}) };
  }

  /** a call, and what came of it: 'later' when Last.fm could not be asked or asks to wait */
  private async post(session: Session, op: 'playing' | 'scrobble', s: Omit<Scrobble, 'timestamp'> & { timestamp?: number }): Promise<'ok' | 'later' | 'refused'> {
    let r: { status: number; json: Record<string, unknown> } | null = null;
    try { r = await this.deps.api.call({ op, sk: session.sk, ...s }); } catch (e) { this.deps.log(`[lastfm] ${op} not sent: ${e}`); }
    const error = r ? String(r.json.error ?? '') : 'down';
    if (r?.status === 200) {
      this.deps.log(`[lastfm] ${op === 'playing' ? 'now playing' : r.json.ignored ? 'scrobble ignored by Last.fm' : 'scrobbled'}`);
      return 'ok';
    }
    if (error === 'session') { this.deps.log('[lastfm] the session key no longer works: disconnected'); this.cur = null; this.deps.dropped(); return 'refused'; }
    this.deps.log(`[lastfm] ${op} refused: ${error || r?.status}`);
    return error === 'down' || error === 'rate' ? 'later' : 'refused';
  }

  /** a scrobble that cannot go now is kept (on this device) and sent later; a sent one sends the kept ones */
  private async send(session: Session, op: 'playing' | 'scrobble', s: Omit<Scrobble, 'timestamp'> & { timestamp?: number }) {
    const got = await this.post(session, op, s);
    if (op !== 'scrobble') return;
    if (got === 'later' && s.timestamp) {
      this.queue = [...this.queue, s as Scrobble].slice(-QUEUE_MAX);
      this.retryAt = this.now() + RETRY_MS;
      localStore.setJSON(LASTFM_QUEUE, this.queue);
      this.deps.log(`[lastfm] ${this.queue.length} scrobbles kept for later`);
    } else if (got === 'ok' && this.queue.length) void this.flush(session);
  }

  /** the scrobbles kept, oldest first, until one cannot go yet */
  private async flush(session: Session) {
    if (this.sending) return;
    this.sending = true;
    this.retryAt = this.now() + RETRY_MS;
    try {
      while (this.queue.length) {
        const s = this.queue[0];
        if (s.timestamp > this.now() / 1000 - 14 * 86_400 + 60 && await this.post(session, 'scrobble', s) === 'later') break;   // (Last.fm takes two weeks)
        this.queue = this.queue.filter(q => q !== s);
        if (this.queue.length) localStore.setJSON(LASTFM_QUEUE, this.queue); else localStore.remove(LASTFM_QUEUE);
      }
    } finally { this.sending = false; }
  }
}

/** Runs the scrobbler while a game runs (port: its radio's words), about once a second; the runtime keeps the song's words up only
 *  while a session is there. */
export function scrobbleWhilePlaying(port: () => RadioLink | null, s: Scrobbler, session: () => Session | null): () => void {
  let link: RadioLink | null = null;
  const timer = setInterval(() => {
    const l = port(), have = session();
    if (l !== link) { link = l; s.tick(null, null); }
    l?.listen(!!have);
    s.tick(l && have ? l.song() : null, l ? have : null);
  }, 1000);
  return () => clearInterval(timer);
}

// The log of a game the page did not get to end.  Safari stops a page whose memory it needs (an iPhone's, mostly while
// the game plays or soon after it went to the background) without any event, and the log (logs.ts) goes with it, just
// when a player would send it.  So while a game runs the page keeps a short copy (LogRing.snapshot) in localStorage:
// every 10 s when the log grew, at once when the page is hidden or shown, and with the game's end.  The next page finds
// a game that never got to its end and offers that copy with Download log (shell.ts).  Each copy also notes what the
// game held then (its textures, friends' cars): Safari gives the page no memory figure, and the renderer's line comes
// only once a minute.  The copy is kept as it would leave the browser (privacy.ts scrub): no names, no addresses.
import type { LogRing } from './logs';
import { LAST_GAME, localStore } from './prefs';

export interface LastGame {
  v: 1;
  /** when the game started (ms since the epoch) and the module's revision */
  started: number; rev: string;
  /** when the copy was last written, and whether the page was hidden then (in the background, on a phone) */
  saved: number; hidden: boolean;
  /** how it ended: the exit code and why ('exit', a stop's code, 'page closed'); null: it did not get to an end */
  ended: { code: number; why: string } | null;
  log: string;
  /** the log went through privacy.ts scrub (copies of pages before it did not) */
  scrubbed?: boolean;
  /** what the game held at that copy, "textures 412 MB (380 unpacked from DXT), 19 friends' cars, ..." ('': nothing known) */
  held?: string;
}

const EVERY_MS = 10_000;
/** the copy's size: localStorage holds a few MB for the whole page */
const BUDGET = 160 << 10;

export class LastGameKeeper {
  private rec: LastGame | null = null;
  private timer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | undefined;
  private written = -1;
  private failed = false;
  private slow = false;
  private held: () => string = () => '';
  /** scrub: the log as it may leave the browser (privacy.ts) */
  constructor(private save: string, private log: LogRing, private note: (s: string) => void, private scrub?: (text: string) => string) {}

  /** a game started: a copy now, then every EVERY_MS while the log grows; held: what the game holds now, for each copy */
  start(rev: string, held?: () => string) {
    this.rec = { v: 1, started: Date.now(), rev, saved: 0, hidden: document.hidden, ended: null, log: '' };
    this.held = held ?? (() => '');
    this.write();
    clearInterval(this.timer);
    this.timer = setInterval(() => { if (this.log.added !== this.written) this.write(); }, EVERY_MS);
  }
  /** the page was hidden or shown: a phone may stop a hidden page at any moment */
  hidden(h: boolean) {
    if (!this.rec || this.rec.ended) return;
    this.rec.hidden = h;
    this.write();
  }
  /** the game ended (why: 'exit', a stop's code) or the page is going away with the game running ('page closed') */
  end(code: number, why: string) {
    if (!this.rec || this.rec.ended) return;
    clearInterval(this.timer); this.timer = undefined;
    this.rec.ended = { code, why };
    this.write();
  }

  private write() {
    const r = this.rec!, t0 = performance.now();
    r.saved = Date.now(); this.written = this.log.added;
    r.log = this.log.snapshot(BUDGET);
    if (this.scrub) { r.log = this.scrub(r.log); r.scrubbed = true; }
    // the copy at the end may come after the renderer went: the last figures seen then
    try { r.held = this.held() || r.held || ''; } catch { /* the last ones */ }
    localStore.setJSON(LAST_GAME + this.save, r, e => {
      // storage off or full: the log stays in memory as before
      if (!this.failed) { this.failed = true; this.note(`[app] the log's copy for a stopped page could not be kept: ${e}`); }
    });
    // it runs on the page's thread, as the picture does: a slow one is a still picture (once a page)
    const ms = performance.now() - t0;
    if (ms > 50 && !this.slow) { this.slow = true; this.note(`[app] the log's copy for a stopped page took ${ms.toFixed(0)} ms`); }
  }
}

/** The last game of this save folder, when it did not end as the game ends (a normal close or a Stop on a page that went
 *  on): stopped with the page, or stopped for a reason (GPU-LOST, a crash) by a page that has been reloaded since. */
export function lastGameToOffer(save: string): LastGame | null {
  const r = localStore.getJSON(LAST_GAME + save) as LastGame | null;
  if (!r || r.v !== 1 || typeof r.log !== 'string' || !r.log) return null;
  if (r.ended && r.ended.why === 'exit' && (r.ended.code === 0 || r.ended.code === -1)) return null;
  return r;
}

/** how it ended, for the start page: the browser stopped the page ('stopped'), the player reloaded or closed it
 *  ('left'), or the game stopped for a reason and the page was reloaded since ('error') */
export function lastGameEnd(r: LastGame): 'stopped' | 'left' | 'error' {
  return !r.ended ? 'stopped' : r.ended.why === 'page closed' ? 'left' : 'error';
}

/** what became of it, for the log: one line */
export function lastGameLine(r: LastGame): string {
  const at = (ms: number) => new Date(ms).toTimeString().slice(0, 8);
  const mins = ((r.saved - r.started) / 60000).toFixed(1);
  const what = !r.ended
    ? `ended without the page closing it, ${r.hidden ? 'the page hidden (in the background)' : 'the page on screen'} at its last copy: the browser stopped the page (an iPhone mostly for memory), or the browser or device restarted`
    : r.ended.why === 'page closed' ? `was running when the page was closed or reloaded`
      : `stopped (${r.ended.why}, code ${r.ended.code}), and the page was reloaded since`;
  const held = typeof r.held === 'string' && r.held ? `; at that copy it held ${r.held}` : '';
  return `[app] the last game (game ${r.rev}, started ${at(r.started)}, last copy ${at(r.saved)}, ${mins} min in) ${what}${held}; its log is at the start of this file`;
}

// Loads the game module from the local server: /game.json (what was built)
// and /game.wasm, compiled while it streams in.  The progress comes from a
// clone of the response, so the original response still goes to
// compileStreaming and Chrome can reuse its compiled-code cache for it.
// The server sends the module brotli-compressed, at an address that names its
// content (/game.wasm?v=<hash>, the hash from /game.json, which no cache
// keeps): the browser and Cloudflare keep it for good, a reload reads it from
// Chrome's HTTP cache without asking, and a new build is a new address.

export interface GameInfo { pages: number; maxPages: number; guestEnd: number; rev: string; size: number; opt: string; module?: string }
export interface Loaded {
  module: WebAssembly.Module; info: GameInfo;
  ms: number;              // fetch + compile, wall time
  transferred: number;     // bytes over the network (0 = from the HTTP cache), -1 unknown
}

/** /game.json and the module it names (a server without module: /game.wasm, revalidated) */
async function fetchModule(signal?: AbortSignal) {
  for (let tries = 1; ; tries++) {
    const ir = await fetch('/game.json', { cache: 'no-store', signal });
    if (!ir.ok) throw new Error(`/game.json: HTTP ${ir.status} (build the game module on the Mac: web/build.sh)`);
    const info = await ir.json() as GameInfo;
    const url = new URL(info.module ? `/game.wasm?v=${encodeURIComponent(info.module)}` : '/game.wasm', location.href).href;
    const r = await fetch(url, { cache: info.module ? 'default' : 'no-cache', signal });
    // 409: a new build arrived between the two answers: its /game.json
    if (r.status === 409 && tries < 3) { await r.body?.cancel(); continue; }
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`/game.wasm: HTTP ${r.status}`);
    return { info, url, r };
  }
}

export async function loadGame(onProgress: (got: number, total: number) => void, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<Loaded> {
  const t0 = performance.now();
  const { info, url, r } = await fetchModule(signal);
  const total = info.size || +(r.headers.get('content-length') ?? 0);
  const counting = (async () => {
    const rd = r.clone().body!.getReader();
    let got = 0;
    for (;;) {
      const { done, value } = await rd.read();
      if (done) break;
      got += value.length;
      onProgress(got, total);
    }
  })();
  const [module] = await Promise.all([WebAssembly.compileStreaming(r), counting]);
  const ms = performance.now() - t0;
  const pe = performance.getEntriesByName(url).pop() as PerformanceResourceTiming | undefined;
  return { module, info, ms, transferred: pe ? pe.transferSize : -1 };
}

/** The revision the server has now, or null (no answer within ms).  The query keeps the request past offline
 *  mode (sw.ts keeps bare paths only), so asking never makes its copy of /game.json one its module is not. */
export async function serverRev(ms: number): Promise<string | null> {
  try {
    const r = await fetch('/game.json?latest', { cache: 'no-store', signal: AbortSignal.timeout(ms) });
    return r.ok ? ((await r.json()) as GameInfo).rev || null : null;
  } catch { return null; }
}

    [/^Multiplayer race: (\d+)(st|nd|rd|th) place\. (.+) won it: it counts in your career too$/,

/** the speedometer under the players (the fastest other car against ours with the engines evened out, vs: runtime
 *  roam_game.c js_players): its needle straight up for a car as fast as ours, at its ends for 1.6 times ours or more
 *  and as much less, in the red past 1.25 times (rated about 2.5 times ours: a stock car against a maxed one) */
const SVGNS = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
function speedometer(vs: number): SVGSVGElement {
  const svg = document.createElementNS(SVGNS, 'svg'), cx = 12, cy = 12, r = 10;
  svg.setAttribute('viewBox', '0 0 24 14'); svg.setAttribute('class', 'lobby-gauge'); svg.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
  const pt = (k: number, rr: number) => {
    const a = (90 - Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, Math.log(k) / Math.log(1.6))) * 80) * Math.PI / 180;
    return `${(cx + rr * Math.cos(a)).toFixed(2)} ${(cy - rr * Math.sin(a)).toFixed(2)}`;
  };
  const path = (d: string, cls: string) => { const e = document.createElementNS(SVGNS, 'path'); e.setAttribute('d', d); e.setAttribute('class', cls); svg.append(e); };
  path(`M${pt(1 / 1.6, r)} A${r} ${r} 0 0 1 ${pt(1.25, r)}`, 'track');
  path(`M${pt(1.25, r)} A${r} ${r} 0 0 1 ${pt(1.6, r)}`, 'red');
  path(`M${cx} ${cy} L${pt(vs, r - 2)}`, 'needle');
  return svg;
}

/** quick chat: a phrase stays beside its player's name this long (ms) */
const SAID_MS = 6000;



/** the card's keys: the player's for each (sitekeys.ts), and the status bit that says the game has one of its controls
 *  on it (then the key is the game's: gamekeys.ts) */
const KEYS: Record<'next' | 'fresh' | 'priv' | 'invite', { id: OurId; bit: number }> = {
  next: { id: 'lobby', bit: KEY_LOBBY }, fresh: { id: 'lobbyNew', bit: KEY_LOBBY_NEW }, priv: { id: 'lobbyPrivate', bit: KEY_LOBBY_PRIVATE },
  invite: { id: 'lobbyInvite', bit: KEY_LOBBY_INVITE },
};

export class LobbyPanel {
  private last = '';
  /** the state shown now */
  private st: LobbyState = {};
  constructor(private panel: HTMLElement, private cover: HTMLElement, private log?: (s: string) => void, private deps?: LobbyDeps) {
    // (caught before the game's input, and only while the card offers it: E, V and Z are the game's for nothing in its
    // driving map, but a player may put one of its controls on them)
    window.addEventListener('keydown', e => this.key(e), { capture: true });
    // (a controller that starts or stops driving: the keys' caps change, lobby.ts cap)
    window.addEventListener(PAD_DRIVER_EVENT, () => { if (!this.panel.hidden) this.redraw(); });
  }

  /** the lobby the player hosts now with room in it (null: none) */
  hosted(): Hosted | null {
    const s = this.st;
    if (s.v !== 'lobby' || s.st !== 'host' || (s.names?.length ?? 0) >= (s.max ?? 6)) return null;
    return { kind: s.kind ?? 'race', stage: s.stage ?? 0, n: s.names?.length ?? 1, max: s.max ?? 6 };
  }

  /** what the card offers now, by its keys: at a start the next lobby (two or more) and a new one beside them (where
   *  the start takes one: the game's pages, pgs, are its lobbies, nl, and a new one's), who can join and invite
   *  (hosting), leave (from afar) */
  private offers(s: LobbyState): { next?: () => void; fresh?: () => void; priv?: () => void; invite?: () => void } {
    const d = this.deps, o: { next?: () => void; fresh?: () => void; priv?: () => void; invite?: () => void } = {};
    if (!d) return o;
    if (s.v === 'join' && (s.nl ?? 0) > 1) o.next = () => d.act(LB_NEXT);
    if (s.v === 'join' && (s.pgs ?? 0) > (s.nl ?? 0)) o.fresh = () => d.act(LB_NEW);
    if (s.v === 'lobby' && s.st === 'host') {
      o.priv = () => d.act(LB_PRIVATE);
      if ((s.names?.length ?? 0) < (s.max ?? 6)) o.invite = () => d.invite();
    }
    if (s.v === 'lobby' && (s.st === 'in' || s.st === 'asked') && s.far) o.invite = () => d.act(LB_LEAVE);
    return o;
  }

  /** a card key's key now (null: none, off, or the game's) */
  private keyOf(which: keyof typeof KEYS): string | null {
    const k = siteKey(KEYS[which].id);
    return k && !gameHas(this.deps?.session(), KEYS[which].bit) ? k : null;
  }

  private key(e: KeyboardEvent) {
    if (this.panel.hidden || e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.altKey || !this.deps) return;
    const el = e.target as HTMLElement | null;
    if (el?.closest?.('input, textarea, select') || pageDialog() || this.panel.closest('.photo')) return;
    const o = this.offers(this.st);
    const f = (Object.keys(KEYS) as (keyof typeof KEYS)[]).find(w => o[w] && this.keyOf(w) === e.code);
    if (!f) return;
    e.preventDefault(); e.stopImmediatePropagation();
    if (!e.repeat) o[f]!();
  }

  /** the game's state (JSON); a bad one shows nothing */
  show(json: string) {
    if (json === this.last) return;
    this.last = json;
    let s: LobbyState = {};
    try { s = JSON.parse(json) as LobbyState; } catch { this.log?.(`[lobby] not JSON: ${json.slice(0, 80)}`); }
    this.st = s;
    const was = !this.cover.hidden;
    this.cover.hidden = s.v !== 'trip';
    if (s.v === 'trip') this.drawCover(s);
    else if (was) this.cover.replaceChildren();
    this.panel.hidden = !s.v || s.v === 'trip';
    if (!this.panel.hidden) this.drawPanel(s);
    if (was !== !this.cover.hidden) this.log?.(`[lobby] cover ${this.cover.hidden ? 'off' : 'on'}`);
  }

  /** gone with the game */
  clear() { this.show('{}'); }

  /** the same state again, in the page's language */
  redraw() { const j = this.last; this.last = ''; this.show(j || '{}'); }

  /** quick chat (quickchat.ts): what a player said, beside their name for SAID_MS (by name, as the lobby has them) */
  private said = new Map<string, { text: string; until: number }>();
  say(name: string, text: string) {
    this.said.set(name, { text, until: performance.now() + SAID_MS });
    if (this.last.includes('"names"')) this.redraw();
    setTimeout(() => { if (this.last.includes('"names"')) this.redraw(); }, SAID_MS + 50);
  }

  /** the panel's place: under the game's Bank box, its right edge on the box's (x 299, y -198 to -168 in the HUD's
   *  units from the middle of the picture; one unit is u px), out to the edge of a wide HUD with hud = wide, as the
   *  radar's side (shell.ts placeNotices); v: the game's picture on the page */
  place(v: { x: number; y: number; w: number; h: number }, wide: boolean) {
    const u = Math.min(v.w / 640, v.h / 480), e169 = 320 * (16 / 9 * 0.75 - 1);
    const out = wide ? Math.min(Math.max(320 * (v.w / v.h * 0.75 - 1), 0), e169) * 109 / e169 : 0;
    const s = this.panel.style;
    s.left = `${v.x + v.w / 2 + (299 + out) * u}px`;
    s.top = `${v.y + v.h / 2 - 158 * u}px`;
    s.setProperty('--u', `${u}px`);
    this.cover.style.setProperty('--u', `${u}px`);
  }

  /** the race and how full it is; where it is (its stage, track, laps), a win's worth in our career */
  private head(s: LobbyState, trip = false) {
    const top = el('div', 'lobby-top');
    top.append(el('span', 'lobby-race ov-title', game(s.kind ?? 'race')));
    if (s.names?.length && !trip) top.append(el('span', 'lobby-count', t('Lobby {n}/{max}', { n: s.names.length, max: s.max ?? 6 })));
    const where = [s.stage ? t('Stage {n}', { n: s.stage }) : '', this.heats(s), s.track, s.laps ? tn(s.laps, '{n} lap', '{n} laps') : ''].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
    const out = [top];
    if (where) out.push(el('div', 'ov-small', where));
    if (s.counts) {
      // (and a friend's or crew-mate's win, with such players in it: theirs counts for us too)
      const fr = (s.fr ?? []).some(Boolean), cr = (s.cr ?? []).some(Boolean), d = el('div', 'ov-small');
      d.append(el('span', 'lobby-star', '★ '), fr && cr ? t('A win counts in your career, and so does a friend\'s or crew-mate\'s')
        : fr ? t('A win counts in your career, and so does a friend\'s') : cr ? t('A win counts in your career, and so does a crew-mate\'s')
        : t('A win counts in your career'));
      out.push(d);
    }
    return out;
  }

  /** a URL race of heats: how many, or on the trip the heat raced now */
  private heats(s: LobbyState) {
    if (!s.heats || s.heats < 2) return '';
    return s.heat ? t('Heat {k} of {n}', { k: s.heat, n: s.heats }) : tn(s.heats, '{n} heat', '{n} heats');
  }

  /** between a URL race's heats: the points so far, the leader first, ours marked */
  private standings(s: LobbyState) {
    const box = el('div', 'lobby-results');
    box.append(el('div', 'lobby-head', t('Standings')));
    const ol = el('ol', 'lobby-places');
    (s.stand ?? []).forEach((r, i) => {
      const li = el('li', r.me ? 'taken mine' : 'taken');
      li.append(el('span', 'lobby-n', String(i + 1)), el('span', 'lobby-name', r.n));
      li.append(el('span', 'lobby-time', tn(r.p, '{n} point', '{n} points')));
      ol.append(li);
    });
    box.append(ol);
    return box;
  }

  /** the lobby's places: its players, the host first and marked, ★ where a win counts in that player's career, our
   *  friends and crew-mates in lime, ours bold (as over the cars in free roam); then the open ones */
  private players(s: LobbyState, open = true) {
    const ul = el('ul', s.st === 'asked' ? 'lobby-players dim' : 'lobby-players'), now = performance.now();
    const names = s.names ?? [], free = open ? Math.max(2, Math.min(6, s.max ?? 6)) - names.length : 0;
    for (const [k, w] of this.said) if (w.until <= now) this.said.delete(k);
    names.forEach((name, i) => {
      const li = el('li', i === s.me ? 'me' : s.fr?.[i] || s.cr?.[i] ? 'mate' : '');
      li.append(el('span', 'lobby-pname', name));
      const w = this.said.get(name);
      if (w) li.append(el('span', 'lobby-said', w.text));
      if (i === 0) li.append(el('span', 'ov-small', t('host')));
      if (s.c?.[i]) li.append(el('span', 'lobby-star', '★'));
      ul.append(li);
    });
    for (let i = 0; i < free; i++) ul.append(el('li', 'open', t('open')));
    return ul;
  }

  /** the fastest other car against ours, under the players */
  private gauge(s: LobbyState) {
    if (!(s.vs! > 0)) return [];
    const d = el('div', 'lobby-speed');
    d.append(speedometer(s.vs!), el('span', '', t('Speed compared to your car')));
    return [d];
  }

  /** a card key's cap now: the keyboard's (none on a touch screen: a tap, or where the game has the key), or with a
   *  controller driving its D-pad direction held (arrow: runtime dinput_pad.c lobby_pad), none where it has none */
  private cap(which: keyof typeof KEYS, arrow?: string): string | null {
    if (touchFirst()) return null;
    if (drivingPad()) return arrow ? t('Hold {arrow}', { arrow }) : null;
    const k = this.keyOf(which);
    return k ? keyName(k) : null;
  }
  /** Enter's cap: the game's Engage, D-pad up on a controller (the game's own layout) */
  private enter() { return drivingPad() && !touchFirst() ? '↑' : 'Enter'; }
  /** one of the card's own actions, with its key (on a touch screen none: a tap) */
  private own(which: keyof typeof KEYS, what: string, f: () => void, arrow?: string) {
    return act(this.cap(which, arrow), what, f);
  }
  /** where E goes at a start of several lobbies (this one pg of nl): the next one by its number */
  private nextPage(s: LobbyState) {
    const nl = s.nl ?? 1;
    return t('Lobby {k} of {n}', { k: (s.pg ?? 1) % nl + 1, n: nl });
  }

  /** The card, in blocks a line apart, a few lines each in one size (the small one only for what qualifies them):
   *  the race; its members (and the speedometer); the host's settings; this lobby or the next: Enter, E, what is going
   *  on and how to leave */
  private drawPanel(s: LobbyState) {
    const p = this.panel, names = s.names ?? [], host = names[0] ?? t('A player'), o = this.offers(s);
    p.dataset.v = s.v ?? '';
    if (s.v === 'note') { p.replaceChildren(block(el('div', '', noteText(s.text ?? '')))); return; }
    const settings: HTMLElement[] = [], go: HTMLElement[] = [];
    const line = (cls: string, text: string) => go.push(el('div', cls, text));
    if (s.v === 'spot') go.push(act(this.enter(), t('Open a lobby')));
    else if (s.v === 'join') go.push(act(this.enter(), t('Join')));
    else if (s.v === 'lobby') {
      const mine = s.me === 0;
      // (every game of the lobby, the host's too, 2 s from the host's Enter: no numbers to count)
      if (s.st === 'count') line('ov-go', t('Starting the race') + '…');
      else if (s.st === 'asked') line('ov-dim', t('Joining {host}\'s {kind}…', { host, kind: game(s.kind ?? 'race') }));
      else {
        if (s.away) line('ov-warn', mine ? t('You seem away: the lobby closes in {n} s unless you press a key', { n: s.away })
          : t('{host} seems away: the lobby closes in {n} s', { host, n: s.away }));
        if (mine && names.length >= 2) go.push(act(this.enter(), t('Start the race')));
        else if (!s.away) line('ov-dim', !mine ? t('Waiting for {host} to start', { host })
          : s.closes !== undefined ? t('Closes in {n} s if nobody joins', { n: s.closes }) : t('Waiting for players'));
      }
      // the host's settings: who can join (V goes round its choices), invite friends; joined from afar: leave
      if (o.priv) {
        const who = s.who ?? (s.priv ? 'friends' : 'all');
        settings.push(this.own('priv', who === 'stage' ? t('Stage {n} and below can join', { n: s.upto ?? 1 })
          : who === 'friends' ? t('Friends & crew can join') : t('Everyone can join'), o.priv, '←'));
      }
      // (no invite on a controller's card: the menu's Friends has it)
      if (o.invite && (!mine || !drivingPad() || touchFirst())) settings.push(this.own('invite', mine ? t('Invite friends') : t('Leave'), o.invite, mine ? undefined : '←'));
    }
    if (o.fresh) go.push(this.own('fresh', t('New lobby'), o.fresh, '←'));
    if (o.next) go.push(this.own('next', this.nextPage(s), o.next, '→'));
    // (how to leave: drive away, but from a lobby joined from afar)
    if (s.v === 'lobby' && s.st !== 'count' && s.st !== 'asked') go.push(el('div', 'ov-small', s.me === 0 ? t('Drive away to call it off')
      : s.far ? t('You joined from afar: the race leaves from where you are') : t('Drive away to leave')));
    const blocks = [block(...this.head(s))];
    if (s.v !== 'spot') blocks.push(block(this.players(s), ...this.gauge(s)));
    if (settings.length) blocks.push(block(...settings));
    if (go.length) blocks.push(block(...go));
    p.replaceChildren(...blocks);
  }

  /** the race's results on the way back: place, name, time (or points), ours marked with its prize */
  private results(s: LobbyState) {
    const box = el('div', 'lobby-results');
    // (a URL race of heats: the last heat's results between heats, the series' standing after the last)
    const head = !s.heats || s.heats < 2 || !s.heat ? t('Results') : s.fin ? t('Final standings')
      : t('Heat {k} results', { k: Math.max(1, s.heat - 1) });
    box.append(el('div', 'lobby-head', head));
    const ol = el('ol', 'lobby-places');
    let place = 0;
    for (const r of s.res ?? []) {
      const li = el('li', r.me ? 'taken mine' : 'taken');
      li.append(el('span', 'lobby-n', r.f ? String(++place) : '–'), el('span', 'lobby-name', r.n));
      const what = !r.f ? t('DNF') : r.p !== undefined ? tn(r.p, '{n} point', '{n} points') : r.t !== undefined ? raceTime(r.t) : '';
      if (what) li.append(el('span', 'lobby-time', what));
      if (r.me && s.credit && s.credited !== -1) li.append(el('span', 'lobby-prize', `★ ${s.credit === 2 ? t('Friend\'s win') : t('Career win')}`));
      else if (r.me && s.prize) li.append(el('span', 'lobby-prize', `+$${s.prize}`));
      ol.append(li);
    }
    box.append(ol);
    return box;
  }

  private drawCover(s: LobbyState) {
    const card = el('div', 'lobby-card');
    // (on the way: the race and its players, no places open; back: its results)
    card.append(block(...this.head(s, true)), block(s.res?.length ? this.results(s) : this.players(s, false)));
    if (s.stand?.length && !s.fin) card.append(block(this.standings(s)));
    const step = el('div', 'lobby-step');
    step.append(el('span', 'lobby-spin'), el('span', '', `${s.step ? game(s.step) : t('Loading')}…`));
    card.append(block(step));
    this.cover.replaceChildren(card);
  }
}

// The game's output (stdout/stderr of every thread) kept in memory, the last
// few megabytes of it, for "Download log" (the Mac app's ~/Library/Logs/NFSU2).
// Lines also go to the console, where test runners read them.
//
// Players send the log after a crash, so a full log keeps what triage needs:
//  - its opening lines (the page's and the first game's start: the build, the
//    session line, settings, browser, renderer) and the lines given to keep()
//    (each later game's session lines) are never dropped, only what came between;
//  - a line, or a short group of lines, repeated back to back is kept once with
//    a count: a game error printed every frame (the force-feedback errors of
//    2026-10-21, tens of thousands of lines) no longer pushes out the history.

/** the longest group of lines folded (the force-feedback errors were two lines, each after an empty one) */
const FOLD_MAX = 4;
/** a group seen this many times in a row is folded */
const FOLD_MIN = 3;

export class LogRing {
  // the lines that may be dropped, oldest first from head; `total` counts every one ever added
  private lines: string[] = [];
  private head = 0;
  private bytes = 0;
  private total = 0;
  // the lines that stay: `at` = how many droppable lines came before
  private kept: { at: number; s: string }[] = [];
  private keptBytes = 0;
  private seen = 0;
  // a repeating group being folded: the next line expected (phase) and the repeats after the first
  private group: string[] | null = null;
  private phase = 0;
  private reps = 0;
  // lines being waited for (waitFor): a part of the line and what to call
  private waits: { part: string; done: (seen: boolean) => void }[] = [];
  dropped = 0;
  /** lines given to add() and keep() so far (a fold's repeats too): changes whenever the log does */
  added = 0;
  /** sees every line as it comes, a fold's repeats too (privacy.ts learns the names in them) */
  onLine?: (s: string) => void;
  constructor(private budget = 8 << 20, private echo = true, private headLines = 300, private keepBudget = 256 << 10) {}

  add(s: string) {
    this.added++;
    this.onLine?.(s);
    if (this.echo) console.log(s);
    if (this.waits.length) this.saw(s);
    if (this.group) {
      if (s === this.group[this.phase]) {
        if (++this.phase === this.group.length) { this.phase = 0; this.reps++; }
        return;
      }
      this.endFold();
    }
    this.push(s, false);
    this.fold();
  }
  /** a line that stays when the log is trimmed (a game's session lines) */
  keep(s: string) {
    this.added++;
    this.onLine?.(s);
    if (this.echo) console.log(s);
    if (this.waits.length) this.saw(s);
    if (this.group) this.endFold();
    this.push(s, true);
  }
  /** true once a line with `part` in it comes, false after `ms` */
  waitFor(part: string, ms: number): Promise<boolean> {
    return new Promise(resolve => {
      const w = { part, done: (seen: boolean) => { clearTimeout(timer); this.waits = this.waits.filter(x => x !== w); resolve(seen); } };
      const timer = setTimeout(() => w.done(false), ms);
      this.waits.push(w);
    });
  }
  private saw(s: string) {
    for (const w of [...this.waits]) if (s.includes(w.part)) w.done(true);
  }

  private push(s: string, keep: boolean) {
    const n = s.length + 1;
    if ((keep || this.seen++ < this.headLines) && this.keptBytes + n <= this.keepBudget) {
      this.kept.push({ at: this.total, s }); this.keptBytes += n;
      return;
    }
    this.lines.push(s); this.total++;
    this.bytes += n;
    while (this.bytes > this.budget && this.head < this.lines.length) {
      this.bytes -= this.lines[this.head].length + 1; this.head++; this.dropped++;
    }
    if (this.head > 4096 && this.head * 2 > this.lines.length) { this.lines = this.lines.slice(this.head); this.head = 0; }
  }
  /** the newest lines: the same group of k lines FOLD_MIN times in a row, after the last kept line, starts a fold */
  private fold() {
    const n = this.lines.length, last = this.kept.length ? this.kept[this.kept.length - 1].at : 0;
    const from = Math.max(this.head, n - (this.total - last));
    for (let k = 1; k <= FOLD_MAX; k++) {
      if (n - FOLD_MIN * k < from) return;
      let i = 1;
      while (i <= (FOLD_MIN - 1) * k && this.lines[n - i] === this.lines[n - i - k]) i++;
      if (i <= (FOLD_MIN - 1) * k) continue;
      this.group = this.lines.slice(n - k);
      this.phase = 0; this.reps = FOLD_MIN - 1;
      for (const l of this.lines.splice(n - (FOLD_MIN - 1) * k)) this.bytes -= l.length + 1;
      this.total -= (FOLD_MIN - 1) * k;
      return;
    }
  }
  private foldNote(more = ''): string {
    const k = this.group!.length;
    return `[log] ${k === 1 ? 'the line' : `the ${k} lines`} above repeated ${this.reps} more times${more}`;
  }
  private endFold() {
    const g = this.group!, phase = this.phase, note = this.foldNote();
    this.group = null;
    this.push(note, false);
    for (let i = 0; i < phase; i++) this.push(g[i], false);    // a group cut short
  }

  text(): string {
    const out: string[] = [];
    const first = this.total - (this.lines.length - this.head);  // the oldest droppable line still here
    let pos = 0;
    const upTo = (end: number) => {
      if (pos < first && end > pos) {
        const d = Math.min(end, first) - pos;
        out.push(`[... ${d} lines dropped: the log keeps its opening lines and the last ${(this.budget / 1048576).toFixed(0)} MB]`);
        pos += d;
      }
      for (; pos < end; pos++) out.push(this.lines[this.head + pos - first]);
    };
    for (const k of this.kept) { upTo(k.at); out.push(k.s); }
    upTo(this.total);
    if (this.group) out.push(this.foldNote(' (so far)'));
    return out.join('\n') + '\n';
  }
  /** the newest n lines, kept ones included (the test tools read it: window.__nfsu2.log) */
  tail(n: number): string[] {
    const out: string[] = [];
    if (this.group) out.push(this.foldNote(' (so far)'));
    let j = this.lines.length - 1, k = this.kept.length - 1, abs = this.total - 1;   // abs: lines[j]'s place
    while (out.length < n && (j >= this.head || k >= 0)) {
      if (k >= 0 && (j < this.head || this.kept[k].at > abs)) out.push(this.kept[k--].s);
      else { out.push(this.lines[j--]); abs--; }
    }
    return out.reverse();
  }
  /** A short copy of the log, about `budget` bytes, for keeping where a page that is stopped cannot lose it
   *  (lastgame.ts): the opening lines (an eighth of it), the newest game's session lines from its "=== NFSU2 web" line
   *  on (a quarter), and the newest lines; where lines are left out it says so.  The whole text when that fits. */
  snapshot(budget = 160 << 10): string {
    if (this.size + 64 <= budget) return this.text();
    const kept = this.kept, out: string[] = [];
    const first = this.total - (this.lines.length - this.head);    // the oldest droppable line still here
    // the opening: the kept lines with no line between them that this copy would leave out
    let used = 0, h = 0;
    for (; h < kept.length && kept[h].at <= first && used + kept[h].s.length + 1 <= budget >> 3; h++) { out.push(kept[h].s); used += kept[h].s.length + 1; }
    // the newest game's session: from its first line, as far as a quarter of the budget goes
    let s = kept.length;
    for (let i = kept.length - 1; i >= h; i--) if (kept[i].s.startsWith('=== NFSU2 web')) { s = i; break; }
    let e = s;
    for (let b = 0; e < kept.length && b + kept[e].s.length + 1 <= budget >> 2; e++) b += kept[e].s.length + 1;
    const sess = kept.slice(s, e).map(k => k.s);
    for (const l of sess) used += l.length + 1;
    // the newest lines, back to the last kept line already in, as far as the rest of the budget goes
    const tail: string[] = [];
    if (this.group) { const f = this.foldNote(' (so far)'); tail.push(f); used += f.length + 1; }
    let j = this.lines.length - 1, k = kept.length - 1, abs = this.total - 1;
    const stop = Math.max(h, e) - 1;   // kept lines up to here are in already
    while (j >= this.head || k > stop) {
      const isKept = k > stop && (j < this.head || kept[k].at > abs);
      const l = isKept ? kept[k].s : this.lines[j];
      if (used + l.length + 1 > budget) break;
      tail.push(l); used += l.length + 1;
      if (isKept) k--; else { j--; abs--; }
    }
    // how many lines each gap leaves out: droppable ones (by place) and kept ones (by index)
    const gap = (n: number) => n > 0 ? [`[... ${n} lines left out of this copy of the log]`] : [];
    const keptAt = (i: number) => (i < kept.length ? kept[i].at : this.total);
    const tailStartAbs = j + 1 - this.head + first;      // the first droppable line in the tail
    const res = [...out];
    if (sess.length) {
      res.push(...gap(Math.max(0, keptAt(s) - Math.max(first, h ? kept[h - 1].at : first)) + (s - h)));
      res.push(...sess);
    }
    const from = sess.length ? e : h;
    res.push(...gap(Math.max(0, tailStartAbs - (from > 0 ? keptAt(from - 1) : first)) + Math.max(0, k - from + 1)));
    res.push(...tail.reverse());
    return res.join('\n') + '\n';
  }
  get size() { return this.bytes + this.keptBytes; }
  get count() { return this.lines.length - this.head + this.kept.length; }
  clear() {
    this.lines = []; this.head = 0; this.bytes = 0; this.total = 0; this.dropped = 0;
    this.kept = []; this.keptBytes = 0; this.seen = 0; this.group = null;
  }
}

export function downloadBlob(data: BlobPart, name: string, type = 'application/octet-stream') {
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([data], { type }));
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url; a.download = name; a.style.display = 'none';
  document.body.append(a); a.click(); a.remove();
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 30000);
}

export function stamp(d = new Date()): string {
  const p = (n: number) => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
  return `${d.getFullYear()}-${p(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${p(d.getDate())}_${p(d.getHours())}${p(d.getMinutes())}${p(d.getSeconds())}`;
}

/** the key that opens the card while driving in free roam (the player's: sitekeys.ts, I by default).  Not T: the game's
 *  Career Status (T and F4, its driving key map, dinput_kbd.c DIMAP=1, action 0x12; issue #52).  The game's driving map
 *  leaves E I O V Z free; I is away from W A S D and the arrows, so an accidental press (the card takes the keys) is
 *  unlikely */
const msgKey = () => siteKey('message');
/** a message at most (characters; the server's PAGE_MSG_LEN): three lines of the log */
export const MSG_MAX = 120;
/** I answers the newest message of this game when it came less than this long ago (ms); after that it asks whom */
const REPLY_MS = 120_000;
/** a message's line in the log: this long, and longer for a long one (ms; quick chat's are 8 s) */
const LINE_MS = 8000, LINE_MS_PER_CHAR = 60, LINE_MS_MAX = 15_000;
/** a message the server has not answered for this long did not go (ms) */
const SEND_WAIT_MS = 10_000;
/** what the store keeps: messages per friend, friends */
const KEEP_MSGS = 40, KEEP_FRIENDS = 60;
/** the friend list's rows at most (keys 1-9) */
const PICK_MAX = 9;

/** one message of a conversation: from the friend ('in') or the player ('out'), when (ms since 1970), and what became
 *  of the player's: on its way, got by the friend's game or page, waiting for the friend, not sent */
export interface Msg { dir: 'in' | 'out'; body: string; t: number; st?: 'wait' | 'sent' | 'kept' | 'failed' }
interface Talk { name: string; msgs: Msg[]; unread: number }

const keyOf = (name: string) => name.toLowerCase();

/** The conversations of the player's claimed name, in this browser's storage (none: kept while the page is open). */
export class MessageStore {
  private me = '';
  private talks: Record<string, Talk> = {};
  private listeners = new Set<() => void>();

  /** the player's claimed name (the friends list's "me"): its conversations (null: none) */
  setMe(me: string | null) {
    const k = me ? keyOf(me) : '';
    if (k === this.me) return;
    // what came before the name was known (a message ahead of the friends list) joins the name's
    const early = this.me ? {} : this.talks;
    this.me = k;
    this.talks = {};
    if (k) {
      const v = localStore.getJSON(this.storeKey());
      if (v && typeof v === 'object') this.talks = v as Record<string, Talk>;
    }
    for (const [f, tk] of Object.entries(early)) {
      const to = this.talks[f] ??= { name: tk.name, msgs: [], unread: 0 };
      to.msgs.push(...tk.msgs);
      to.unread += tk.unread;
    }
    this.changed(Object.keys(early).length > 0);
  }

  private storeKey() { return MESSAGES + this.me; }

  private changed(save = true) {
    if (save && this.me) {
      // the friends talked to last stay
      const ks = Object.keys(this.talks);
      if (ks.length > KEEP_FRIENDS) {
        const last = (k: string) => this.talks[k].msgs.at(-1)?.t ?? 0;
        for (const k of ks.sort((a, b) => last(a) - last(b)).slice(0, ks.length - KEEP_FRIENDS)) delete this.talks[k];
      }
      localStore.setJSON(this.storeKey(), this.talks);
    }
    for (const f of this.listeners) f();
  }

  onChange(f: () => void) { this.listeners.add(f); }

  /** a message to or from friend `name`; unread: one of theirs not seen yet */
  add(name: string, m: Msg, unread: boolean) {
    const k = keyOf(name), tk = this.talks[k] ??= { name, msgs: [], unread: 0 };
    tk.name = name;
    tk.msgs.push(m);
    if (tk.msgs.length > KEEP_MSGS) tk.msgs.splice(0, tk.msgs.length - KEEP_MSGS);
    if (unread) tk.unread++;
    this.changed();
  }

  /** what became of the player's message to `name` sent at `at` */
  mark(name: string, at: number, st: Msg['st']) {
    const m = this.talks[keyOf(name)]?.msgs.find(x => x.dir === 'out' && x.t === at);
    if (m) { m.st = st; this.changed(); }
  }

  messages(name: string): readonly Msg[] { return this.talks[keyOf(name)]?.msgs ?? []; }
  unread(name: string): number { return this.talks[keyOf(name)]?.unread ?? 0; }
  read(name: string) {
    const tk = this.talks[keyOf(name)];
    if (tk?.unread) { tk.unread = 0; this.changed(); }
  }
  /** the newest message from `name` (none: undefined) */
  lastIn(name: string): Msg | undefined { return this.messages(name).findLast(m => m.dir === 'in'); }
}

/** the messages that came with a list or one by one (friends.rs "mail"), as the store takes them */
export function mailOf(v: unknown): { from: string; body: string; t: number }[] {
  return Array.isArray(v)
    ? v.filter((m: any) => typeof m?.from === 'string' && typeof m?.body === 'string')
      .map((m: any) => ({ from: m.from, body: m.body.slice(0, MSG_MAX * 2), t: Number(m.at) || Date.now() }))
    : [];
}

/** what a "done" other than sent or kept says to the player (null: nothing) */
export function sendTrouble(done: string, name: string): string | null {
  switch (done) {
    case 'sent': case 'kept': case 'empty': return null;
    case 'none': return t('{name} is not on your friends list', { name });
    case 'off': return t('You can\'t send messages for a few minutes');
    case 'rate': return t('Wait a moment');
    case 'claim': return t('Claim your name on the start page to send messages');
    default: return t('The message was not sent: try again in a moment');
  }
}

export interface FriendMessagesDeps {

  driving(): boolean;

/** Messages between friends in the game (this module's doc). */
export class FriendMessages {

  private offered: { name: string; until: number } | null = null;

    clearInterval(this.timer);

  /** the card's place: the log's (shell.ts placeNotices), u: CSS px per HUD unit */
  place(left: number, top: number, u: number) {

    s.left = `${left}px`; s.top = `${top}px`;
    s.setProperty('--u', `${u}px`);

  /** a friend message from the server (friends.rs): the list (with the messages that waited), a message, an answer */
  server(m: any) {
    if (typeof m?.op !== 'string') return;
    if (m.op === 'list') {
      this.store.setMe(typeof m.me === 'string' ? m.me : null);
      const names: string[] = Array.isArray(m.friends) ? m.friends.filter((f: unknown) => typeof f === 'string') : [];
      const at = new Map(this.friends.map(f => [f.name, f.at]));
      this.friends = names.map(name => ({ name, at: at.get(name) ?? '' }));
      this.listed = true;
      for (const x of mailOf(m.mail)) this.incoming(x.from, x.body, x.t);
      if (this.mode === 'pick') this.draw();
    } else if (m.op === 'where') {
      // where each friend plays (friends.ts asks every minute; the card asks when it opens)
      if (!Array.isArray(m.friends)) return;
      this.friends = m.friends.filter((f: any) => typeof f?.name === 'string')
        .map((f: any) => ({ name: f.name, at: f.where === 'roam' || f.where === 'online' ? f.where : '' }));
      this.listed = true;
      if (this.mode === 'pick') this.draw();
    } else if (m.op === 'mail') {
      for (const x of mailOf([m])) this.incoming(x.from, x.body, x.t);
    } else if (m.op === 'msg') {
      const w = this.waiting.get(Number(m.id));
      if (!w) return;
      this.waiting.delete(Number(m.id));
      this.answered(w, String(m.done ?? ''));
    }
  }

  /** a friend's message: kept, and on the log now or once the player drives in free roam */
  private incoming(from: string, body: string, at: number) {
    this.deps.log(`[msg] from ${from}`);
    this.store.add(from, { dir: 'in', body, t: at }, true);
    if (this.on) this.queue.push({ from, body });
    this.tick();
  }

    if (done === 'sent' || done === 'kept') {

      const note = done === 'kept' ? t('(gets it when back)') : '';
      this.deps.line(t('To {name}', { name: w.name }), w.body, true, note, lineMs(w.body));
      return;
    }
    this.store.mark(w.name, w.t, 'failed');
    const why = sendTrouble(done, w.name);
    if (why) this.deps.toast(why);
  }

  private tick() {
    const now = performance.now();
    for (const [id, w] of this.waiting) {
      if (now - w.at > SEND_WAIT_MS) { this.waiting.delete(id); this.answered(w, 'timeout'); }
    }
    if (this.mode && !this.deps.driving()) this.close();
    if (!this.queue.length || !this.deps.driving()) return;
    for (const { from, body } of this.queue.splice(0)) {
      const ms = lineMs(body);
      this.deps.line(from, body, false, '', ms, () => this.write(from, true));
      this.store.read(from);
      this.newest = { name: from, at: now }; this.offered = null;
      this.deps.hint(touchFirst() ? null : ms);
    }
  }

  private key(e: KeyboardEvent) {
    if (!this.on || !this.session || e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.altKey || e.code !== msgKey()) return;
    const el = e.target as HTMLElement | null;
    if (el?.closest?.('input, textarea, select, dialog[open]') || document.querySelector('dialog[open]')) return;
    // (a control of the game's the player put on I: the game's alone, gamekeys.ts)
    if (this.mode || !this.deps.driving() || gameHas(this.session, KEY_MESSAGE)) return;
    e.preventDefault(); e.stopImmediatePropagation();
    if (e.repeat) return;
    const n = this.newest, o = this.offered, now = performance.now();
    if (o && now < o.until) this.write(o.name, false);
    else if (n && now - n.at < REPLY_MS) this.write(n.name, false);
    else this.pick(false);
  }

  /** a friend came into free roam (friends.ts's notice, shell.ts friendNotice): for the notice's time MSG_KEY writes
   *  to it, and the hint under the notice says so ("I Message"); not on a touch screen (quick chat's sheet has
   *  Message a friend), nor while the key is the game's */
  offer(name: string, ms: number) {
    if (!this.on || this.mode || touchFirst() || !msgKey() || !this.deps.driving() || gameHas(this.session, KEY_MESSAGE)) return;
    this.offered = { name, until: performance.now() + ms };
    this.deps.hint(ms, t('Message'));
  }

  /** quick chat's touch sheet: "Message a friend" */
  pickByTouch() { if (this.deps.driving()) this.pick(true); }

  /** whether the touch sheet offers it (quick chat's sheet asks) */
  get enabled() { return this.on; }

  private pick(touch: boolean) {
    this.touch = touch; this.mode = 'pick'; this.to = '';
    this.deps.hint(null);
    // where each friend plays now
    this.deps.send({ op: 'where' });
    this.draw();
    if (!touch) this.card.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  }

  private write(name: string, touch = this.touch) {
    if (!this.deps.driving()) return;
    this.touch = touch; this.mode = 'write'; this.to = name;
    this.deps.hint(null);
    this.draw();
    this.card.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>('input')?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  }

  private close() {
    if (!this.mode) return;
    const had = this.card.contains(document.activeElement);
    this.mode = null; this.to = '';
    this.card.hidden = true;
    this.card.replaceChildren();
    if (had) this.deps.focusGame();
  }

  private cardKey(e: KeyboardEvent) {
    if (e.code === 'Escape') { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); this.close(); return; }
    if (this.mode === 'pick' && !e.repeat) {
      const d = /^(?:Digit|Numpad)([1-9])$/.exec(e.code);
      const f = d ? this.sorted()[+d[1] - 1] : undefined;
      if (f) { e.preventDefault(); this.write(f.name, false); }
    } else if (this.mode === 'write' && e.code === 'Enter' && !e.isComposing) {
      e.preventDefault();
      this.sendNow();
    }
  }

  /** the friends in the order the card lists them: in free roam, in the Online lobby, then the others */
  private sorted(): Friend[] {
    const rank = (a: string) => a === 'roam' ? 0 : a === 'online' ? 1 : 2;
    return [...this.friends].sort((a, b) => rank(a.at) - rank(b.at) || a.name.localeCompare(b.name)).slice(0, PICK_MAX);
  }

  private sendNow() {
    const input = this.card.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>('input');
    const body = (input?.value ?? '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, MSG_MAX);
    if (!body || !this.to) { this.close(); return; }
    const id = this.nextId++, at = Date.now();
    if (!this.deps.send({ op: 'msg', name: this.to, body, id })) { this.deps.toast(t('The message was not sent: try again in a moment')); return; }
    this.store.add(this.to, { dir: 'out', body, t: at, st: 'wait' }, false);
    this.store.read(this.to);
    this.waiting.set(id, { name: this.to, t: at, body, at: performance.now() });
    this.deps.log(`[msg] sending to ${this.to} (${body.length} characters)`);
    this.close();
  }

  /** the card (cards.ts, quick chat's picker's place): picking, its title, the friends (a key cap, the name, where
   *  each plays; on a touch screen rows to tap), "Esc closes"; writing, its title, the message answered and the field,
   *  then what the keys do and the characters left (on a touch screen Send) */
  private draw() {
    const c = this.card;
    this.deps.placeNow();

export interface ChatDialogDeps {

/** The start page's conversation with one friend (index.html #chat-pop): the messages kept here, a field, Send. */
export class ChatDialog {
  private name = '';
  private d: HTMLDialogElement;

  constructor(private store: MessageStore, private deps: ChatDialogDeps) {
    this.d = document.querySelector<HTMLDialogElement>('#chat-pop')!;
    const input = this.input();
    input.maxLength = MSG_MAX;
    input.addEventListener('input', () => this.count());
    input.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.isComposing) { e.preventDefault(); void this.send(); } });
    this.d.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>('#chat-send')!.addEventListener('click', () => void this.send());
    store.onChange(() => { if (this.d.open) { this.store.read(this.name); this.render(); } });
  }

  private input() { return this.d.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>('#chat-text')!; }

  open(name: string) {
    this.name = name;
    this.d.querySelector('#chat-pop-title')!.textContent = name;
    this.d.querySelector('#chat-note')!.textContent = '';
    this.input().value = '';
    this.count();
    this.store.read(name);
    this.render();
    this.d.showModal();
    this.input().focus();
  }

  private count() {
    this.d.querySelector('#chat-left')!.textContent = String(MSG_MAX - this.input().value.length);
  }

  private render() {
    const box = this.d.querySelector<HTMLElement>('#chat-log')!, msgs = this.store.messages(this.name);
    const fmt = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, { weekday: 'short', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
    const rows: HTMLElement[] = msgs.map(m => {
      const r = document.createElement('div');
      r.className = `chat-msg ${m.dir}`;
      const head = document.createElement('div');
      head.className = 'chat-head';
      const who = document.createElement('b');
      who.textContent = m.dir === 'in' ? this.name : t('You');
      const when = document.createElement('span');
      const st = m.st === 'wait' ? t('sending') : m.st === 'kept' ? t('gets it when back') : m.st === 'failed' ? t('not sent') : '';
      when.textContent = st ? `${fmt.format(m.t)} · ${st}` : fmt.format(m.t);
      head.append(who, when);
      const body = document.createElement('p');
      body.textContent = m.body;
      r.append(head, body);
      return r;
    });
    if (!rows.length) {
      const p = document.createElement('p');
      p.className = 'hint';
      p.textContent = t('No messages yet. Messages wait up to 7 days for a friend who is away.');
      rows.push(p);
    }
    box.replaceChildren(...rows);
    box.scrollTop = box.scrollHeight;
  }

  private async send() {
    const input = this.input(), name = this.name;
    const body = input.value.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, MSG_MAX);
    if (!body) return;
    const at = Date.now();
    input.value = '';
    this.count();
    this.store.add(name, { dir: 'out', body, t: at, st: 'wait' }, false);
    let done: string | null = null;
    try { done = await this.deps.send(name, body); } catch (e) { this.deps.log(`[msg] to ${name} failed: ${e}`); }
    this.deps.log(`[msg] to ${name} from the start page: ${done ?? 'no answer'}`);
    const ok = done === 'sent' || done === 'kept';
    this.store.mark(name, at, ok ? done as 'sent' | 'kept' : 'failed');
    const why = done === null ? t('The message was not sent: try again in a moment') : sendTrouble(done, name);
    this.d.querySelector('#chat-note')!.textContent = why ?? '';
  }
}

import { ADDED, KINDS, LABELS, MODS, ONLINE, OURS, PLACES, USES, type Author, type Change, type Mod } from './mods';

const BY_ID = new Map(MODS.map(m => [m.id, m]));
const GROUPS = new Map(ADDED.map(g => [g.id, g]));

/** the entries of id's row: the entry, then those that share its row (mods.ts row) */
export function rowMods(id: string): Mod[] {

  return first ? [first, ...MODS.filter(m => m.row === id)] : [];

/** a row's name: its mods' names ("Upscaled HUD and Detailed Map") */

  return listOf(rowMods(id).map(m => m.name));

/** a row's help line in the page's language: "by <authors> · <its line>" */
export function rowHelp(id: string): string {
  const ms = rowMods(id), names = [...new Set(ms.flatMap(m => m.authors.map(a => a.name)))];
  const line = t(ms[0]?.line ?? '');
  return names.length ? `${t(LABELS.rowBy, { names: listOf(names) })} · ${line}` : line;
}

/** a group's names in its row's help: the first 2 or 3 (a third where they stay this short), then how many more */
const NAMES_LONG = 44;
/** where the English names go in the help's translated text */
const MARK = '\u0001';

/** a group of our changes' help line: its first names (English, as the popup's), and "and {n} more" */
function groupHelp(items: readonly Change[]): (Node | string)[] {
  const names = items.map(i => i.name);
  let n = Math.min(2, names.length);
  if (n < names.length && names.slice(0, n + 1).join(', ').length <= NAMES_LONG) n++;
  const rest = names.length - n;
  const shown = rest ? names.slice(0, n).join(', ') : listOf(names);
  const text = rest ? tn(rest, '{names} and {n} more', '{names} and {n} more', { names: MARK }) : MARK;
  const at = text.indexOf(MARK);
  if (at < 0) return [text];
  return [text.slice(0, at), Object.assign(document.createElement('span'), { lang: 'en', textContent: shown }), text.slice(at + 1)];
}

const SVG = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';

function infoIcon(): SVGSVGElement {

  const c = document.createElementNS(SVG, 'circle'); c.setAttribute('cx', '12'); c.setAttribute('cy', '12'); c.setAttribute('r', '9');
  const p = document.createElementNS(SVG, 'path'); p.setAttribute('d', 'M12 11v5M12 8h.01');

}

/**

 * does not wrap (.set-name-end), so where the name takes two lines the (i) follows its last word, never alone.  As the
 * (i) is in it, the label names nothing by its text: the row's control (settings-ui.ts) and group take the name as

function withInfo(label: HTMLElement, info: HTMLButtonElement): HTMLElement {

    return ms.length ? [section(k.kind, k.title, [...lead, ...ms.map(m => 'setting' in m.control ? settingRow(m.control.setting) : modRow(m))])] : [];
  });

    plainRow(g.id, t(g.title), t(LABELS.ours, { name: t(g.title) }), groupHelp(g.items))))];
}

/** where a mod without a setting is set (a popup's fact): "Always on", or the page's or the game's place */
function placeOf(m: Mod): string {
  const c = m.control;

/** the row whose popup is open, and the button that opened it (the focus goes back to it) */
let open: { id: string; from: HTMLButtonElement } | null = null;

/** text with {names} as the author links (the page's "a, b and c"): an author's own page, or the mod's for its one
 *  author of its own; a port's authors and a mod's several without a page of their own as plain text */
function byLine(label: string, authors: readonly Author[], m: Mod): Node[] {
  const marks = authors.map((_, i) => `\u0001${i}\u0001`);
  const text = t(label, { names: listOf(marks) });
  const sole = m.authors.filter(a => !a.port).length === 1;
  return text.split(/\u0001(\d+)\u0001/).map((part, i) => {
    if (i % 2 === 0) return document.createTextNode(part);
    const a = authors[+part], href = a.url ?? (sole && !a.port ? m.links.page ?? m.links.source : undefined);
    if (!href) return document.createTextNode(a.name);
    return Object.assign(document.createElement('a'), { href, target: '_blank', rel: 'noopener noreferrer', textContent: a.name });
  });
}

/** a mod's makers in one line: from its mod, by its authors, ported by */
function makers(m: Mod): HTMLElement | null {
  const own = m.authors.filter(a => !a.port), port = m.authors.filter(a => a.port);
  const parts: Node[][] = [];
  if (m.mod) parts.push([document.createTextNode(t(LABELS.partOf, { mod: m.mod }))]);
  if (own.length) parts.push(byLine(LABELS.by, own, m));
  if (port.length) parts.push(byLine(LABELS.port, port, m));
  if (!parts.length) return null;
  const p = document.createElement('p'); p.className = 'hint mod-by';
  parts.forEach((x, i) => { if (i) p.append(' · '); p.append(...x); });
  return p;
}

/** a mod's short facts: where it is set (or "With it off: as in the original game"), who sees it, its download, what

  if ('setting' in m.control) { if (m.off !== false) add(t(LABELS.off)); } else add(placeOf(m));

  if (m.uses) add(t(USES[m.uses]));
  if (m.licence) add(t(LABELS.licence, { licence: m.licence }));
  return ul;
}

/** one mod in the popup: (a shared row's: its name and its makers) what it does, its parts, its facts and its pages */
function modInfo(m: Mod, named: boolean): Node[] {

    out.push(Object.assign(document.createElement('h3'), { textContent: m.name }));
    const by = makers(m);

    }

  if (links.length) {

 *  found out about the game (addresses, values), written anew (findings); or nothing, a mod made for this port in its
 *  own source (original: no link) */

  online: Online;
  /** false: its setting off is not the original game (Subtitles: none at all, which its details say); else the popup
   *  says "With it off: as in the original game" (a setting's entry only) */
  off?: false;
  /** a mod of several parts (NFSU2 Extra Options): each part, what it does (English, as details) and who sees it */
  parts?: readonly { name: string; text: string; online: Online }[];
  /** the mod's licence, where it states one */
  licence?: 'MIT' | 'GPL-3.0' | 'No Rights Reserved';
  /** its code ported by the mod's own author, in this repo's history (his commits): no licence file of its own */
  ownPort?: true;
  /** about how much the mod's own files add to the download (a shared row's: each its own, so they add up) */
  sizeMB?: number;
  /** another default on phones (device.ts deviceDefaults) */
  phones?: string;
  /** the repo's files that make it */
  files: readonly string[];
  /** not built yet: its files and its setting may not exist */
  pending?: true;
}

// A player's name that reads as a slur.  The server (web/server-rs/crates/names, the same rules) refuses one for
// the Online mode (an account or persona; its results drop the ones kept under one) and the switch's peer list
// shows "player" for one (nfsu2-lan clean_name); the page's settings refuse one as "Your name"

/** ch as a letter (above), else '' */
function letter(ch) {
  if (ch >= 'A' && ch <= 'Z') ch = ch.toLowerCase();
  const i = FROM.indexOf(ch);
  if (i >= 0) return TO[i];
  return ch >= 'a' && ch <= 'z' ? ch : '';
}
const word = w => [...w].map(letter).join('');
const PHRASES = HATE.verbs.flatMap(v => ['', ...HATE.between].flatMap(b => HATE.groups.map(g => v + b + g)));
const ANYWHERE = [...SLURS.anywhere, ...PHRASES].map(word), WHOLE = SLURS.whole.map(word), EDGE = SLURS.edge.map(word);
const OK_START = EDGE_OK.start.map(word), OK_END = EDGE_OK.end.map(word), STEMS = PID_STEMS.map(word);
const OK_WHOLE = WHOLE_OK.map(word);
const DYKE = [word('dyke')], NIGER = word('niger'), NIGERIA = word('nigeri');
const digit = ch => ch !== undefined && ch >= '0' && ch <= '9';
/** the run of n digits at str[i] is a number, not letters: three or more, or two with no letter after them or a
 *  capital after a small letter before them */
function number(str, i, n) {
  if (n !== 2) return n > 2;
  const a = str[i + 2] ?? '', b = str[i - 1] ?? '';
  return !a || !letter(a) || (a >= 'A' && a <= 'Z' && b >= 'a' && b <= 'z');
}
/** the end of word w (its letters) at s[i], each letter at least as many times in a row as in w; -1 if it is not
 *  there */
function at(s, i, w) {
  for (let j = 0; j < w.length;) {
    const c = w[j];
    let m = 0, k = 0;
    for (; w[j] === c; j++) m++;
    while (s[i + k] === c) k++;
    if (k < m) return -1;
    i += k;
  }
  return i;
}
/** a "pid" word of the anywhere list (pidor, pidar, pidr) at s[i] is the end of an English word: not at the start of
 *  a part, and right after the start of one of those words ("RapidRacer", "Stupidrift"), or after a vowel and into
 *  the next part ("TopiDrift"); "vladpidr", "dapidor", "YaPidor" are slurs.  starts[j]: a part starts at s[j] */
function englishPid(s, i, w, starts) {
  if (!w.startsWith('pid') || starts[i]) return false;
  if (STEMS.some(st => st.length <= i && s.startsWith(st, i - st.length))) return true;
  if (!'aeiouy'.includes(s[i - 1])) return false;
  for (let j = i + 1, e = at(s, i, w); j < e; j++) if (starts[j]) return true;
  return false;
}
/** a word of the anywhere list at s[i] is no slur there: an English "pid" word, "niger" in "Nigeria" */
const excused = (s, i, w, starts) => englishPid(s, i, w, starts) || (w === NIGER && s.startsWith(NIGERIA, i));
/** t is all one of words, or its plural */
function whole(t, words) {
  return words.some(w => {
    let e = at(t, 0, w);
    if (e < 0) return false;
    while (t[e] === 's') e++;
    return e === t.length;
  });
}

/** t is a word of the whole list (or its plural), and no name of WHOLE_OK */
const wholeWord = t => whole(t, WHOLE) && !OK_WHOLE.includes(t);

/** t starts with word w (its letters, as at() reads them) */
const startsWith = (t, w) => at(t, 0, w) >= 0;
/** t ends with word w, or its plural */
function endsWith(t, w) {
  for (let i = 0; i < t.length; i++) {
    let e = at(t, i, w);
    if (e < 0) continue;
    while (t[e] === 's') e++;
    if (e === t.length) return true;
  }
  return false;
}
/** t starts or ends with a word of the edge list, and not with a word of EDGE_OK there */
const edge = t => EDGE.some(w => (startsWith(t, w) && !OK_START.some(x => startsWith(t, x))) ||
  (endsWith(t, w) && !OK_END.some(x => endsWith(t, x))));

/** name reads as a slur (above) */
export function blockedName(name) {
  const str = [...String(name ?? '').normalize('NFKD').replace(/\p{M}/gu, '')].map(ch => LOOKALIKE[ch] ?? ch);
  // 1488, spaces, _ or - between its digits or not ("14_88"; not "1:48.8", a lap time)
  if (str.filter(ch => !' _-'.includes(ch)).join('').includes('1488')) return true;
  let s = '', t = '', prev = '', low = false;
  const starts = [];
  for (let i = 0; i <= str.length; i++) {
    const ch = str[i] ?? '';
    let r = 0;
    while (digit(str[i + r])) r++;
    let num = r > 0 && number(str, i, r);
    // after a lone n (or ni) and before a letter, digits are letters: "N1663r"
    if (num && (t === 'n' || t === 'ni') && str[i + r] && letter(str[i + r])) num = false;
    const c = num ? '' : ch && letter(ch);
    if ((!c || (low && ch >= 'A' && ch <= 'Z')) && t) {
      if ((wholeWord(t) && !(prev === 'van' && whole(t, DYKE))) || edge(t)) return true;
      prev = t; t = '';
    }
    if (c) {
      if (s.length < 255) { starts[s.length] = !t; s += c; }
      if (t.length < 255) t += c;
    }
    if (!c) low = false;
    else if ((ch >= 'a' && ch <= 'z') || (ch >= 'A' && ch <= 'Z')) low = ch >= 'a';
    if (num) i += r - 1;
  }
  return ANYWHERE.some(w => {
    for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) if (at(s, i, w) >= 0 && !excused(s, i, w, starts)) return true;
    return false;
  }) || wholeWord(s) || edge(s);
}

const P_EDGE = PLATE.edge.map(word), P_END_OK = PLATE.endOk.map(word), P_RESTS = PLATE.rests.map(word);
const P_ANY = PLATE.anywhere.map(word), P_ANY_OK = PLATE.anywhereOk.map(word);
/** word x holds s[i..e): it is there from s[j], j <= i, to e or past it */
function held(s, i, e, x) {
  for (let j = Math.max(0, i - x.length); j <= i; j++) if (at(s, j, x) >= e) return true;
  return false;
}
/** plate (a license plate: capitals and digits, at most 8; anything else is read as a name only) reads as a slur, as
 *  a name or as a plate (PLATE) */
export function blockedPlate(plate) {
  const p = String(plate ?? '');
  if (blockedName(p)) return true;
  if (!/^[A-Z0-9]{0,8}$/.test(p)) return false;
  const parts = p.match(/[A-Z]+|[0-9]+/g) ?? [];
  if (parts.some((x, i) => PLATE.alone.includes(x) ||
    (PLATE.numbers.includes(x) && [parts[i - 1] ?? '', parts[i + 1] ?? ''].some(y => PLATE.marks.includes(y))))) return true;
  // its letters as a name's, a lone digit at its end left out
  const q = /[A-Z][0-9]$/.test(p) ? p.slice(0, -1) : p;
  let s = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < q.length; i++) {
    let r = 0;
    while (digit(q[i + r])) r++;
    if (r && number(q, i, r)) i += r - 1;
    else s += letter(q[i]);
  }
  return P_EDGE.some(w => {
    if (endsWith(s, w) && !P_END_OK.some(x => endsWith(s, x))) return true;
    const e = at(s, 0, w);
    return e >= 0 && P_RESTS.some(r => whole(s.slice(e), [r]) || whole(s.slice(e).replace(/^s+/, ''), [r]));
  }) || P_ANY.some(w => {
    for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
      const e = at(s, i, w);
      if (e >= 0 && !P_ANY_OK.some(x => held(s, i, e, x))) return true;
    }
    return false;
  });
}
