// The frame-rate counter over the game (F8: off, on, detailed).  The game's
// own rate comes from its presented-frame counter (HOST_KIND_STATUS, see
// status.ts); until a status block exists it falls back to the page's
// requestAnimationFrame rate, and says so.

import type { StatusReader } from './status';
import type { GameMemory } from '../host/memory';

export type FpsMode = 'off' | 'on' | 'detailed';
export const FPS_MODES: FpsMode[] = ['off', 'on', 'detailed'];

export class FpsOverlay {
  mode: FpsMode = 'off';
  private raf = 0;
  private rafTimes: number[] = [];
  private samples: { t: number; frames: number; tris: number }[] = [];
  private lastPaint = 0;
  reader: StatusReader | null = null;
  extra: () => Record<string, number> = () => ({});
  memory: GameMemory | null = null;
  /** latest game frame rate (for tests and the page) */
  gameFps = 0;
  pageFps = 0;

  constructor(private el: HTMLElement) {}

  set(mode: FpsMode) {
    this.mode = mode;
    this.el.hidden = mode === 'off';
    if (mode !== 'off' && !this.raf) this.raf = requestAnimationFrame(this.tick);
    if (mode === 'off' && this.raf) { cancelAnimationFrame(this.raf); this.raf = 0; }
  }
  cycle(): FpsMode { const m = FPS_MODES[(FPS_MODES.indexOf(this.mode) + 1) % FPS_MODES.length]; this.set(m); return m; }
  stop() { if (this.raf) cancelAnimationFrame(this.raf); this.raf = 0; this.samples = []; this.rafTimes = []; this.el.hidden = true; }

  private tick = (now: number) => {
    this.raf = requestAnimationFrame(this.tick);
    this.rafTimes.push(now);
    while (this.rafTimes.length > 2 && now - this.rafTimes[0] > 1000) this.rafTimes.shift();
    if (now - this.lastPaint < 250) return;
    this.lastPaint = now;
    const rt = this.rafTimes;
    this.pageFps = rt.length > 1 ? (rt.length - 1) * 1000 / (rt[rt.length - 1] - rt[0]) : 0;
    const st = this.reader?.read() ?? null;
    if (st?.has('frames')) {
      // the game's own clock: frames_t is when the C side read frames (the page's
      // sampling times do not line up with its updates); a block without it
      // (an older build) falls back to the page's time
      const t = st.get('frames_t') ?? now, f = st.get('frames')!;
      const last = this.samples[this.samples.length - 1];
      if (!last || t !== last.t) this.samples.push({ t, frames: f, tris: st.get('tris') ?? 0 });
      while (this.samples.length > 2 && t - this.samples[0].t > 1000) this.samples.shift();
      const a = this.samples[0], b = this.samples[this.samples.length - 1];
      if (b.t > a.t && b.frames >= a.frames) this.gameFps = (b.frames - a.frames) * 1000 / (b.t - a.t);
      else if (this.samples.length < 2) this.gameFps = 0;
    }
    this.paint(st);
  };

  private paint(st: Map<string, number> | null) {
    const game = st?.has('frames');
    const fps = game ? this.gameFps : this.pageFps;
    const big = document.createElement('div');
    big.textContent = String(Math.round(fps));
    const small = document.createElement('small'); small.textContent = game ? 'fps' : 'fps page';
    big.append(small);
    const parts: Node[] = [big];
    if (this.mode === 'detailed') {
      const dl = document.createElement('dl');
      const add = (k: string, v: string) => { const dt = document.createElement('dt'); dt.textContent = k; const dd = document.createElement('dd'); dd.textContent = v; dl.append(dt, dd); };
      if (game && this.gameFps > 0) add('frame', `${(1000 / this.gameFps).toFixed(2)} ms`);
      add('display', `${this.pageFps.toFixed(0)} Hz`);
      if (game && this.samples.length > 1) {
        const a = this.samples[0], b = this.samples[this.samples.length - 1];
        const df = b.frames - a.frames;
        if (df > 0 && b.tris >= a.tris) add('tris/frame', Math.round((b.tris - a.tris) / df).toLocaleString('en-US'));
      }

// A controller in the page's own dialogs (the menu, the controls sheet, the
// Quit question) while a game runs: the input module hands the page the
// button presses while one is open (gamepad.ts PadPage), and the game gets
// the controller at rest meanwhile.
//   D-pad or left stick  the focus to the next or previous button
//   A                    presses it
//   B, Start             closes the dialog, as Esc does (B on the menu's Crews or
//                        Friends: back to its list, as its ‹ does)

import { PAD_A, PAD_B, PAD_DDOWN, PAD_DLEFT, PAD_DRIGHT, PAD_DUP, PAD_START } from '../input/proto';

/** the open modal dialog of the page (of two, the one on top: the one later in the page, as the playlist after the
 *  menu), or null */
export function pageDialog(): HTMLDialogElement | null {
  const open = document.querySelectorAll<HTMLDialogElement>('dialog[open]:modal');
  return open[open.length - 1] ?? null;
}

/** a dialog the controller works: its focus ring shows (data-pad), until it closes */
export function markPad(d: HTMLDialogElement) {
  if (d.hasAttribute('data-pad')) return;
  d.setAttribute('data-pad', '');
  d.addEventListener('close', () => d.removeAttribute('data-pad'), { once: true });
}

const FOCUSABLE = 'button:not([disabled]), input:not([disabled]), select:not([disabled]), textarea:not([disabled]), a[href]';

export function padPress(button: number) {
  const d = pageDialog();
  if (!d) return;
  markPad(d);
  const shown = (e: HTMLElement) => e.checkVisibility?.() ?? e.offsetParent !== null;
  if (button === PAD_B || button === PAD_START) {
    // (a page of the dialog in its place, the menu's Crews or Friends: its Back, data-act="back", shell.ts menuPage)
    const back = button === PAD_B ? [...d.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-act="back"]')].find(shown) : undefined;
    if (back) back.click(); else closeLikeEsc(d);
    return;
  }
  const items = [...d.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(FOCUSABLE)].filter(shown);
  const at = items.indexOf(document.activeElement as HTMLElement);
  if (button === PAD_A) { if (at >= 0) items[at].click(); return; }
  const step = button === PAD_DUP || button === PAD_DLEFT ? -1 : button === PAD_DDOWN || button === PAD_DRIGHT ? 1 : 0;
  if (!step || !items.length) return;
  const next = items[at < 0 ? 0 : Math.max(0, Math.min(items.length - 1, at + step))];
  next.focus({ focusVisible: true } as FocusOptions);
}

/** Esc's way out: a cancel event the dialog may refuse, then the close */
function closeLikeEsc(d: HTMLDialogElement) {
  const rc = (d as { requestClose?(): void }).requestClose;
  if (typeof rc === 'function') { rc.call(d); return; }
  if (d.dispatchEvent(new Event('cancel', { cancelable: true }))) d.close();
}

// This browser's own id on the server's LAN: random, made once and kept in two of the browser's stores, localStorage
// and a file at the top of the origin private file system (beside the save folder, not in it: no backup, restore or
// cloud sync takes it), sent in the switch's hello (net/index.ts).  The operator's bans name a page by it besides its
// address and its passphrase (web/server-rs/crates/bans), so that a banned player is not back by changing networks.
// Each load puts the id back in a store that lost it (keepPageId: one of them cleared alone), and when the two held
// different ids the hello names the other one too ("was"), so that a ban of either holds.  The server counts the
// browsers that come each day by it too (seen(): web/server-rs src/app/days.rs).  It says nothing about the player,
// and the server keeps only a keyed hash of it, in a ban, and in the day's counts with a key of that day.  Without
// storage (a private window, storage blocked) each load has a new one.
import { localStore, PAGE_ID, SEEN_SETTINGS } from './prefs';

/** the file at the top of the origin private file system (shell.ts keeps the save folder off its name) */
export const PAGE_ID_FILE = 'nfsu2.page-id';

/** what the hello names: the id, and the one the other store held when it was another (net/index.ts id, was) */
export interface PageIds { id: string; was: string[] }

const valid = (s: string | null | undefined): s is string => !!s && /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{22}$/.test(s);
/** this load's id when localStorage keeps none */
let loose: string | null = null;
let kept: Promise<PageIds> | null = null;

/** The id now: localStorage's (made and kept there when it has none).  keepPageId, early in a load, may change it
 *  once, to the file's. */
export function pageId(): string {
  const have = localStore.get(PAGE_ID);
  if (valid(have)) return have;
  const id = make();
  return localStore.set(PAGE_ID, id) ? id : loose ??= id;
}

/** The id from both stores, put back in a store that lost it or held another: the file's first (the harder one to
 *  clear alone), else localStorage's, else a new one.  Once a load. */
export function keepPageId(): Promise<PageIds> {
  return kept ??= (async () => {
    let local = localStore.get(PAGE_ID);
    if (!valid(local)) local = null;
    const file = await readFile();
    const id = file ?? local ?? loose ?? make();
    if (file !== id) await writeFile(id);
    if (local !== id && !localStore.set(PAGE_ID, id)) loose = id;
    return { id, was: local && local !== id ? [local] : [] };
  })();
}

/** what a day's first Play tells the server besides: the kind of device, and the settings changed from its defaults
 *  (settings.ts changedSettings: "key=value", the player's own words only as "set") */
export interface SettingsReport { device: 'pc' | 'phone' | 'tablet'; changed: string[] }

/** This browser came today, for the server's daily counts (web/server-rs src/app/days.rs): at a load ('page') and at
 *  Play ('play').  At the first Play of a UTC day the settings go along (web/server-rs src/app/settings_days.rs keeps
 *  only the day's totals): once a day, so the server needs nothing per browser to count each one once.  A day whose
 *  request failed is not marked, and a browser without storage tells them at each Play.  Nothing comes back, and a
 *  server that does not answer changes nothing. */
export function seen(at: 'page' | 'play', settings?: SettingsReport): void {
  const day = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  const told = localStore.get(SEEN_SETTINGS);
  const report = settings && told !== day ? `&k=${settings.device}&s=${encodeURIComponent(settings.changed.join(','))}` : '';
  void keepPageId()
    .then(({ id }) => fetch(`/seen?at=${at}&id=${encodeURIComponent(id)}${report}`, { cache: 'no-store', keepalive: true }))
    .then(r => { if (report && r.ok) localStore.set(SEEN_SETTINGS, day); })
    .catch(() => {});
}

async function readFile(): Promise<string | null> {
  try {
    const f = await (await (await navigator.storage.getDirectory()).getFileHandle(PAGE_ID_FILE)).getFile();
    const s = (await f.text()).trim();
    return valid(s) ? s : null;
  } catch { return null; }
}

async function writeFile(id: string): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const h = await (await navigator.storage.getDirectory()).getFileHandle(PAGE_ID_FILE, { create: true });
    const w = await h.createWritable();
    await w.write(id); await w.close();
  } catch { /* no origin private file system here, or no room: localStorage alone */ }
}

/** 128 random bits, base64url (22 characters) */
function make(): string {
  const b = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(16));
  return btoa(String.fromCharCode(...b)).replace(/\+/g, '-').replace(/\//g, '_').replace(/=+$/, '');
}

// The graphics a phone starts with.  A new player's registry.txt is the built-in seed (app/registry-defaults.txt, the
// game's highest settings, shared with the Mac app); on a phone it has car and road reflections, motion blur, depth of
// field, overbright and bleach bypass off.  Measured on the PC over one lockstep Quick Race (2026-10-26): draws per
// frame 1,639 -> 1,118, render passes 30 -> 4, GPU time -54 %, WebGPU encoding -36 %.  Rain, fog, particles, light
// trails and world detail stay.  A phone that started before this gets them once too, if every graphics option there
// still has the seed's value; one where any was changed keeps its own.  The game's Options, Display raise them again.
// Cloud saves leave registry.txt out (vault.ts keeps), so a phone's never reaches a PC.
//
// A computer's new registry has the game's Full Scene Anti-Aliasing on (runtime/com.c MULTISAMPLING: 4 samples, about
// 1 to 1.5 ms more GPU time a frame at 2560x1440 on an M4 Pro, 2026-11-08); tablets' and phones' stay as the seed
// (off; phones are not offered it).  A computer's registry from before, which could never have it (-1), is asked about
// it once at Play (shell.ts askFsaa) and marked.

/** the game's own options (registry DWORDs) a phone starts with */
export const PHONE_GRAPHICS: Readonly<Record<string, number>> = {
  g_CarEnvironmentMapEnable: 0, g_RoadReflectionEnable: 0, g_MotionBlurEnable: 0,
  g_DepthOfFieldEnable: 0, g_OverBrightEnable: 0, g_BleachByPassEnable: 0,
};
/** a value of ours in registry.txt (the game never asks for it, and win32_ext.c keeps every line it read): this
 *  registry has had its phone graphics, or was left alone, and is not looked at again */
export const PHONE_MARK = 'PhoneGraphics';

const DWORD = /^d ([^=\r\n]+)=(\d+)(\r?)$/gm;
function dwords(text: string): Map<string, number> {
  return new Map([...text.matchAll(DWORD)].map(m => [m[1].toLowerCase(), +m[2]]));
}

/** the registry text with these DWORDs set: each line replaced where it is, or added at the end */
export function withDwords(text: string, values: Record<string, number>): string {
  const left = new Map(Object.entries(values).map(([k, v]) => [k.toLowerCase(), [k, v] as const]));
  let out = text.replace(DWORD, (line, name: string, _v: string, cr: string) => {
    const kv = left.get(name.toLowerCase());
    if (!kv) return line;
    left.delete(name.toLowerCase());
    return `d ${name}=${kv[1]}${cr}`;
  });
  const nl = text.includes('\r\n') ? '\r\n' : '\n';
  if (left.size && out && !out.endsWith('\n')) out += nl;
  for (const [k, v] of left.values()) out += `d ${k}=${v}${nl}`;
  return out;
}

/** the registry a phone starts with */
export function phoneSeed(seed: string): string {
  return withDwords(seed, { ...PHONE_GRAPHICS, [PHONE_MARK]: 1 });
}

/** the game's Full Scene Anti-Aliasing level a computer starts with: on (the option's one step) */
export const COMPUTER_GRAPHICS: Readonly<Record<string, number>> = { g_FSAALevel: 1 };

/** a value of ours in registry.txt: the start page asked this player about Full Scene Anti-Aliasing (shell.ts askFsaa) */
export const FSAA_MARK = 'FsaaAsked';
/** g_FSAALevel -1 as the game writes it: what every registry had while the browser game offered no multisampling */
const FSAA_NEVER = 4294967295;

/** a registry from before Full Scene Anti-Aliasing (still -1, never chosen) whose player was not asked yet */
export function fsaaAsk(text: string): boolean {
  const have = dwords(text);
  return !have.has(FSAA_MARK.toLowerCase()) && have.get('g_fsaalevel') === FSAA_NEVER;
}

/** the registry after the question: Full Scene Anti-Aliasing on (its one step) or left as it was, and the mark */
export function fsaaAnswer(text: string, on: boolean): string {
  return withDwords(text, on ? { ...COMPUTER_GRAPHICS, [FSAA_MARK]: 1 } : { [FSAA_MARK]: 1 });
}

/** a new player's registry on this kind of device (device.ts deviceKind) */
export function deviceSeed(kind: 'phone' | 'tablet' | 'pc', seed: string): string {
  return kind === 'phone' ? phoneSeed(seed) : kind === 'pc' ? withDwords(seed, COMPUTER_GRAPHICS) : seed;
}

/** a phone's registry from before the phone graphics: the text to write (the phone graphics when every graphics option,
 *  the seed's g_ values but the resolution, still has the seed's value; else only the mark), or null once it has the mark */
export function phoneUpgrade(text: string, seed: string): { text: string; lowered: boolean } | null {
  const have = dwords(text);
  if (have.has(PHONE_MARK.toLowerCase())) return null;
  const untouched = [...dwords(seed)].every(([k, v]) => !k.startsWith('g_') || k === 'g_racingresolution' || have.get(k) === v);
  return untouched
    ? { text: withDwords(text, { ...PHONE_GRAPHICS, [PHONE_MARK]: 1 }), lowered: true }
    : { text: withDwords(text, { [PHONE_MARK]: 1 }), lowered: false };
}

  speed: number; smooth: number; spin: number; level: boolean; invert: boolean; pathS: number;
  show: number; lights: boolean; horns: boolean; weather: number;
  shutter: number; size: number; shiftX: number; shiftY: number; lens: number;
}
const KEPT0: Kept = {
  tab: 'camera', filter: 'none', exposure: 0, vignette: 0, crop: 'full', grid: false, blur: 0, freeze: true,
  speed: 500, smooth: 0, spin: 0, level: false, invert: false, pathS: 10,
  show: SHOW_ALL, lights: true, horns: true, weather: -1,
  shutter: 0, size: 1, shiftX: 0, shiftY: 0, lens: 0,
};
/** Auto-turn within this of the slider's middle is off (its track is 1200 wide: a tenth of it) */
const SPIN_OFF = 60;
const clamp = (v: unknown, lo: number, hi: number, d: number) => { const n = Number(v); return Number.isFinite(n) ? Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, n)) : d; };
function loadKept(): Kept {
  try {
    const raw = (localStore.getJSON(PHOTO_KEPT) ?? {}) as Partial<Kept> & { cars?: number };
    const k = { ...KEPT0, ...raw } as Kept;
    if (!TABS.includes(k.tab)) k.tab = 'camera';
    if (!(k.filter in FILTERS)) k.filter = 'none';
    if (!(k.crop in CROPS)) k.crop = 'full';
    k.exposure = clamp(k.exposure, -200, 200, 0); k.vignette = clamp(k.vignette, 0, 1000, 0); k.blur = clamp(k.blur, 0, 1000, 0);
    k.speed = clamp(k.speed, 0, 1000, 500); k.smooth = clamp(k.smooth, 0, 1000, 0);
    // Auto-turn starts off at every visit, not as it was left: kept, a camera that turned by itself greeted the next
    // visit and the next reload, and players took it for a bug they could not stop (2026-11-05)
    k.spin = 0;
    k.pathS = PATH_TIMES.includes(k.pathS) ? k.pathS : 10;
    // the Cars list before the kinds' boxes: all, only mine, none, friends and crews
    if (raw.show === undefined && raw.cars !== undefined) k.show = [SHOW_ALL, SHOW_MINE, 0, SHOW_MINE | SHOW_FRIENDS | SHOW_CREWS][raw.cars] ?? SHOW_ALL;
    k.show = clamp(k.show, 0, SHOW_ALL, SHOW_ALL) & SHOW_ALL;
    k.weather = [-1, 0, 1].includes(k.weather) ? k.weather : -1;
    k.shutter = SHUTTERS.includes(k.shutter) ? k.shutter : 0; k.size = [1, 2, 3, 4].includes(k.size) ? k.size : 1;
    k.shiftX = clamp(k.shiftX, -500, 500, 0); k.shiftY = clamp(k.shiftY, -500, 500, 0); k.lens = k.lens === 1 ? 1 : 0;
    for (const b of ['grid', 'level', 'invert'] as const) k[b] = !!k[b];
    for (const b of ['freeze', 'lights', 'horns'] as const) k[b] = k[b] !== false;
    delete (k as { cars?: number }).cars;
    return k;
  } catch { return { ...KEPT0 }; }
}
/** the Speed slider (0 .. 1000) as the camera's speed: a tenth at the left, as it was in the middle, 4 times at the right */
const speedOf = (v: number) => (v < 500 ? 0.1 ** ((500 - v) / 500) : 4 ** ((v - 500) / 500));

/** the keys that steer the camera while they are held */
const HELD: Record<string, number> = {
  KeyW: HB_FWD, KeyS: HB_BACK, KeyA: HB_LEFT, KeyD: HB_RIGHT, KeyE: HB_UP, KeyQ: HB_DOWN,
  ArrowLeft: HB_TL, ArrowRight: HB_TR, ArrowUp: HB_TU, ArrowDown: HB_TD,
  KeyZ: HB_ZIN, KeyX: HB_ZOUT, KeyC: HB_RL, KeyV: HB_RR, ShiftLeft: HB_FAST, ShiftRight: HB_FAST,
};
/** the page's own keys, which stay the page's (shell.ts): the menu's, photo mode's, the next song's, the counter's (the
 *  player's: sitekeys.ts) and F11 */
const pageKey = (code: string) => code === 'F11' || menuKeyOf(code) !== null;

/** two values of -1..1 as a photo event's int16 pair */
const pack = (x: number, y: number) =>
  (Math.round(Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, x)) * 32767) & 0xffff) | (Math.round(Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, y)) * 32767) << 16);
/** a stick's value past its dead zone, from 0 there */
const dz = (v: number) => (Math.abs(v) < 0.15 ? 0 : (v - Math.sign(v) * 0.15) / 0.85);
/** a drag this near the window's edge locks the mouse (it turns on past the edge: the cursor stops there) */
const EDGE_PX = 24;

type Hint = [string, string];

/** F12 pictures carry the site's address in a corner (png-worker.ts), unless the panel's box turned it off */
export function photoMark(): boolean { return localStore.get(PHOTO_MARK) !== 'off'; }

export class PhotoMode {
  private root: HTMLElement;
  private flash: HTMLElement;
  private sl: Record<'zoom' | 'tilt' | 'speed' | 'smooth' | 'spin' | 'blur' | 'focus' | 'exposure' | 'vignette' | 'shiftX' | 'shiftY', HTMLInputElement>;
  private pk: Record<'target' | 'pathS' | 'shutter' | 'lens' | 'filter' | 'crop' | 'size' | 'weather', HTMLSelectElement>;
  private ck: Record<'level' | 'invert' | 'grid' | 'mark' | 'freeze' | 'lights' | 'names' | 'horns', HTMLInputElement>;
  private kinds: HTMLInputElement[];
  private shootBtn: HTMLButtonElement;
  private playBtn: HTMLButtonElement;
  private pathNote: HTMLElement;
  private hints: HTMLElement;
  private session: GameSession | null = null;
  private raf = 0;
  private hello = false;
  private can = false;
  private free = false;
  private namesHere = false;             // friends' names can show (free roam with them)
  private playersHere = false;           // other players' cars can be here (free roam with them)
  /** whether photo mode is on (the game's status) */
  on = false;
  private bare = false;                  // the panel hidden (H, the controller's View, a double tap)
  private keys = 0;
  private padBits = 0;
  private sent = { hold: -1, move: -1, lift: -1, turn: -1 };
  private sliding: HTMLInputElement | null = null;
  private drag: { id: number; x: number; y: number; pan: boolean; locked: boolean } | null = null;
  private fingers = new Map<number, [number, number]>();
  private pinch: { d: number; x: number; y: number } | null = null;
  private tap: { t: number; x: number; y: number; moved: boolean } | null = null;
  private lastTap = { t: 0, x: 0, y: 0 };
  private shooting = false;
  private flashTimer = 0;
  private kept = loadKept();
  private lookSent = '';
  private progress = -1;
  private path = -1;
  private target = -1;
  private pic = -1;                      // photo_pic: what the picture's options allow now (1 Size, 2 Shutter, 4 Fisheye,
                                         // 8 Lens shift; 16 a picture being taken)

  constructor(private stage: HTMLElement, private deps: {
    shoot(): Promise<void>; screenshot(): void; log(s: string): void;
  }) {
    const p = this.root = document.createElement('div');
    p.className = 'photo-panel'; p.hidden = true; p.dataset.nfsu2Ui = '';
    const slider = (cls: string, min: number, max: number, step = 1) =>
      `<label class="ph-slider"><span class="${cls}-l"></span><input type="range" class="${cls}" min="${min}" max="${max}" step="${step}"></label>`;
    const pick = (cls: string) => `<label class="ph-pick"><span class="${cls}-l"></span><select class="${cls}"></select></label>`;
    const check = (cls: string, extra = '') => `<label class="ph-check${extra}"><input type="checkbox" class="${cls}"><span class="${cls}-l"></span></label>`;
    const kinds = ['mine', 'friends', 'crews', 'players', 'traffic', 'racers'];
    p.innerHTML =
      '<b class="ph-title"></b>' +
      '<div class="ph-tabs" role="tablist">' + TABS.map(k => `<button type="button" class="ph-tab" role="tab" data-tab="${k}"></button>`).join('') + '</div>' +
      '<div class="ph-pane" data-pane="camera"><span class="ph-mode"><button type="button" data-mode="0"></button><button type="button" data-mode="1"></button></span>' +
        slider('ph-zoom', 0, 1000) + slider('ph-tilt', -450, 450, 5) + slider('ph-speed', 0, 1000, 10) + slider('ph-smooth', 0, 1000, 10) +
        slider('ph-spin', -600, 600, 10) + check('ph-level') + check('ph-invert') + pick('ph-target') +
        '<div class="ph-sec ph-path-l"></div>' +
        '<div class="ph-row3"><button type="button" data-act="point"></button><button type="button" data-act="clear"></button>' +
        '<button type="button" data-act="play"></button></div><div class="ph-note"></div>' + pick('ph-pathS') + '</div>' +
      '<div class="ph-pane" data-pane="picture">' +
        slider('ph-blur', 0, 1000) + slider('ph-focus', 0, 1000) + pick('ph-shutter') + pick('ph-lens') +
        slider('ph-shiftY', -500, 500, 5) + slider('ph-shiftX', -500, 500, 5) +
        slider('ph-exposure', -200, 200, 5) + slider('ph-vignette', 0, 1000) + pick('ph-filter') + pick('ph-crop') + pick('ph-size') +
        check('ph-grid') + check('ph-mark') + '</div>' +
      '<div class="ph-pane" data-pane="scene">' + check('ph-freeze') + '<div class="ph-sec ph-cars-l"></div><div class="ph-grid2">' +
        kinds.map(k => check(`ph-show-${k}`, k === 'friends' || k === 'crews' || k === 'players' ? ' ph-people' : '')).join('') + '</div>' +
        check('ph-lights') + check('ph-names', ' ph-names-c') + check('ph-horns') + pick('ph-weather') + '</div>' +
      '<div class="ph-pane ph-hints" data-pane="controls"></div>' +
      '<div class="ph-buttons"><button type="button" data-act="reset"></button>' +
      '<button type="button" class="ph-shoot" data-act="shoot"></button><button type="button" data-act="leave"></button></div>';
    const q = <E extends Element>(s: string) => p.querySelector<E>(s)!;
    this.sl = {
      zoom: q('.ph-zoom'), tilt: q('.ph-tilt'), speed: q('.ph-speed'), smooth: q('.ph-smooth'), spin: q('.ph-spin'),
      blur: q('.ph-blur'), focus: q('.ph-focus'), exposure: q('.ph-exposure'), vignette: q('.ph-vignette'),
      shiftX: q('.ph-shiftX'), shiftY: q('.ph-shiftY'),
    };
    this.pk = {
      target: q('.ph-target'), pathS: q('.ph-pathS'), shutter: q('.ph-shutter'), lens: q('.ph-lens'), filter: q('.ph-filter'),
      crop: q('.ph-crop'), size: q('.ph-size'), weather: q('.ph-weather'),
    };
    this.ck = {
      level: q('.ph-level'), invert: q('.ph-invert'), grid: q('.ph-grid'), mark: q('.ph-mark'), freeze: q('.ph-freeze'),
      lights: q('.ph-lights'), names: q('.ph-names'), horns: q('.ph-horns'),
    };
    this.kinds = kinds.map(k => q<HTMLInputElement>(`.ph-show-${k}`));
    this.shootBtn = q('.ph-shoot'); this.playBtn = q('[data-act="play"]'); this.pathNote = q('.ph-note'); this.hints = q('.ph-hints');
    const k = this.kept, s = this.sl, c = this.ck;
    c.mark.checked = photoMark();
    s.blur.value = String(k.blur); s.exposure.value = String(k.exposure); s.vignette.value = String(k.vignette);
    s.speed.value = String(k.speed); s.smooth.value = String(k.smooth); s.spin.value = String(k.spin);
    s.shiftX.value = String(k.shiftX); s.shiftY.value = String(k.shiftY);
    c.grid.checked = k.grid; c.freeze.checked = k.freeze; c.level.checked = k.level; c.invert.checked = k.invert;
    c.lights.checked = k.lights; c.horns.checked = k.horns;
    this.kinds.forEach((b, i) => { b.checked = (k.show & 1 << i) !== 0; });
    for (const v of Object.keys(CROPS)) this.pk.crop.add(new Option('', v));
    for (const v of Object.keys(FILTERS)) this.pk.filter.add(new Option('', v));
    for (const v of SHUTTERS) this.pk.shutter.add(new Option('', String(v)));
    for (const v of PATH_TIMES) this.pk.pathS.add(new Option('', String(v)));
    for (const v of [0, 1]) this.pk.lens.add(new Option('', String(v)));
    for (const v of [1, 2, 3, 4]) this.pk.size.add(new Option('', String(v)));
    for (const v of [-1, 0, 1]) this.pk.weather.add(new Option('', String(v)));
    this.pk.crop.value = k.crop; this.pk.filter.value = k.filter; this.pk.shutter.value = String(k.shutter);
    this.pk.pathS.value = String(k.pathS); this.pk.lens.value = String(k.lens); this.pk.size.value = String(k.size);
    this.pk.weather.value = String(k.weather);                     // (the camera's car: fill(), by where it is)
    p.addEventListener('click', e => {
      const b = (e.target as HTMLElement).closest<HTMLButtonElement>('button');
      if (!b) return;
      if (b.dataset.mode) this.send(PH_MODE, +b.dataset.mode);
      else if (b.dataset.tab) this.setTab(b.dataset.tab as Tab);
      else if (b.dataset.act === 'reset') this.reset();
      else if (b.dataset.act === 'shoot') void this.shoot();
      else if (b.dataset.act === 'leave') this.leave();
      else if (b.dataset.act === 'point') this.send(PH_PATH, PATH_ADD);
      else if (b.dataset.act === 'play') this.playPath();
      else if (b.dataset.act === 'clear') this.send(PH_PATH, PATH_CLEAR);
      back();
    });
    // the buttons leave the keyboard with the game's canvas; the sliders and lists give it back when let go
    const back = () => this.canvas()?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    p.addEventListener('pointerdown', e => { if ((e.target as HTMLElement).closest('button')) e.preventDefault(); });
    for (const x of Object.values(s)) {
      x.addEventListener('pointerdown', () => { this.sliding = x; });
      x.addEventListener('input', () => this.slid(x));
      x.addEventListener('change', () => { this.sliding = null; back(); });
    }
    // a double click puts a slider back where it starts
    const home: [HTMLInputElement, number][] = [[s.tilt, 0], [s.exposure, 0], [s.speed, 500], [s.spin, 0], [s.shiftX, 0], [s.shiftY, 0]];
    for (const [x, v] of home) x.addEventListener('dblclick', () => { x.value = String(v); this.slid(x); });
    s.focus.addEventListener('dblclick', () => this.send(PH_FOCUS, -1));          // the car again
    for (const x of Object.values(this.pk)) x.addEventListener('change', () => { this.picked(x); back(); });
    for (const x of Object.values(c)) x.addEventListener('change', () => { this.checked(x); back(); });
    for (const x of this.kinds) x.addEventListener('change', () => { this.sendShow(); back(); });
    const f = this.flash = document.createElement('div');
    f.className = 'photo-flash'; f.hidden = true;          // (hidden by a timer: with reduced motion no animation ends)
    stage.append(p, f);
    addEventListener('keydown', e => this.onKey(e as KeyboardEvent, true), { capture: true });
    addEventListener('keyup', e => this.onKey(e as KeyboardEvent, false), { capture: true });
    for (const type of ['pointerdown', 'pointermove', 'pointerup', 'pointercancel'])
      addEventListener(type, e => this.onPointer(e as PointerEvent), { capture: true });
    addEventListener('wheel', e => this.onWheel(e as WheelEvent), { capture: true, passive: false });
    addEventListener('contextmenu', e => { if (this.mine(e)) { e.preventDefault(); e.stopImmediatePropagation(); } }, { capture: true });
    // no key-up comes for a key held while the page loses the keyboard (alt-tab, another tab)
    addEventListener('blur', () => this.letGo());
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => { if (document.hidden) this.letGo(); });
    this.setTab(k.tab, false);
  }

  /** a game started: photo mode follows its status until stop() */
  start(s: GameSession) {
    this.session = s; this.hello = false;
    const tick = () => { this.update(); this.raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick); };
    this.raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }

  /** the game ended */
  stop() {
    cancelAnimationFrame(this.raf);
    this.show(false);
    this.session = null; this.can = false;
  }

  /** F12: the picture while photo mode is on; else photo mode where it can open, the screenshot where it cannot */
  f12() {
    if (this.on) void this.shoot();
    else if (this.can && this.send(PH_OPEN, 1)) this.deps.log('[app] photo mode: F12');
    else this.deps.screenshot();
  }

  /** the controller while no dialog of the page is open (gamepad.ts PadPage.capture): photo mode's while it is on */
  pad(s: PadSnapshot, pressed: number): boolean {
    if (!this.on) return false;
    const b = s.buttons, a = s.axes, on = (n: number) => (b & 1 << n) !== 0, inv = this.kept.invert ? -1 : 1;
    if (pressed & 1 << PAD_A) void this.shoot();
    if (pressed & (1 << PAD_B | 1 << PAD_START)) this.leave();
    if (pressed & 1 << PAD_Y) this.send(PH_MODE, 2);
    if (pressed & 1 << PAD_X) this.reset();
    if (pressed & 1 << PAD_RS && this.namesHere) this.send(PH_NAMES, 2);
    if (pressed & 1 << PAD_BACK) this.setBare(!this.bare);
    this.padBits = (on(PAD_DUP) ? HB_ZIN : 0) | (on(PAD_DDOWN) ? HB_ZOUT : 0) | (on(PAD_DLEFT) ? HB_RL : 0) |
      (on(PAD_DRIGHT) ? HB_RR : 0) | (on(PAD_LS) ? HB_FAST : 0);
    this.steer(pack(dz(a[PAD_AXIS_LX]), -dz(a[PAD_AXIS_LY])),
      pack((on(PAD_RB) ? 1 : 0) - (on(PAD_LB) ? 1 : 0), dz(a[PAD_AXIS_RT]) - dz(a[PAD_AXIS_LT])),
      pack(dz(a[PAD_AXIS_RX]), inv * dz(a[PAD_AXIS_RY])));
    return true;
  }

  private input() { return this.session?.input ?? null; }
  private canvas() { return this.stage.querySelector('canvas'); }
  private send(what: number, a = 0, b = 0): boolean { return !!this.input()?.photo?.(what, a, b); }
  private leave() { if (this.send(PH_OPEN, 0)) this.deps.log('[app] photo mode: leave'); }
  private keep() { localStore.setJSON(PHOTO_KEPT, this.kept); }

  /** the tab shown (kept for the next time) */
  private setTab(tab: Tab, keep = true) {
    for (const b of this.root.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-tab]')) b.setAttribute('aria-selected', String(b.dataset.tab === tab));
    for (const x of this.root.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-pane]')) x.hidden = x.dataset.pane !== tab;
    if (keep && tab !== this.kept.tab) { this.kept.tab = tab; this.keep(); }
  }

  /** the kinds of cars shown, from their boxes (the player kinds' only where there are players: else as they were) */
  private sendShow() {
    let m = 0;
    this.kinds.forEach((b, i) => { if (b.checked) m |= 1 << i; });
    this.kept.show = m; this.keep();
    this.send(PH_SHOW, m);
  }

  /** the camera's settings to the game (photo mode came on: all of them) */
  private sendCamera() {
    const k = this.kept;
    this.send(PH_SPEED, Math.round(speedOf(k.speed) * 100)); this.send(PH_SMOOTH, k.smooth);
    this.send(PH_SPIN, k.spin); this.send(PH_LEVEL, k.level ? 1 : 0);
  }
  /** Auto-turn off: the slider in its middle, the camera standing still */
  private unturn() {
    this.kept.spin = 0; this.sl.spin.value = '0';
    this.sendCamera(); this.keep();
  }
  /** Reset: the camera back behind the car, and turning by itself no more */
  private reset() { this.send(PH_RESET); this.unturn(); }
  private sendScene() {
    const k = this.kept;
    this.send(PH_FREEZE, k.freeze ? 1 : 0); this.send(PH_SHOW, k.show); this.send(PH_LIGHTS, k.lights ? 1 : 0);
    this.send(PH_HORNS, k.horns ? 1 : 0); this.send(PH_WEATHER, k.weather);
  }
  private sendPicture() {
    const k = this.kept;
    this.send(PH_BLUR, k.blur); this.send(PH_SHUTTER, k.shutter); this.send(PH_SIZE, k.size);
    this.send(PH_SHIFT, k.shiftX, k.shiftY); this.send(PH_LENS, k.lens);
  }

  /** what needs time to stand (the picture's frames add up) and what goes only with something else (the game says:
   *  photo_pic) */
  private greyed() {
    const k = this.kept, pic = this.pic < 0 ? 15 : this.pic;
    this.sl.blur.disabled = !k.freeze; this.sl.focus.disabled = !k.freeze || k.blur <= 0;
    this.pk.size.disabled = !(pic & 1); this.pk.shutter.disabled = !(pic & 2) || !k.freeze; this.pk.lens.disabled = !(pic & 4);
    this.sl.shiftX.disabled = this.sl.shiftY.disabled = !(pic & 8);
    this.ck.level.disabled = !this.free;
  }

  /** the path: plays, or stops if it plays */
  private playPath() {
    if (this.path > 0 && this.path & 16) this.send(PH_PATH, PATH_STOP);
    else this.send(PH_PATH, PATH_PLAY, this.kept.pathS * 1000);
  }

  /** a slider moved */
  private slid(x: HTMLInputElement) {
    const v = +x.value, s = this.sl, k = this.kept;
    if (x === s.zoom) this.send(PH_FOV, Math.round((FOV_MAX - (v / 1000) * (FOV_MAX - FOV_MIN)) * 100));
    else if (x === s.tilt) this.send(PH_ROLL, Math.round(v * 10));
    else if (x === s.focus) this.send(PH_FOCUS, Math.round(focusM(v) * 100));
    else {
      if (x === s.blur) { k.blur = v; this.send(PH_BLUR, v); }
      else if (x === s.exposure) k.exposure = v;
      else if (x === s.vignette) k.vignette = v;
      else if (x === s.speed) k.speed = v;
      else if (x === s.smooth) k.smooth = v;
      else if (x === s.spin) { k.spin = Math.abs(v) < SPIN_OFF ? 0 : v; if (!k.spin) x.value = '0'; }
      else if (x === s.shiftX) { k.shiftX = v; this.send(PH_SHIFT, k.shiftX, k.shiftY); }
      else if (x === s.shiftY) { k.shiftY = v; this.send(PH_SHIFT, k.shiftX, k.shiftY); }
      if (x === s.speed || x === s.smooth || x === s.spin) this.sendCamera();
      this.greyed(); this.keep();
    }
  }

  /** a list's choice */
  private picked(x: HTMLSelectElement) {
    const k = this.kept, p = this.pk, v = x.value;
    if (x === p.target) { this.send(PH_TARGET, v === 'mine' ? TARGET_MINE : TARGET_MIDDLE); this.target = -1; return; }
    if (x === p.filter) k.filter = v as Filter;
    else if (x === p.crop) k.crop = v;
    else if (x === p.pathS) k.pathS = +v;
    else if (x === p.shutter) { k.shutter = +v; this.send(PH_SHUTTER, k.shutter); }
    else if (x === p.lens) { k.lens = +v; this.send(PH_LENS, k.lens); }
    else if (x === p.size) { k.size = +v; this.send(PH_SIZE, k.size); }
    else if (x === p.weather) { k.weather = +v; this.send(PH_WEATHER, k.weather); }
    this.keep();
  }

  /** a box ticked or not */
  private checked(x: HTMLInputElement) {
    const k = this.kept, c = this.ck, on = x.checked;
    if (x === c.names) { this.send(PH_NAMES, on ? 1 : 0); return; }
    if (x === c.mark) {
      if (on) localStore.remove(PHOTO_MARK); else localStore.set(PHOTO_MARK, 'off');
      this.deps.log(`[app] photo mode: the site's address on pictures ${on ? 'on' : 'off'}`);
      return;
    }
    if (x === c.grid) k.grid = on;
    else if (x === c.level) { k.level = on; this.send(PH_LEVEL, on ? 1 : 0); }
    else if (x === c.invert) k.invert = on;
    else if (x === c.freeze) { k.freeze = on; this.send(PH_FREEZE, on ? 1 : 0); }
    else if (x === c.lights) { k.lights = on; this.send(PH_LIGHTS, on ? 1 : 0); }
    else if (x === c.horns) { k.horns = on; this.send(PH_HORNS, on ? 1 : 0); }
    this.greyed(); this.keep();
  }

  /** the picture's look and crop to the renderer, when they change */
  private sendLook() {
    const r = this.session?.renderer;
    if (!r?.photoLook) return;
    const k = this.kept, rc = r.imageRect(), f = FILTERS[k.filter];
    const look: PhotoLook = { ...f, exposure: 2 ** (k.exposure / 100), vignette: k.vignette / 1000 * 0.8,
      crop: cropRect(CROPS[k.crop], rc.w / Math.max(1, rc.h)), grid: k.grid };
    const key = JSON.stringify(look);
    if (key === this.lookSent) return;
    this.lookSent = key;
    r.photoLook(look);
  }

  /** the held keys and buttons, the left stick and shoulders, the right stick: sent when they change */
  private steer(move = this.sent.move < 0 ? 0 : this.sent.move, lift = this.sent.lift < 0 ? 0 : this.sent.lift,
                turn = this.sent.turn < 0 ? 0 : this.sent.turn) {
    const hold = this.keys | this.padBits;
    if (hold !== this.sent.hold && this.send(PH_HOLD, hold)) this.sent.hold = hold;
    if ((move !== this.sent.move || lift !== this.sent.lift) && this.send(PH_MOVE, move, lift)) { this.sent.move = move; this.sent.lift = lift; }
    if (turn !== this.sent.turn && this.send(PH_TURN, turn)) this.sent.turn = turn;
  }

  /** nothing held any more: the keys, the controller, a drag (the page lost the input, or a dialog of its took it) */
  private letGo() {
    if (!this.on) return;
    this.keys = 0; this.padBits = 0; this.endDrag(); this.fingers.clear(); this.pinch = null; this.tap = null;
    this.steer(0, 0, 0);
  }

  /** the picture: the flash once it is kept (a big one or the shutter's takes a few seconds; the button fills meanwhile) */
  private async shoot() {
    if (this.shooting || !this.on) return;
    this.shooting = true;
    try { await this.deps.shoot(); } finally { this.shooting = false; }
    const f = this.flash;
    f.hidden = true; void f.offsetWidth; f.hidden = !this.on;
    clearTimeout(this.flashTimer);
    this.flashTimer = setTimeout(() => { f.hidden = true; }, 400);
  }

  private update() {
    const s = this.session;
    if (!s) return;
    if (!this.hello && this.send(PH_HELLO)) this.hello = true;
    const st = s.status?.read();                  // null while the game writes it: the last state stands
    if (!st || !st.has('photo')) return;
    const bits = st.get('photo')!;
    this.can = (bits & 1) !== 0;
    if (((bits & 2) !== 0) !== this.on) this.show((bits & 2) !== 0);
    if (!this.on) return;
    if (pageDialog()) this.letGo();                 // the controller goes to the dialog, a key's up to it too
    const free = (bits & 4) !== 0;
    if (free !== this.free) { this.free = free; this.greyed(); }
    for (const b of this.root.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>('[data-mode]')) b.classList.toggle('on', (b.dataset.mode === '1') === this.free);
    if (((bits & 16) !== 0) !== this.namesHere || ((bits & 512) !== 0) !== this.playersHere) {
      this.namesHere = (bits & 16) !== 0; this.playersHere = (bits & 512) !== 0; this.fill();
    }
    this.ck.names.checked = (bits & 8) !== 0;
    const fov = st.get('photo_fov') ?? 70, roll = st.get('photo_roll') ?? 0, focus = st.get('photo_focus') ?? 10;
    if (this.sliding !== this.sl.zoom) this.sl.zoom.value = String(Math.round((FOV_MAX - fov) / (FOV_MAX - FOV_MIN) * 1000));
    if (this.sliding !== this.sl.tilt) this.sl.tilt.value = String(Math.round(roll * 10));
    if (this.sliding !== this.sl.focus) this.sl.focus.value = String(focusV(focus));
    const path = st.get('photo_path') ?? 0, target = st.get('photo_target') ?? 0, pic = st.get('photo_pic') ?? -1;
    if (pic !== this.pic) { this.pic = pic; this.greyed(); }
    if (path !== this.path) { this.path = path; this.fillPath(); }
    if (target !== this.target) { this.target = target; this.fillTarget(); }
    this.sendLook();
    // the picture's frames so far: the Take photo button fills as they come
    const pr = s.renderer?.photoProgress?.(), p = pr && pr.target > 0 ? Math.min(1, pr.n / pr.target) : 0;
    if (p !== this.progress) { this.progress = p; this.shootBtn.style.setProperty('--ph-p', String(p)); }
  }

  /** photo mode came on or went off in the game */
  private show(on: boolean) {
    if (on === this.on) return;
    this.on = on;
    this.keys = 0; this.padBits = 0; this.endDrag(); this.fingers.clear(); this.pinch = null; this.tap = null; this.sliding = null;
    this.sent = { hold: -1, move: -1, lift: -1, turn: -1 };
    this.stage.classList.toggle('photo', on);
    if (on) {
      this.input()?.releaseAll?.();                 // what the game held when the page took the keys goes up
      this.steer(0, 0, 0);
      this.kept.spin = 0; this.sl.spin.value = '0';
      this.sendCamera(); this.sendScene(); this.sendPicture();
      this.path = -1; this.target = -1; this.pic = -1;
      this.greyed();
      this.lookSent = ''; this.sendLook();
      this.fill();
      this.setBare(false);
      const k = this.kept;
      this.deps.log(`[app] photo mode: on (blur ${k.blur / 10} %, ${k.filter}, crop ${k.crop}, cars ${k.show}, speed ${speedOf(k.speed).toFixed(2)}, ` +
        `smoothing ${k.smooth / 10} %, turn ${k.spin / 10}, weather ${k.weather}, size ${k.size}, shutter ${k.shutter})`);
    } else {
      this.root.hidden = true; this.flash.hidden = true;
      this.deps.log('[app] photo mode: off');
    }
  }

  private setBare(bare: boolean) {
    this.bare = bare;
    this.root.hidden = !this.on || bare;
    if (!this.root.hidden) this.fitTabs();
  }

  /** the tabs on one line, smaller where the language's words do not fit, else in two rows (as tabs.ts does) */
  private fitTabs() {
    const l = this.root.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.ph-tabs')!;
    for (const fit of ['', 'small', 'rows']) {
      if (fit) l.dataset.fit = fit; else delete l.dataset.fit;
      if (fit === 'rows' || l.scrollWidth <= l.clientWidth) break;
    }
  }

  /** the path's points and its Play button */
  private fillPath() {
    const n = Math.max(0, this.path) & 15, playing = this.path > 0 && (this.path & 16) !== 0;
    this.pathNote.textContent = n ? tn(n, '{n} point', '{n} points') : t('Add two points or more');
    this.playBtn.textContent = playing ? t('Stop') : t('Play path');
    this.playBtn.disabled = !playing && n < 2;
    (this.root.querySelector('[data-act="point"]') as HTMLButtonElement).disabled = playing || n >= 8;
    (this.root.querySelector('[data-act="clear"]') as HTMLButtonElement).disabled = !n;
  }

  /** the car the camera is on: the list shows its kind, and offers the player's and the car in the middle */
  private fillTarget() {
    const kind = [t('Your car'), t("A friend's car"), t("A crew-mate's car"), t("A player's car"), t('A traffic car'), t("A racer's car")];
    const k = Math.max(0, this.target), o = (v: string, s: string) => new Option(s, v);

    this.pk.target.value = k ? 'on' : 'mine';
  }

      ['[data-tab="scene"]', N('Scene')], ['[data-tab="controls"]', N('Controls')],

  // ---- the keyboard, the mouse and the touch screen while photo mode is on ---------------------------------------
  private onKey(e: KeyboardEvent, down: boolean) {
    const bit = HELD[e.code];
    if (!down && bit && this.keys & bit) { this.keys &= ~bit; this.steer(); }   // let go wherever it went (a dialog, Ctrl)
    if (!this.on || pageKey(e.code) || pageDialog()) return;
    e.stopImmediatePropagation();                   // the game gets none of them
    if (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) return;             // the browser's shortcuts stay the browser's
    e.preventDefault();
    if (bit) { if (down) { this.keys |= bit; this.steer(); } return; }
    if (!down || e.repeat) return;
    if (e.code === 'Escape') this.leave();
    else if (e.code === 'Enter' || e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'NumpadEnter') void this.shoot();
    else if (e.code === 'Tab') this.send(PH_MODE, 2);
    else if (e.code === 'KeyR') this.reset();
    else if (e.code === 'KeyF') this.send(PH_TARGET, TARGET_MIDDLE);
    else if (e.code === 'KeyK') this.send(PH_PATH, PATH_ADD);
    else if (e.code === 'KeyP') this.playPath();
    else if (e.code === 'KeyN' && this.namesHere) this.send(PH_NAMES, 2);
    else if (e.code === 'KeyH') this.setBare(!this.bare);
  }

  /** an event on the game's picture (not on the panel or another control of the page's) while photo mode is on */
  private mine(e: Event): boolean {
    const el = e.target as HTMLElement | null;
    return this.on && !!el && this.stage.contains(el) && !el.closest('[data-nfsu2-ui]') && !pageDialog();
  }

  /** a mouse drag turns the camera (the left button) or moves it (another); near the window's edge it locks the mouse,
   *  so that it turns on past the edge, where the cursor would stop (the browser may say how to get the cursor back) */
  private onPointer(e: PointerEvent) {
    if (e.type === 'pointerdown' ? !this.mine(e) : !this.on || !(this.drag?.id === e.pointerId || this.fingers.has(e.pointerId))) return;
    e.stopImmediatePropagation(); e.preventDefault();
    const h = Math.max(1, this.session?.viewRect().h ?? 1);
    if (e.pointerType === 'touch') { this.onFinger(e, h); return; }
    if (e.type === 'pointerdown') {
      if (this.drag) return;
      this.drag = { id: e.pointerId, x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY, pan: e.button !== 0, locked: false };
      try { (e.target as Element).setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch { /* a synthetic pointer */ }
    } else if (e.type === 'pointermove' && this.drag) {
      // the cursor's move (locked: the mouse's own, the cursor standing still)
      const locked = !!document.pointerLockElement, mx = locked ? e.movementX : e.clientX - this.drag.x, my = locked ? e.movementY : e.clientY - this.drag.y;
      this.drag.x = e.clientX; this.drag.y = e.clientY;
      const inv = this.drag.pan || !this.kept.invert ? 1 : -1;
      const dx = Math.round(mx / h * 10000), dy = Math.round(inv * my / h * 10000);
      if (dx || dy) this.send(this.drag.pan ? PH_PAN : PH_DRAG, dx, dy);
      const c = this.canvas();
      if (!this.drag.locked && c && (e.clientX < EDGE_PX || e.clientY < EDGE_PX || e.clientX > innerWidth - EDGE_PX || e.clientY > innerHeight - EDGE_PX)) {
        this.drag.locked = true;
        try { void Promise.resolve(c.requestPointerLock()).catch(() => { /* refused: the drag goes on to the edge */ }); } catch { /* none */ }
      }
    } else if (e.type === 'pointerup' || e.type === 'pointercancel') this.endDrag();
  }
  private endDrag() {
    if (this.drag?.locked && document.pointerLockElement) document.exitPointerLock();
    this.drag = null;
  }

  /** one finger turns the camera; two move it (their middle) and bring it closer or farther (their spread); a double
   *  tap hides the panel or shows it again */
  private onFinger(e: PointerEvent, h: number) {
    if (e.type === 'pointerdown') {
      this.fingers.set(e.pointerId, [e.clientX, e.clientY]);
      this.tap = this.fingers.size === 1 ? { t: e.timeStamp, x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY, moved: false } : null;
    } else if (e.type === 'pointerup' || e.type === 'pointercancel') {
      this.fingers.delete(e.pointerId);
      const tp = this.tap;
      if (e.type === 'pointerup' && tp && !tp.moved && e.timeStamp - tp.t < 250) {
        const l = this.lastTap;
        if (e.timeStamp - l.t < 350 && Math.hypot(e.clientX - l.x, e.clientY - l.y) < 40) { this.setBare(!this.bare); this.lastTap.t = 0; }
        else this.lastTap = { t: e.timeStamp, x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY };
      }
      this.tap = null;
    }
    const was = this.fingers.get(e.pointerId);
    if (e.type === 'pointermove' && was) {
      if (this.tap && Math.hypot(e.clientX - this.tap.x, e.clientY - this.tap.y) > 8) this.tap.moved = true;
      if (this.fingers.size === 1) {
        const inv = this.kept.invert ? -1 : 1;
        const dx = Math.round((e.clientX - was[0]) / h * 10000), dy = Math.round(inv * (e.clientY - was[1]) / h * 10000);
        if (dx || dy) this.send(PH_DRAG, dx, dy);
      }
      this.fingers.set(e.pointerId, [e.clientX, e.clientY]);
    }
    const two = [...this.fingers.values()].slice(0, 2);
    if (two.length < 2) { this.pinch = null; return; }
    const d = Math.hypot(two[0][0] - two[1][0], two[0][1] - two[1][1]), mx = (two[0][0] + two[1][0]) / 2, my = (two[0][1] + two[1][1]) / 2;
    const p = this.pinch;
    this.pinch = { d, x: mx, y: my };
    if (!p || e.type !== 'pointermove') return;
    const dx = Math.round((mx - p.x) / h * 10000), dy = Math.round((my - p.y) / h * 10000);
    if (dx || dy) this.send(PH_PAN, dx, dy);
    if (p.d > 8 && d > 8) {
      const notches = Math.log(d / p.d) / 0.12;      // runtime/photo.c: the distance times e^(-0.12) a notch
      if (Math.abs(notches) > 0.001) this.send(PH_DOLLY, Math.round(notches * 1000));
    }
  }

  private onWheel(e: WheelEvent) {
    if (!this.mine(e)) return;
    e.stopImmediatePropagation(); e.preventDefault();
    const lines = e.deltaMode === 1 ? e.deltaY : e.deltaMode === 2 ? e.deltaY * 3 : e.deltaY / 100;
    if (lines) this.send(PH_DOLLY, Math.round(-lines * 1000));
  }
}

// Photo mode's panel (photo.ts), the parts without the page: the focus slider's scale, the filters' looks, the
// crops and the part of the picture each keeps.  (web/test/photolook.test.mjs)
import type { PhotoLook } from '../gpu/photo-picture';

/** the focus slider (0 .. 1000): FOCUS_MIN m to FOCUS_MAX m, evenly in their ratio */
export const FOCUS_MIN = 0.5, FOCUS_MAX = 500;
export const focusM = (v: number) => FOCUS_MIN * (FOCUS_MAX / FOCUS_MIN) ** (v / 1000);
export const focusV = (m: number) =>
  Math.round(Math.log(Math.max(FOCUS_MIN, Math.min(FOCUS_MAX, m)) / FOCUS_MIN) / Math.log(FOCUS_MAX / FOCUS_MIN) * 1000);

/** the filters: their look over the picture */
export type Filter = 'none' | 'bw' | 'warm' | 'cool' | 'vivid' | 'faded';
export const FILTERS: Record<Filter, Pick<PhotoLook, 'contrast' | 'saturation' | 'tint' | 'fade'>> = {
  none: { contrast: 1, saturation: 1, tint: [1, 1, 1], fade: 0 },
  bw: { contrast: 1.12, saturation: 0, tint: [1, 1, 1], fade: 0 },
  warm: { contrast: 1.04, saturation: 1.08, tint: [1.08, 1, 0.86], fade: 0 },
  cool: { contrast: 1.04, saturation: 0.95, tint: [0.88, 0.98, 1.1], fade: 0 },
  vivid: { contrast: 1.12, saturation: 1.4, tint: [1, 1, 1], fade: 0 },
  faded: { contrast: 0.88, saturation: 0.7, tint: [1.02, 1, 0.96], fade: 0.07 },
};
/** the crops: width over height (0: the whole picture) */
export const CROPS: Record<string, number> = { full: 0, '16:9': 16 / 9, '21:9': 21 / 9, '3:2': 3 / 2, '4:3': 4 / 3, '1:1': 1, '4:5': 4 / 5, '9:16': 9 / 16 };
/** the part of a picture w / h wide that a crop of width over height r keeps, the middle of it: left, top, right, bottom */
export function cropRect(r: number, aspect: number): [number, number, number, number] {
  if (!(r > 0) || !(aspect > 0) || Math.abs(r - aspect) < 1e-3) return [0, 0, 1, 1];
  if (r > aspect) { const h = aspect / r; return [0, (1 - h) / 2, 1, (1 + h) / 2]; }
  const w = r / aspect;
  return [(1 - w) / 2, 0, (1 + w) / 2, 1];
}

// quick_chat_groups; the start page's Your phrases row).  A phrase on the wire is its number here, its place in

import { N } from './i18n';

/** the library's categories: also the names a group can take (each translated) */
export const CATS = [
  { id: 'hi', name: N('Hi') },
  { id: 'reply', name: N('Reply') },
  { id: 'thanks', name: N('Thanks') },
  { id: 'nice', name: N('Nice') },
  { id: 'drive', name: N('Drive') },

/** the countdown's number */
export const COUNTDOWN = 152;

/** the slots: four groups of four */
export const SLOTS = 16;
/** the default: the first sixteen, in the groups they always had, but the countdown in the last place (One more?'s) */
export const DEFAULT_PHRASES: readonly number[] = [...Array.from({ length: SLOTS - 1 }, (_, i) => i), COUNTDOWN];
export const DEFAULT_GROUPS: readonly CatId[] = ['hi', 'reply', 'drive', 'race'];

const CAT_IDS = new Set<string>(CATS.map(c => c.id));
const nums = (v: string) => v.split(/[, \t]+/).filter(Boolean);

/** a quick_chat_phrases value: sixteen phrase numbers, separated by commas */
export function phrasesOk(v: string): boolean {
  const n = nums(v);
  return n.length === SLOTS && n.every(x => /^\d{1,3}$/.test(x) && +x < PHRASES.length);
}
/** a quick_chat_groups value: four category names, separated by commas */
export function groupsOk(v: string): boolean {
  const n = nums(v.toLowerCase());
  return n.length === 4 && n.every(x => CAT_IDS.has(x));
}
/** the player's sixteen (settings.ini's value; missing or refused: the default) */
export function phrasesOf(v: string | undefined): number[] {
  return v && phrasesOk(v) ? nums(v).map(Number) : [...DEFAULT_PHRASES];
}
export function groupsOf(v: string | undefined): CatId[] {
  return v && groupsOk(v) ? nums(v.toLowerCase()) as CatId[] : [...DEFAULT_GROUPS];
}
export function catName(id: string): string { return CATS.find(c => c.id === id)?.name ?? id; }

/** The license plate on the player's car (settings.ini license_plate, Settings, Online; the game takes it at Play):
 *  up to 8 capitals and digits, '' the game's own plate (runtime/plates.c).  Other players in free roam see it; one
 *  that reads as a slur is refused here, and blanked by every game and the server that see it. */
export const PLATE_MAX = 8;
/** small letters as capitals, the rest as it is (settings.ts refuses what is still not a plate) */
export const plateUpper = (s: string) => s.trim().replace(/[a-z]/g, c => c.toUpperCase());
/** capitals and digits, at most PLATE_MAX ('' too: the game's own) */
export const plateValid = (s: string) => /^[A-Z0-9]{0,8}$/.test(s);
/** a text box for a plate: at most PLATE_MAX characters, capitals on a phone's keyboard, small letters typed shown
 *  as capitals (the caret where it was), no spelling or autofill */
export function plateInput(input: HTMLInputElement) {
  input.maxLength = PLATE_MAX;
  input.autocapitalize = 'characters';
  input.autocomplete = 'off';
  input.spellcheck = false;
  input.addEventListener('input', () => {
    const up = input.value.replace(/[a-z]/g, c => c.toUpperCase());
    if (up === input.value) return;
    const at = input.selectionStart, end = input.selectionEnd;
    input.value = up;
    if (at !== null && end !== null) input.setSelectionRange(at, end);
  });
}

// How many play on this server now, for the start page's Playing now panel: the server's /players (three
// counts, whether it is full, how many wait in line for a place and whether free roam is busy, nothing else; how many are
// in free roam in each world too (worlds.ts), and with crews how many in each).  Asked every 15 s, and only while the start page is visible and no game runs; a
// server without the route shows no panel.  Whether the server answered at all goes to reached() (offline mode).

/** roam: driving in free roam or paused there (null, or missing from an older server: not shown);
 *  roamBusy: free roam gives fewer cars a player now (the server's hub cut its links; until 2026-11-05 the first Play
 *  did not ask about free roam then);
 *  room: of roam, those in the room asked for (/players?room=: pages of before the worlds);
 *  rooms: of roam, those in each world asked for, in the order asked (/players?rooms=, missing from an older server);
 *  crews: of roam, those in each crew asked for, in the order asked (/players?crews=, the same) */
export interface PlayerCounts {
  players: number; online: number | null; roam?: number | null; full?: boolean; roamBusy?: boolean; room?: number; rooms?: number[]; crews?: number[];
  /** a world's race tracks' spots, each its own room (the page menu's Tracks; missing from an older server) */
  spots?: number[];
  /** pages waiting in line for a place (missing from an older server) */
  queue?: number;
}

import { count, live, onLanguage, t, tn, type Msg } from './i18n';

const EVERY_MS = 15_000;

/** One character of a Room's or a crew's name as its hash takes it, as roam_core.c room_fold does (the two must agree
 *  on every character: web/test/players.test.mjs and tests/roam_unit.c check the same sum): 0 for a blank or an
 *  invisible one, capitals small in Latin, Greek and Cyrillic, Turkish i as i, final sigma as sigma, full-width ASCII
 *  as ASCII; any other character is itself. */
export function roomFold(c: number): number {
  if (c === 0x20 || (c >= 0x09 && c <= 0x0d) || c === 0xa0 || c === 0xad || c === 0x1680 || (c >= 0x2000 && c <= 0x200d) ||
      c === 0x2028 || c === 0x2029 || c === 0x202f || c === 0x205f || c === 0x2060 || c === 0x3000 || c === 0xfeff) return 0;
  if (c >= 0xff01 && c <= 0xff5e) c -= 0xfee0;
  if (c >= 0x41 && c <= 0x5a) return c + 32;
  if (c < 0xc0) return c;
  if (c <= 0xde) return c === 0xd7 ? c : c + 32;
  if (c >= 0x100 && c <= 0x17f) {
    if (c === 0x130 || c === 0x131) return 0x69;
    if (c === 0x178) return 0xff;
    if (c <= 0x137 || (c >= 0x14a && c <= 0x177)) return c | 1;
    if ((c >= 0x139 && c <= 0x148) || (c >= 0x179 && c <= 0x17e)) return c & 1 ? c + 1 : c;
    return c;
  }
  if (c >= 0x218 && c <= 0x21f) return c | 1;
  if (c >= 0x391 && c <= 0x3ab) return c === 0x3a2 ? c : c + 32;
  if (c === 0x386) return 0x3ac;
  if (c >= 0x388 && c <= 0x38a) return c + 37;
  if (c === 0x38c) return 0x3cc;
  if (c === 0x38e || c === 0x38f) return c + 63;
  if (c === 0x3c2) return 0x3c3;
  if (c >= 0x400 && c <= 0x40f) return c + 80;
  if (c >= 0x410 && c <= 0x42f) return c + 32;
  if ((c >= 0x460 && c <= 0x481) || (c >= 0x48a && c <= 0x4bf) || (c >= 0x4d0 && c <= 0x52f)) return c | 1;
  if (c === 0x4c0) return 0x4cf;
  if (c >= 0x4c1 && c <= 0x4ce) return c & 1 ? c + 1 : c;
  return c;
}

/** A Room's or a crew's name as the game is given it: in Unicode's composed form (NFC), so an "é" typed as e and an
 *  accent is the "é" of a keyboard */
export const roomText = (name: string) => name.normalize('NFC');

const utf8 = new TextEncoder();
/** The Room setting's hash, as roam_core.c rc_room_hash makes it of roomText(name) (FNV-1a of its UTF-8 with each
 *  character as roomFold has it: "Blue Room" is "blueroom"; 0: no room), for /players?room= (a crew is the hash of its
 *  name too) */
export function roomHash(name: string): number {
  let h = 0x811c9dc5, kept = 0;
  for (const ch of roomText(name)) {
    const c = roomFold(ch.codePointAt(0)!);
    if (!c) continue;
    for (const b of utf8.encode(String.fromCodePoint(c))) h = Math.imul(h ^ b, 0x01000193) >>> 0;
    kept++;
  }
  return !kept ? 0 : h || 1;
}

const known = (k: number | null | undefined): k is number => Number.isInteger(k) && k! >= 0;

/** a count as the page writes it in its language (7,592; 7.592; 7 592), '–' for one the server does not give */
export const countText = (k: number | null | undefined): string => known(k) ? count(k) : '–';

/** The line under the numbers while the server is full ('' while it is not): how many wait in line, and what Play does. */
export function fullLine(c: PlayerCounts): string {
  if (c.full !== true) return '';
  const waiting = Number.isInteger(c.queue) && c.queue! > 0 ? c.queue! : 0;
  return waiting ? tn(waiting, 'The server is full, with {n} in line. At Play you can wait in line (playing alone until your turn) or play offline.',
    'The server is full, with {n} in line. At Play you can wait in line (playing alone until your turn) or play offline.')
    : t('The server is full: multiplayer starts when a place frees up.');
}

/** The start page's Playing now panel (index.html #players): everyone on the server, those in free roam and those in
 *  the game's Online mode (its lobbies and races), '–' until the server says; under them the server full, or why it
 *  does not answer.  The numbers drawn again in the page's language when that changes (its digit grouping). */
export class PlayersPanel {
  private last: PlayerCounts | null = null;
  constructor(private root: HTMLElement) {
    onLanguage(() => this.draw());
    // (a line may break after the slash: races/ lobbies, not races/lob-bies)
    live(root.querySelector('#players-online-label')!, () => t('in races/lobbies').replace(/\//g, '/\u200b'));
  }

  /** the server's answer; null: a server without the route (no panel) */
  show(c: PlayerCounts | null) {
    this.root.hidden = !c;
    this.last = c;
    this.draw();
    this.note(c ? () => fullLine(c) : () => '');
  }

  /** the server does not answer: the numbers unknown, the line says why */
  offline(why: Msg) {
    this.root.hidden = false;
    this.last = null;
    this.draw();
    this.note(why);
  }

  private draw() {
    const c = this.last, n = (id: string, k: number | null | undefined) => { this.root.querySelector(id)!.textContent = countText(k); };
    n('#players-all', c && Number.isInteger(c.players) ? c.players : null);
    n('#players-roam', c?.roam);
    n('#players-online', c?.online);
  }

  private note(f: Msg) {
    const p = this.root.querySelector<HTMLElement>('#players-note')!;
    live(p, f); p.hidden = !p.textContent;
  }
}

/** 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th, ..., 11th, 12th, 13th, ..., 21st */
function ordinal(k: number): string {
  const t = k % 100, u = k % 10;
  return `${k}${t >= 11 && t <= 13 ? 'th' : u === 1 ? 'st' : u === 2 ? 'nd' : u === 3 ? 'rd' : 'th'}`;
}

/** The line over the game while it waits in line for a place on a full server (net's NetQueue): where it is, and
 *  about how long that is (once the server can tell). */
export function queueText(q: { pos: number; of: number; eta?: number }): string {
  const e = q.eta;
  const wait = e === undefined ? '' : e < 60 ? t('less than a minute') : e < 90 * 60 ? t('about {n} min', { n: Math.round(e / 60) }) : t('about {n} h', { n: Math.round(e / 3600) });
  const v = { pos: ordinal(q.pos), n: q.pos, of: q.of, wait };
  if (q.pos <= 1) return wait ? t('The server is full. In line for a place: next ({wait}).', v) : t('The server is full. In line for a place: next.');
  return wait ? t('The server is full. In line for a place: {pos} of {of} ({wait}).', v) : t('The server is full. In line for a place: {pos} of {of}.', v);
}

/** How the server answered: 'ok' (any answer but a 5xx); 'down': a 5xx, from the proxy in front of a server that is
 *  stopped or restarting; 'unreachable': no answer at all (the way there is blocked, or it took too long);
 *  'no-network': no answer, and the browser says this device has no network. */
export type Reach = 'ok' | 'down' | 'unreachable' | 'no-network';
const reachOf = (status: number): Reach => status < 500 ? 'ok' : 'down';
const missed = (): Reach => navigator.onLine === false ? 'no-network' : 'unreachable';

/** Whether the server answers (Reach), within ms. */
export async function serverAnswers(ms: number): Promise<Reach> {
  try { return reachOf((await fetch('/players', { method: 'HEAD', cache: 'no-store', signal: AbortSignal.timeout(ms) })).status); }
  catch { return missed(); }
}

/** How many are in free roam in each crew asked for (their hashes, in the order asked), by hash; none from an older
 *  server (no crews in its answer) or for a count it does not give. */
export function crewCounts(c: PlayerCounts, asked: readonly number[]): Map<number, number> {
  return byHash(c.crews, asked);
}
/** How many are in free roam in each world asked for (their rooms' hashes, 0 the main world, in the order asked), by
 *  hash; as crewCounts */
export function worldCounts(c: PlayerCounts, asked: readonly number[]): Map<number, number> {
  return byHash(c.rooms, asked);
}
function byHash(counts: number[] | undefined, asked: readonly number[]): Map<number, number> {
  const m = new Map<number, number>();
  if (Array.isArray(counts)) asked.forEach((h, i) => { const n = counts[i]; if (Number.isInteger(n) && n >= 0) m.set(h, n); });
  return m;
}

/** How many are in free roam in each of these worlds now (worldCounts; their hashes: worlds.ts worldRooms), asked once
 *  as askCrews asks: the page menu's World.  null: no answer within ms. */
export async function askWorlds(rooms: readonly number[], ms: number): Promise<Map<number, number> | null> {
  try {
    const r = await fetch(`/players?rooms=${rooms.join(',')}`, { cache: 'no-store', signal: AbortSignal.timeout(ms) });
    return r.ok ? worldCounts(await r.json() as PlayerCounts, rooms) : null;
  } catch { return null; }
}

/** How many are at each of these race tracks' spots now (their rooms: tracks.ts trackRooms), by room, asked once as
 *  askWorlds asks: the page menu's Tracks.  A server of before this has no `spots` (and counted a world without its
 *  tracks): its `rooms`, then, 8 at a time.  null: no answer within ms. */
export async function askSpots(rooms: readonly number[], ms: number): Promise<Map<number, number> | null> {
  try {
    const r = await fetch(`/players?spots=${rooms.join(',')}`, { cache: 'no-store', signal: AbortSignal.timeout(ms) });
    if (!r.ok) return null;
    const c = await r.json() as PlayerCounts;
    if (Array.isArray(c.spots)) return byHash(c.spots, rooms);
  } catch { return null; }
  const parts = await Promise.all([askWorlds(rooms.slice(0, 8), ms), askWorlds(rooms.slice(8), ms)]);
  return parts[0] ? new Map([...parts[0], ...(parts[1] ?? [])]) : null;
}

/** How many are in free roam in each of these crews now (crewCounts), asked once, whatever the page does, and
 *  without watchPlayers' line or its say on whether the server answers: the page menu's Crews while a game runs.  The
 *  player counts there too, once its game is in free roam in that crew (the server's hub heard its HELLO).  null: no
 *  answer within ms. */
export async function askCrews(hashes: readonly number[], ms: number): Promise<Map<number, number> | null> {
  const mine = hashes.slice(0, 4);
  if (!mine.length) return new Map();
  try {
    const r = await fetch(`/players?crews=${mine.join(',')}`, { cache: 'no-store', signal: AbortSignal.timeout(ms) });
    return r.ok ? crewCounts(await r.json() as PlayerCounts, mine) : null;
  } catch { return null; }
}

/** show(counts, worlds, crews) at once and every 15 s while idle() and the page is visible (counts: null from a server
 *  without the route; worlds: worldCounts; crews: crewCounts); reached(whether the server answered: Reach); rooms():
 *  the worlds to count (worlds.ts worldRooms of the Room setting); crews(): the Crews setting's
 *  hashes ([] for none, at most 4); last(): the newest answer (null before the first, or from a server without
 *  the route); fresh(ms): asked now, whatever the page does (Play: whether the server is full), within ms, then the
 *  newest answer.  An answer that comes after a later question's is not shown: it was asked with the settings of
 *  before (the page's first question goes before settings.ini is read, the next one at once after it). */
export function watchPlayers(show: (c: PlayerCounts | null, worlds: Map<number, number>, crews: Map<number, number>) => void, idle: () => boolean,
                             reached?: (r: Reach) => void, rooms: () => number[] = () => [], crews: () => number[] = () => []) {
  let gone = false, last: PlayerCounts | null = null, asked = 0;
  // quiet: a miss is not passed on (fresh: Play's short question, whose timeout says nothing about the server)
  const get = async (ms: number, quiet = false) => {
    if (gone) return;
    const n = ++asked;
    try {
      const worlds = rooms(), mine = crews().slice(0, 4);
      const q = [worlds.length ? `rooms=${worlds.join(',')}` : '', mine.length ? `crews=${mine.join(',')}` : ''].filter(Boolean).join('&');
      const r = await fetch(q ? `/players?${q}` : '/players', { cache: 'no-store', signal: AbortSignal.timeout(ms) });
      if (!quiet || r.status < 500) reached?.(reachOf(r.status));
      if (r.status === 404) { gone = true; last = null; show(null, new Map(), new Map()); return; }
      if (!r.ok) return;
      const c = await r.json() as PlayerCounts;
      if (n !== asked) return;
      last = c; show(c, worldCounts(c, worlds), crewCounts(c, mine));
    } catch { if (!quiet) reached?.(missed()); }
  };
  const ask = async () => { if (document.visibilityState === 'visible' && idle()) await get(5000); };
  window.setInterval(() => void ask(), EVERY_MS);
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => void ask());
  void ask();

// After two hours of play, a text message of ours on the game's phone (runtime/sms.c): "Enjoying the game?", with the
// Discord, crews and Ko-fi; once.  After a hundred hours a second one, "100 hours!", a thank-you (2026-11-05), in a
// later game than the first.  Play counts while a game runs, the tab is in sight and the player gave some input
// in the last few minutes (input/index.ts lastInput), over all the games in this browser (localStorage).  From two
// hours on, each game asks the game for the message (IEV_SMS) until its status "sms" says the inbox has it: the game
// waits for career free roam, the only place with a phone, and a profile that has it already counts.  The count goes
// on after the message: Play's cloud saves question says how long was played here (playedMs, shell.ts askCloud;
// before 2026-10-31 it stopped at the message, near two hours).  The games started here are counted too (since
// 2026-11-03): with the play, Play's question asks once more (vault-ui.ts offerable).  Without storage (a private
// window) each load counts from 0.
// The start page shows the count (2026-11-05, players asked): the whole in the Saves tab, the latest game's under
// Play (lastGameMs, kept as the game goes, so a page Safari stops keeps it too).  The whole is short where the count
// began before the page showed it: it began only on 2026-10-26 and stopped near two hours until 2026-10-31, so there
// the page says "at least" (playedAtLeast; the browser's first page with this code decides, once).
import type { GameSession } from './game';
import { t } from './i18n';
import { localStore, PLAY_FROM, PLAY_GAMES, PLAY_LAST, PLAY_MS, PLAY_SMS } from './prefs';

export const SMS_AFTER_MS = 2 * 3600_000;
/** the second message's play, as a multiple of the first's (a test page's playtime= scales both) */
const HUNDRED_TIMES = 50;
const HELLO = 1, HUNDRED = 2;           /* sms.c: "Enjoying the game?", "100 hours!" */
const IDLE_MS = 5 * 60_000, TICK_MS = 5000;

/** the play counted in this browser so far, in ms (0 without storage) */
export const playedMs = () => Math.max(0, Number(localStore.get(PLAY_MS)) || 0);
/** the games started in this browser so far (counted since 2026-11-03; 0 without storage) */
export const gamesStarted = () => Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(localStore.get(PLAY_GAMES)) || 0));
/** the play counted in the latest game in this browser, in ms (0 before a game with this code, or without storage) */
export const lastGameMs = () => Math.max(0, Number(localStore.get(PLAY_LAST)) || 0);
/** whether the count here began before the page showed it, so it may miss play (see the top): decided at the first
 *  call in this browser, by whether there was a count then, and kept */
export function playedAtLeast(): boolean {
  const from = localStore.get(PLAY_FROM);
  if (from === 'old' || from === 'new') return from === 'old';
  const old = playedMs() > 0;
  localStore.set(PLAY_FROM, old ? 'old' : 'new');
  return old;
}
/** a count as the page shows it: "45 min", "3 h 20 min"; '' under a minute */
export function playedText(ms: number): string {
  const m = Math.floor(ms / 60_000);
  if (!m) return '';
  return m < 60 ? t('{n} min', { n: m }) : t('{h} h {m} min', { h: Math.floor(m / 60), m: m % 60 });
}

export class PlayTime {
  private timer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;
  private played = playedMs();
  /** this game's */
  private game = 0;
  private last = performance.now();
  /** the message asked for in this game, 0: none */
  private asked = 0;
  /** the last message in the game's inbox (PLAY_SMS: 1 before 2026-11-05 too): after the last, only the count goes on */
  private sent = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(localStore.get(PLAY_SMS)) || 0));
  /** the second message only in a game after the first's (not both at once) */
  private readonly sentBefore = this.sent;

  /** a game started (counted); afterMs: the play before the first message (SMS_AFTER_MS; a test page's address may
   *  give less), the second's HUNDRED_TIMES that */
  constructor(private s: GameSession, private afterMs: number, private log: (line: string) => void) {
    playedAtLeast();                      // (decided before this game counts)
    localStore.set(PLAY_GAMES, String(gamesStarted() + 1));
    localStore.set(PLAY_LAST, '0');
    this.timer = setInterval(() => this.tick(), TICK_MS);
  }

  private tick() {
    const now = performance.now(), dt = Math.min(now - this.last, 2 * TICK_MS), input = this.s.input?.lastInput?.() ?? null;
    this.last = now;
    if (!document.hidden && input !== null && now - input < IDLE_MS) {
      this.played += dt; this.game += dt;
      localStore.set(PLAY_MS, String(Math.round(this.played)));
      localStore.set(PLAY_LAST, String(Math.round(this.game)));
    }
    if (this.sent >= HUNDRED) return;
    const due = this.sent < HELLO ? (this.played >= this.afterMs ? HELLO : 0)
      : this.sentBefore >= HELLO && this.played >= this.afterMs * HUNDRED_TIMES ? HUNDRED : 0;
    if (due && this.asked !== due && this.s.input?.sms?.(due)) {
      this.asked = due;
      this.log(`[app] played ${Math.round(this.played / 60_000)} min: the game's phone gets our message ${due} once the player drives in career free roam`);
    }
    if (this.asked && this.s.status?.read()?.get('sms') === this.asked) {
      localStore.set(PLAY_SMS, String(this.asked));
      this.sent = this.asked;
      this.log(`[app] our message ${this.asked} is in the game's inbox: not asked for again`);
    }
  }

  stop() {
    if (this.timer !== null) clearInterval(this.timer);
    this.timer = null;
  }
}
