// The game data (all but the movies) onto this device ahead of play ("Game data on this device", in
// the start page's Game tab): the predownload worker fills the cache the
// game reads from.  It only runs while no game runs in this tab, because the
// game's I/O worker writes the same cache files.  A game pauses it, and it
// goes on after the game ends.

import type { FromPredownload, ToPredownload } from '../host/predownload-worker';
import { DATA_BASE, MANIFEST_URL, aheadFiles, languageMovies, manifestFiles, scanCache, type Manifest, type Packs } from '../host/datacache';

export type DownloadState = 'idle' | 'running' | 'paused' | 'done' | 'error';
export interface DownloadStatus {
  state: DownloadState;
  /** bytes of the game data in this browser, of total (0 until the worker has counted them) */
  have: number; total: number;
  /** bytes a second over the last 10 s, 0 until measured */
  rate: number;
  error?: string;
}

const STOP_WAIT_MS = 3000;

/** Whether every movie a game in this language can play is in this browser's cache (they are not downloaded ahead:
 *  only one that played is), in VP6 or, where the browser plays them in AV1 (av1), their AV1 copies. */
export async function moviesKept(language: string, av1: boolean): Promise<boolean> {
  const r = await fetch(MANIFEST_URL, { cache: 'no-cache' });
  if (!r.ok) return false;
  const s = await scanCache(languageMovies(manifestFiles(await r.json() as Manifest), language, av1));
  return s.have >= s.total;
}

/** How much of what the download fetches (all but the movies) this browser keeps: bytes in the cache, of their total. */
export async function gameDataKept(language: string, packs: Packs): Promise<{ have: number; total: number }> {
  const r = await fetch(MANIFEST_URL, { cache: 'no-cache' });
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${r.status}`);
  const s = await scanCache(aheadFiles(manifestFiles(await r.json() as Manifest), language, packs));
  return { have: s.have, total: s.total };
}

export class Predownload {
  status: DownloadStatus = { state: 'idle', have: 0, total: 0, rate: 0 };
  private w: Worker | null = null;
  private ended: (() => void) | null = null;
  private samples: { t: number; have: number }[] = [];

  /** language: the game's language now (settings.ini): only its language pack is fetched; packs: the texture packs
   *  picked (comma-separated, '' for none), the only ones fetched, and the songs (datacache.ts Packs) */
  constructor(private onChange: (s: DownloadStatus) => void, private log: (line: string) => void, readonly language: () => string,
              readonly packs: () => Packs) {}

  get running() { return this.w !== null; }

  start() {
    if (this.w) return;
    const w = this.w = new Worker(new URL('/host/predownload-worker.js', import.meta.url), { type: 'module', name: 'predownload' });
    this.samples = [];
    w.onmessage = (e: MessageEvent<FromPredownload>) => this.message(w, e.data);
    w.onerror = e => this.message(w, { t: 'error', msg: e.message || 'it stopped unexpectedly' });
    w.postMessage({ t: 'start', manifestUrl: MANIFEST_URL, language: this.language(), packs: this.packs() } satisfies ToPredownload);
    this.set({ state: 'running', have: 0, total: 0, rate: 0, error: undefined });     // counted again by the worker
    this.log('[app] predownload: started');
  }

  /** Stop it, and do not resume it after a game (it keeps what it wrote); resolves once its files are closed. */
  async stop(): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.w && this.status.state !== 'paused') return;
    await this.end();
    this.set({ state: 'idle', rate: 0 });
    this.log('[app] predownload: stopped');
  }

  /** Before a game: stop it if it runs.  It goes on at resume(). */
  async pause(): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.w) return;
    await this.end();
    this.set({ state: 'paused', rate: 0 });
    this.log('[app] predownload: paused for the game');
  }

  /** After the game: on again if pause() stopped it. */
  resume() { if (this.status.state === 'paused') this.start(); }

  private end(): Promise<void> {
    const w = this.w;
    if (!w) return Promise.resolve();
    return new Promise<void>(res => {
      const timer = setTimeout(() => { this.log('[app] predownload: did not stop in time, ended'); finish(); }, STOP_WAIT_MS);
      const finish = () => { clearTimeout(timer); w.terminate(); if (this.w === w) this.w = null; this.ended = null; res(); };
      this.ended = finish;
      w.postMessage({ t: 'stop' } satisfies ToPredownload);
    });
  }

  private message(w: Worker, m: FromPredownload) {
    if (w !== this.w) return;
    switch (m.t) {
      case 'progress': {
        const t = performance.now();
        this.samples.push({ t, have: m.have });
        while (this.samples.length > 2 && t - this.samples[0].t > 10_000) this.samples.shift();
        const a = this.samples[0], span = (t - a.t) / 1000;
        this.set({ have: m.have, total: m.total, rate: span >= 2 ? (m.have - a.have) / span : 0 });
        return;
      }
      case 'stopped': this.ended?.(); return;
      case 'done':
        w.terminate(); this.w = null;
        this.log(`[app] predownload: done, ${m.total} bytes of game data in this browser`);
        this.set({ state: 'done', have: m.have, total: m.total, rate: 0 });
        return;
      case 'error':
        w.terminate(); this.w = null;
        this.log(`[app] predownload: stopped, ${m.msg}`);
        this.set({ state: 'error', rate: 0, error: m.msg });
        this.ended?.();
    }
  }

  private set(p: Partial<DownloadStatus>) { this.status = { ...this.status, ...p }; this.onChange(this.status); }
}

// The browser's two small stores: localStorage (this browser's, for good) and sessionStorage (this tab's, until it
// closes).  Every key the page keeps in them is named here, and every read and write goes through localStore or
// sessionStore, which never throw: either store may be missing or refuse (a private window, storage blocked, a full
// store, Safari on a write), and the page then goes on with what it holds in memory (a read gives null, a write false).
// The keys' spellings are what players' choices are kept under: never change one (both styles, nfsu2-a-b and
// nfsu2.a.b, stay as they are).  A key ending in ':' or '.' is a prefix, followed by what it is for.
// Workers have neither store: nothing that runs in one reads these (i18n.ts is in some workers' bundles, but not its
// functions that do).

/** one of the two stores, by a way in that never throws */
export interface Store {
  /** the key's value; null: none kept, or no store */
  get(key: string): string | null;
  /** keeps value under key; false: not kept (no store, or no room), and failed hears why */
  set(key: string, value: string, failed?: (e: unknown) => void): boolean;
  remove(key: string): void;
  /** the key's value read as JSON; null: none kept, not JSON, or no store */
  getJSON(key: string): unknown;
  /** keeps value as JSON, as set does */
  setJSON(key: string, value: unknown, failed?: (e: unknown) => void): boolean;
  /** whether the store answers at all (false: storage blocked, or none here) */
  usable(): boolean;
}

/** the store is looked up at each call (it may be blocked at any time, and a test puts its own in) */
function storeOf(which: () => Storage): Store {
  const set = (key: string, value: string, failed?: (e: unknown) => void) => {
    try { which().setItem(key, value); return true; } catch (e) { failed?.(e); return false; }
  };
  return {
    get: key => { try { return which().getItem(key); } catch { return null; } },
    set,
    remove: key => { try { which().removeItem(key); } catch { /* no store */ } },
    getJSON: key => { try { return JSON.parse(which().getItem(key) ?? 'null'); } catch { return null; } },
    setJSON: (key, value, failed) => { try { return set(key, JSON.stringify(value), failed); } catch (e) { failed?.(e); return false; } },
    usable: () => { try { which().getItem(''); return true; } catch { return false; } },
  };
}

/** 4 characters of a 32-bit FNV-1a hash of the salt and the name */
function hash4(salt: string, s: string): string {
  let h = 0x811c9dc5;
  for (const ch of `${salt}\0${s}`) { h ^= ch.codePointAt(0)!; h = Math.imul(h, 0x01000193) >>> 0; }
  return (h % 1679616).toString(36).padStart(4, '0');   // 36^4
}
const wordAt = (s: string, i: number) => { WORD_AT.lastIndex = i; return WORD_AT.test(s); };
const byLength = (a: string, b: string) => b.length - a.length;

/** the text with each name in it replaced where no word character stands right before it or right after it, as
 *  /(?<!WORD)(?:name|...)(?!WORD)/gu with the longest names first would: from the left, the longest name at a place */
function replaceAnywhere(text: string, names: string[], label: (n: string) => string): string {
  // a name's first word, or its first character, to the names starting so (longest first)
  const byStart = new Map<string, string[]>();
  const tok = new RegExp(TOKEN.source, 'gu');
  for (const n of names.sort(byLength)) {
    tok.lastIndex = 0;
    const first = tok.exec(n)?.[0];
    if (!first) continue;
    const list = byStart.get(first);
    if (list) list.push(n); else byStart.set(first, [n]);
  }
  let out = '', last = 0, afterWord = false, m: RegExpExecArray | null;
  tok.lastIndex = 0;
  while ((m = tok.exec(text))) {
    const p = m.index;
    let hit: string | undefined;
    if (!afterWord) for (const n of byStart.get(m[0]) ?? []) if (text.startsWith(n, p) && !wordAt(text, p + n.length)) { hit = n; break; }
    if (hit) {
      out += text.slice(last, p) + label(hit);
      last = tok.lastIndex = p + hit.length;
      afterWord = WORD_ONE.test([...hit.slice(-2)].pop()!);  // its last character (a pair of halves is one)
    } else afterWord = wordAt(m[0], 0);
  }
  return last ? out + text.slice(last) : text;
}

/** the text with each name in it replaced where PRE stands right before it and POST right after it, as
 *  /(?<=PRE)(?:name|...)(?=POST)/gmu with the longest names first would */
function replaceFramed(text: string, names: string[], label: (n: string) => string): string {
  const at = new Map<number, string>();        // a place -> the longest name that stands there framed
  for (const n of names.sort(byLength)) {
    for (let i = text.indexOf(n); i >= 0; i = text.indexOf(n, i + 1)) {
      if (at.has(i)) continue;
      POST_AT.lastIndex = i + n.length;
      if (!POST_AT.test(text)) continue;
      const c = i ? text.charCodeAt(i - 1) : 10;
      // PRE's ^: at a line's start; its other words never reach past one
      if (c === 10 || c === 13 || c === 0x2028 || c === 0x2029 || PRE_END.test(text.slice(text.lastIndexOf('\n', i - 1) + 1, i))) at.set(i, n);
    }
  }
  if (!at.size) return text;
  let out = '', last = 0;
  for (const p of [...at.keys()].sort((a, b) => a - b)) {
    if (p < last) continue;
    const n = at.get(p)!;
    out += text.slice(last, p) + label(n);
    last = p + n.length;
  }
  return out + text.slice(last);
}

function browserSalt(): string {
  const fresh = () => Array.from(crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(12)), b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
  let s = localStore.get(LOG_SALT);
  if (!s) { s = fresh(); localStore.set(LOG_SALT, s); }      // (storage off: the stand-ins hold for this page only)
  return s;
}

export class Privacy {
  private names = new Map<string, NameKind>();
  /** our own virtual addresses (one per connection) */
  private ours = new Set<string>();
  private salt?: string;
  constructor(salt?: string) { this.salt = salt; }

  /** a name the page knows (empty, absent and the game's "Player" are nobody's) */
  name(n: string | null | undefined, kind: NameKind) {
    const s = (n ?? '').trim();
    if (!s || NOBODY.has(s) || s.length > 64) return;
    const had = this.names.get(s);
    if (!had || RANK[kind] < RANK[had]) this.names.set(s, kind);
  }

  /** a line of the log as it is logged: the names and our address it brings in; true when it brought one */
  learn(line: string): boolean {
    let l = line;
    if (l.charCodeAt(0) !== 91) return false;                    // '[': every line this reads starts with a tag
    if (THREAD.test(l)) l = l.replace(THREAD, '').trimStart();
    let m: RegExpExecArray | null;
    const got = (n: string | undefined, kind: NameKind) => { this.name(n, kind); return true; };
    if (l.startsWith('[roam] ')) {
      if ((m = /^\[roam\] (?:JOIN: (.+) joined|LEAVE: (.+?) left: )/.exec(l))) return got(m[1] ?? m[2], 'player');
      if (!l.startsWith('[roam] f=')) {
        if ((m = /^\[roam\] crew \d+: "(.*)" \(/.exec(l))) return got(m[1], 'crew');
        if ((m = /^\[roam\] free-roam multiplayer ON: .*?, room "(.*?)"(?: \([0-9a-f]{8}\))?, up to/.exec(l))) return got(m[1], 'room');
        return false;
      }
      if (l.includes(' race lobby ') && (m = /^\[roam\] f=\d+ race lobby [0-9a-f]{8}: (.+?)(?: (?:joined|left|quit), \d+ of \d+| is gone from it)/.exec(l))) return got(m[1], 'player');
      if (l.includes(' won it: ') && (m = /^\[roam\] f=\d+ race lobby: Multiplayer race: \d+(?:st|nd|rd|th) place\. (.+?) won it: /.exec(l))) return got(m[1], 'player');
      if (l.includes(' quick chat: ') && (m = /^\[roam\] f=\d+ quick chat: (.+?)(?: said phrase |'s phrase \d)/.exec(l))) return got(m[1], 'player');
      if (l.includes(': loading ') && (m = /^\[roam\] f=\d+ slot \d+: loading (.+)'s \S+ \(\d+ parts/.exec(l))) return got(m[1], 'player');
      if (l.includes('(car of our own') && (m = /^\[roam\] f=\d+ slot \d+ \(car of our own, being created\) for (.+), [\d.]+ m away/.exec(l))) return got(m[1], 'player');
      if (l.includes(' outrun with ') && (m = /^\[roam\] f=\d+ outrun with (.+?): /.exec(l))) return got(m[1], 'player');
      if (l.includes(' alone in room ') && (m = /^\[roam\] f=\d+ alone in room "(.*)" for /.exec(l))) return got(m[1], 'room');
      return false;
    }
    if (l.startsWith('[notice] ') && (m = /^\[notice\] (.+?) (?:joined free roam|left|lost the connection|is in a race|is in free roam|turned free roam off)$/.exec(l))) return got(m[1], 'player');
    if (l.startsWith('[chat] ') && (m = /^\[chat\] (.+) said \d+ \(/.exec(l))) return got(m[1], 'player');
    if (l.startsWith('[msg] ') && (m = /^\[msg\] (?:from|to|sending to) (.+?)(?:, on the start page| from the start page: .*| failed: .*|: \w+| \(\d+ characters\))?$/.exec(l))) return got(m[1], 'player');
    if (l.startsWith('[horn] ') && (m = /^\[horn\] (.+)'s horn, [\d.]+ m away/.exec(l))) return got(m[1], 'player');
    if (l.startsWith('[carsfx] ') && (m = /^\[carsfx\] (.+): [^:]+, \d+% \(voice \d+\)$/.exec(l))) return got(m[1], 'player');
    if (l.startsWith('[mprace] ')) {
      if ((m = /^\[mprace\] f=\d+ the LAN name (.+)$/.exec(l))) return got(m[1], 'you');
      if ((m = /^\[mprace\]\s+row \d+: car [0-9a-f]{4}( \(ours\))?, (.+?), /.exec(l))) return got(m[2], m[1] ? 'you' : 'player');
      // a race that counts in the career: the friends in it (LAN names: letters and digits), its winner
      if ((m = /^\[mprace\] f=\d+ start: .*; friends in the race: (.+)$/.exec(l))) {
        for (const n of m[1].split(' ')) if (n !== 'none') this.name(n, 'player');
        return true;
      }
      if ((m = /^\[mprace\] f=\d+ the race in the career: .*\(place \d+, winner (.+?)(?:, a friend)?, margin /.exec(l)) && m[1] !== 'none') return got(m[1], 'player');
      // a player who quit a race of ours, as its game told the others
      if ((m = /^\[mprace\] f=\d+ (.+) quits the race \(its game says so\)$/.exec(l))) return got(m[1], 'player');
      return false;
    }
    if (l.startsWith('[online] ') && (m = /^\[online\] Online menu as (.+) \([^)]*\): /.exec(l))) return got(m[1], 'you');
    if (l.startsWith('[app] ')) {
      if ((m = /^\[app\] the game saved profile (.+) \(\d+ this game\)$/.exec(l))) return got(m[1], 'profile');
      if ((m = /^\[app\] autosave: (.+?)(?:: Save | left as it is|: \d+ bytes|: the name inside)/.exec(l))) return got(m[1], 'profile');
      if ((m = /^\[app\] settings\.ini:\d+: roam_(name|room|crew) -> NFSU2_ROAM_\w+=(.*)$/.exec(l))) {
        if (m[1] === 'crew') for (const c of crewList(m[2])) this.name(c, 'crew');
        else this.name(m[2], m[1] === 'name' ? 'you' : 'room');
        return true;
      }
      return false;
    }
    if (l.startsWith('[net] ') && (m = /(?:on the virtual LAN as |this browser is |hub switch, address )(10\.77\.\d{1,3}\.\d{1,3})/.exec(l))) { this.ours.add(m[1]); return true; }
    if (l.startsWith('[write] ') && (m = /\/save\/NFS Underground 2\/([^/"]+)\//.exec(l))) return got(m[1], 'profile');
    // the Online server (server.dll, lifted): each player's login
    if (l.startsWith('[guest] ') && (m = /^\[guest\] \d+ (?:auth NAME '(.+?)' UID |\S+ auth '(.+?)' \$)/.exec(l))) return got(m[1] ?? m[2], 'player');
    return false;
  }

  /** the text as it may leave the browser */
  scrub(text: string): string {
    const salt = this.salt ??= browserSalt();
    const lines = text.split('\n');
    // the log's own words: of the lines that print no player's name (none of PLAYER_TAGS, none that brought one in)
    const words = new Set<string>();
    const wordRe = new RegExp(`${WORD}+`, 'gu');
    for (const line of lines) {
      if (this.learn(line)) continue;
      const l = line.replace(THREAD, '').trimStart();
      if (PLAYER_TAGS.test(l)) continue;
      for (const w of l.match(wordRe) ?? []) words.add(w);
    }
    const label = (n: string, kind: NameKind) => kind === 'you' ? 'you' : `${kind}-${hash4(salt, n)}`;
    const anywhere: string[] = [], framed: string[] = [];
    for (const n of this.names.keys()) {
      const plain = new RegExp(`^${WORD}+$`, 'u').test(n);
      ((/^\d+$/.test(n) || [...n].length < 3 || (plain && words.has(n))) ? framed : anywhere).push(n);
    }
    const named = (n: string) => label(n, this.names.get(n)!);
    let out = text;
    if (anywhere.length) out = replaceAnywhere(out, anywhere, named);
    if (framed.length) out = replaceFramed(out, framed, named);
    // a race's friends, a list of LAN names (one word each): every known one, a log word too
    out = out.replace(/(friends in the race: )(.+)$/gm, (_, pre: string, list: string) =>
      pre + list.split(' ').map(n => this.names.has(n) ? label(n, this.names.get(n)!) : n).join(' '));
    // addresses: ours, the virtual LAN's, any other; the adapter made from ours
    out = out.replace(/(?<![\d.])10\.77\.\d{1,3}\.\d{1,3}(?!\d)/g, a => this.ours.has(a) ? 'vlan-you' : `vlan-${hash4(salt, a)}`);
    out = out.replace(IPV4, (a, ...o: string[]) => {
      const n = o.slice(0, 4).map(Number);
      if (n.some(x => x > 255) || a === '0.0.0.0' || a === '255.255.255.255' || n[0] === 127) return a;
      return `ip-${hash4(salt, a)}`;
    });
    out = out.replace(/\bVLAN-\d+\b/g, 'VLAN-n').replace(/\b02:4e:56:4c:[0-9a-f]{2}:[0-9a-f]{2}\b/gi, '02:4e:56:4c:xx:xx')
      .replace(/\$024e564c[0-9a-f]{4}\b/gi, '$$024e564cxxxx');
    // the time zone: its offset stays
    out = out.replace(/^((?:\[\d+!\] )?tz: )[^,\n]+(, UTC)/gm, '$1(zone)$2');
    out = out.replace(/(GetTimeZoneInformation: bias -?\d+ min, )"[^"\n]*" \/ "[^"\n]*"/g, '$1"(zone)" / "(zone)"');
    return out;
  }
}

/** the page's: every log line goes through learn (shell.ts), both downloads through scrub */
export const privacy = new Privacy();

// taken as edited (profileName) and comes in sealed again, with a warning, so
// the page's own checks below take it too; one in the save folder whose
// checksums do not hold is left alone instead of being "repaired".  Checked in
// the game (2026-10-19): a profile it created came in on Prompt, and after
// withAutosave it loaded with Options, Gameplay, Save at Autosave and every
// other Gameplay option as before.  Every check below must still hold before

import { readsAsSlur, UNCLAIMABLE } from './claim';
import { fill, N, t, type Vars } from './i18n';

export const PROFILE_SIZE = 54966;
const PAYLOAD = 54930, VERSION = 0x10D;
const B = 36;                                        // the payload's start in the file
const AUTOSAVE = B + 50987, PROMPT = B + 50988, NAME = B + 53761, MONEY = 0xA16A;

const T = new Uint32Array(256);                      // MSB-first CRC table, polynomial 0x04C11DB7
for (let i = 0; i < 256; i++) {
  let r = i << 24;
  for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) r = r & 0x80000000 ? (r << 1) ^ 0x04C11DB7 : r << 1;
  T[i] = r >>> 0;
}

/** The game's checksum of a block (SPEC §3.4): 0 below 4 bytes. */
export function checksum(d: Uint8Array): number {
  if (d.length < 4) return 0;
  let r = ~((d[0] << 24) | (d[1] << 16) | (d[2] << 8) | d[3]) >>> 0;
  for (let i = 4; i < d.length; i++) r = (((r << 8) | d[i]) ^ T[r >>> 24]) >>> 0;
  return ~r >>> 0;
}

export type SaveMode = 'autosave' | 'prompt' | 'off';

const u32 = (f: Uint8Array, at: number) => new DataView(f.buffer, f.byteOffset, f.byteLength).getUint32(at, true);
const lowerAscii = (s: string) => s.replace(/[A-Z]/g, c => String.fromCharCode(c.charCodeAt(0) + 32));

/**
 * The Save option of a profile file, or why the page does not trust the file
 * enough to change it: its size, header, checksums, version, the name inside
 * against its folder's (ASCII letters in any case), and both Save bytes 0 or 1.
 */
export function readSaveMode(file: Uint8Array, name: string): { mode: SaveMode } | { bad: string } {
  const bad = checkProfile(file, name);
  if (bad) return { bad: fill(bad.t, bad.v) };
  const a = file[AUTOSAVE], p = file[PROMPT];
  if (a > 1 || p > 1) return { bad: `unexpected Save bytes ${a}, ${p}` };
  return { mode: a ? 'autosave' : p ? 'prompt' : 'off' };
}

/** why a check refuses a file, as written (English with {name}s for v): filled for the log, translated for the page */
interface Why { t: string; v?: Vars }

/** Why a file is not a profile the game saved under this name (readSaveMode's checks but the Save bytes), or null. */
function checkProfile(file: Uint8Array, name: string): Why | null {
  const bad = checkFile(file);
  if (bad) return bad;
  if (lowerAscii(folderName(file)) !== lowerAscii(name)) return { t: N('the name inside is "{name}"'), v: { name: nameInside(file) } };
  return null;
}

/** checkProfile's checks of the file itself: SPEC §3.5's (the game loads one whose checksums are stale, though). */
function checkFile(file: Uint8Array): Why | null {
  return checkShape(file) ?? (sealedRight(file) ? null : { t: N('its checksums do not match (edited outside the game?)') });
}

/** checkFile's checks but the checksums: the container, its block sizes and the version. */
function checkShape(file: Uint8Array): Why | null {
  if (!isProfileFile(file)) return { t: N('not a profile file (no "20CM")') };
  if (file.length !== PROFILE_SIZE) return { t: N('{n} bytes, not {size}'), v: { n: file.length, size: PROFILE_SIZE } };
  if (u32(file, 4) !== file.length || u32(file, 8) !== 8 || u32(file, 12) !== PAYLOAD) return { t: N('unexpected block sizes') };
  if (u32(file, 28) !== VERSION || u32(file, 32) !== PAYLOAD) return { t: N('saved by another version of the game (version {got}, not {want})'), v: { got: u32(file, 28), want: VERSION } };
  return null;
}

const sealedRight = (file: Uint8Array) => u32(file, 16) === checksum(file.subarray(28, B)) &&
  u32(file, 20) === checksum(file.subarray(B)) && u32(file, 24) === checksum(file.subarray(0, 24));

function nameInside(file: Uint8Array): string {
  let inside = '';
  for (let i = NAME; i < NAME + 32 && file[i]; i++) inside += String.fromCharCode(file[i]);
  return inside;
}

/**
 * The name of the folder the game saves a profile in: the name inside, at
 * most 31 bytes of it (0x6FCAB8 copies no more), as the I/O worker reads a
 * path (UTF-8, U+FFFD for bytes that are not).  For a name the game's field
 * makes, the name inside itself.  A cover shoot whose save failed could name
 * a profile with stale heap bytes (runtime/overrides.c sub_004e8b70); Rename
 * gives such a profile a name the game's field makes again.
 */
function folderName(file: Uint8Array): string {
  let n = 0;
  while (n < 31 && file[NAME + n]) n++;
  return new TextDecoder().decode(file.subarray(NAME, NAME + n));
}

/** A file that starts as the game's save files do ("20CM"): a profile, or one of another version. */
export const isProfileFile = (file: Uint8Array) => file.length >= 4 && file[0] === 0x32 && file[1] === 0x30 && file[2] === 0x43 && file[3] === 0x4D;

/** A profile's bank; null: not a profile of this version. */
export const profileMoney = (file: Uint8Array): number | null => file.length === PROFILE_SIZE && isProfileFile(file) ? u32(file, MONEY) : null;

/**
 * The name inside a profile file that comes from elsewhere (the PC game's
 * NFS Underground 2 folder, a backup), or why the page does not take it:
 * checkProfile's checks but the folder's name and the checksums, and a name
 * the game's own field makes (isProfileName).  edited: its checksums do not
 * hold, as a save editor leaves them; it comes in as sealed() makes it, so
 * Autosave and Rename take it.  A save editor that makes them again is not seen here.
 */
export function profileName(file: Uint8Array): { name: string; edited: boolean } | { bad: string } {
  const r = profileInside(file);
  if ('bad' in r) return r;
  const name = r.inside;
  if (!isProfileName(name)) return { bad: t('the name inside, "{name}", is not one the game makes (1 to {n} letters, digits, spaces, - and _)', { name, n: NAME_MAX }) };
  return { name, edited: r.edited };
}

/**
 * profileName's checks but the name: the name inside as it is (a byte a character), or why the page does not take
 * the file at all.  A profile whose only fault is its name comes in with another one (fixedName, withName).
 */
export function profileInside(file: Uint8Array): { inside: string; edited: boolean } | { bad: string } {
  const bad = checkShape(file);
  if (bad) return { bad: t(bad.t, bad.v) };
  return { inside: nameInside(file), edited: !sealedRight(file) };
}

/** A profile file whole, as the game wrote it: the shape of this version's, and its checksums hold (whatever its name). */
export const profileWhole = (file: Uint8Array) => !checkShape(file) && sealedRight(file);

/**
 * The name a profile from elsewhere comes in under when the name inside is not one the game's field makes, or not
 * its file's: its file's own name when the field makes that, else what the field keeps of its file's name ("ë" as
 * "e"), or of the name inside (its other bytes are the game's font's, no letters of ours), or Profile when none of
 * them has any; one that taken (lower case) does not have, with digits at its end if need be.  The game's
 * new-profile box started with its language's text for NAME, which in Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Thai, Polish and
 * Hungarian has bytes the field itself never takes (overrides.c sub_004ff3b0), a failed cover shoot's save could name
 * a profile with heap bytes (sub_004e8b70), and the PC game with NFSU2 Extra Options' longer names takes any
 * character.  The name it gives is one the game's own box makes (isGivenName).
 */
export function fixedName(own: string, inside: string, taken: Set<string>): string {
  const keep = (s: string) => s.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9]/g, '').slice(0, GIVE_MAX);
  const names = [own, keep(own.normalize('NFKD')), keep(inside)].filter(n => isGivenName(n) && !readsAsSlur(n));
  if (!names.length) names.push('Profile');
  const free = names.find(n => !taken.has(n.toLowerCase()));
  if (free) return free;
  for (let i = 2; ; i++) {
    const n = names[0].slice(0, GIVE_MAX - String(i).length) + i;
    if (!taken.has(n.toLowerCase())) return n;
  }
}

/** Two profile files of one career, whatever their names: the same bytes but the name inside and the checksums. */
export function sameCareer(a: Uint8Array, b: Uint8Array): boolean {
  if (a.length !== PROFILE_SIZE || b.length !== PROFILE_SIZE) return false;
  for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) if (a[i] !== b[i] && (i < 16 || i >= 28) && (i < NAME || i >= NAME + 32)) return false;
  return true;
}

/**
 * Whether `to` is what a page of before 2026-11 (its fixedName: the letters and digits, 7 of them, with digits at
 * the end when that is taken) made of the name `from` it did not take: a name of up to 15 with spaces, - or _, which
 * such a page, cached in another browser, renames when a backup or a keyphrase's version brings it.
 */
export function mendedBefore(from: string, to: string): boolean {
  const base = from.normalize('NFKD').replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9]/g, '').slice(0, 7), t = to.toLowerCase();
  if (!base || base === from) return false;
  if (t === base.toLowerCase()) return true;
  const m = /^(.*?)([0-9]+)$/.exec(to);
  return !!m && !!m[1] && m[1].toLowerCase() === base.slice(0, 7 - m[2].length).toLowerCase();
}

// ------------------------------------------------------- mod cars --
//
// The cars come first in the payload (FEDatabase+0x3c0, written by 0x5166b0
// and read back as they are by 0x516850):
//   0      48 stock cars, 24 bytes each: +20 u32 the car type's index (0xFFFFFFFF unused)
//   1152   u32 stock cars in use (31)
//   1156   20 customized cars, 1,072 bytes each
//   22596  5 career cars, 2,034 bytes each
//   32770  6 preset cars, 1,076 bytes each (after a u32 at 32766)
// The customized, career and preset cars hold their type as a name hash at
// +28 (0: unused), then 170 part hashes.  The hash is bStringHash (0x43db50)
// of the type's name, as CarTypeInfo +0xd0 holds it.  The game reads an
// unknown one's CarTypeInfo through a NULL pointer (0x503880, 0x610130 returns
// 0), and a stock car's index past CarTypeInfo out of its bounds: the game here
// shows such a car as the stock car of the first type (runtime/garage.c
// addon_cars), while the profile keeps it as it is (runtime/modpacks.c: each
// save writes it back as loaded until the player changes it here), and makes
// the stock cars the game's own again as the profile loads (overrides.c
// cars_stock_fix).  Unknown part hashes find no part (0x61b980): the stock
// part instead; the page does not check those (the game's part table is
// 12,000 entries).  Checked against players' profiles: their cars are all of
// the 31 player types below.

/** The game's car types, CarTypeInfo 0..45 in GLOBAL/GLOBALB.BUN (chunk 0x34600): 0..30 the player cars, 31..45 traffic. */
const CAR_TYPES = ['PEUGOT', 'FOCUS', 'COROLLA', '240SX', 'MIATA', 'CIVIC', 'PEUGOT106', 'CORSA', 'HUMMER', 'NAVIGATOR',
  'ESCALADE', 'TIBURON', 'SENTRA', 'CELICA', 'IS300', 'SUPRA', 'GOLF', 'A3', 'RSX', 'ECLIPSE', 'TT', 'RX8', '350Z', 'G35',
  '3000GT', 'GTO', 'MUSTANGGT', 'SKYLINE', 'LANCEREVO8', 'RX7', 'IMPREZAWRX',
  'TAXI', '4DR_SEDAN02', 'AMBULANCE', 'TAXI02', 'PANELVAN', 'COUPE', 'FIRETRUCK', 'PARCELVAN', 'PICKUP', '4DR_SEDAN', 'BUS',
  'SUV', 'MINIVAN', 'HATCHBACK', 'HATCHBACK02'];
export const bStringHash = (s: string) => { let h = 0xFFFFFFFF; for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) h = (Math.imul(h, 33) + s.charCodeAt(i)) >>> 0; return h; };
const CAR_TYPE_HASHES = new Set(CAR_TYPES.map(bStringHash));

/**
 * How many cars in a profile (one profileName took) are of a car type the game does not have (a modded game's
 * cars): the ones the game shows as a stock car instead.  A traffic car's type is one of the game's.
 */
export function modCars(file: Uint8Array): number {
  const at = (o: number) => u32(file, B + o);
  let n = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < 48; i++) { const t = at(i * 24 + 20); if (t !== 0xFFFFFFFF && t >= CAR_TYPES.length) n++; }
  const typed = (o: number) => { const h = at(o + 28); if (h && !CAR_TYPE_HASHES.has(h)) n++; };
  for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) typed(1156 + i * 1072);
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) typed(22596 + i * 2034);
  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) typed(32770 + i * 1076);
  return n;
}

/**
 * How many cars in a GARAGE.DAT (slots 6-10 beside a profile, runtime/garage.c: a 32-byte head, "N2GA" and version 1,
 * then 5 career cars as the profile has its own) are of a car type the game does not have; 0 for any other file.
 */
export function garageModCars(file: Uint8Array | undefined): number {
  if (!file || file.length !== 32 + 5 * 2034 || u32(file, 0) !== 0x4147324E || u32(file, 4) !== 1) return 0;
  let n = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) { const o = 32 + i * 2034, h = u32(file, o + 28); if (file[o + 1073] && h && !CAR_TYPE_HASHES.has(h)) n++; }
  return n;
}

/** The file's checksums made again (A's, B's, then the header's, which covers the other two). */
function seal(f: Uint8Array): Uint8Array {
  const dv = new DataView(f.buffer, f.byteOffset, f.byteLength);
  dv.setUint32(16, checksum(f.subarray(28, B)), true);
  dv.setUint32(20, checksum(f.subarray(B)), true);
  dv.setUint32(24, checksum(f.subarray(0, 24)), true);
  return f;
}

/** A copy of a profile file profileName took as edited, with its checksums made again: as if the game had saved it. */
export const sealed = (file: Uint8Array) => seal(file.slice());

/** A copy of a profile file readSaveMode accepted, with Save at Autosave (both bytes 1, as the game's menu sets it) and its checksums made again. */
export function withAutosave(file: Uint8Array): Uint8Array {
  const f = file.slice();
  f[AUTOSAVE] = 1; f[PROMPT] = 1;
  return seal(f);
}

/** A copy of a profile file the checks accepted, with another name inside (NUL-padded, as the game writes it) and its checksums made again. */
export function withName(file: Uint8Array, name: string): Uint8Array {
  const f = file.slice();
  f.fill(0, NAME, NAME + 32);
  for (let i = 0; i < name.length; i++) f[NAME + i] = name.charCodeAt(i);
  return seal(f);
}

// ------------------------------------------------- once per profile --

/** The save folder's file of the profiles turnOnAutosave has looked at: each one gets Autosave once. */
export const AUTOSAVE_SEEN = 'autosave-profiles.txt';
const SEEN_HEAD = `# Profiles the page has looked at for settings.ini's "autosave": each one is set
# to Autosave once (if it was on Prompt, the game's default), then left as the
# game's Options, Gameplay, Save set it.  Delete a name to have it set again.
`;

export interface SaveFiles {
  listFiles(): Promise<{ path: string }[]>;
  readBytes(path: string): Promise<Uint8Array>;
  readText(path: string): Promise<string | null>;
  writeFile(path: string, data: string | Uint8Array): Promise<void>;
}

/**
 * Before a Play (no game runs in this tab): every profile not looked at yet that
 * is on Prompt is set to Autosave.  Profiles on Autosave or Off, and those set,
 * are remembered (AUTOSAVE_SEEN), so a choice made in the game later stays; a
 * file readSaveMode does not trust is left alone and looked at again next time.
 * Names of profiles that are gone are dropped (a new profile of the same name
 * gets Autosave too).  turnedOn: the profiles set now; notes: one line each for the log.
 */
export async function turnOnAutosave(fs: SaveFiles, profilesDir: string): Promise<{ turnedOn: string[]; notes: string[] }> {
  const seenText = await fs.readText(AUTOSAVE_SEEN) ?? '';
  const seen = new Set(seenText.split('\n').map(l => l.trim()).filter(l => l && !l.startsWith('#')));
  const turnedOn: string[] = [], notes: string[] = [], now: string[] = [];
  for (const { path } of await fs.listFiles()) {
    const p = path.split('/');
    if (p.length !== 3 || p[0] !== profilesDir || lowerAscii(p[2]) !== lowerAscii(p[1])) continue;
    const name = p[1];
    if (seen.has(name)) { now.push(name); continue; }
    const file = await fs.readBytes(path);
    const r = readSaveMode(file, name);
    if ('bad' in r) { notes.push(`${name} left as it is: ${r.bad}`); continue; }
    if (r.mode === 'prompt') {
      await fs.writeFile(path, withAutosave(file));
      turnedOn.push(name);
      notes.push(`${name}: Save set from Prompt to Autosave (Options, Gameplay, Save in the game)`);
    } else notes.push(`${name}: Save is ${r.mode === 'off' ? 'Off' : 'Autosave'} already, left as it is`);
    now.push(name);
  }
  const text = SEEN_HEAD + now.map(n => n + '\n').join('');
  if (text !== seenText && (now.length || seenText)) await fs.writeFile(AUTOSAVE_SEEN, text);
  return { turnedOn, notes };
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------- rename --

/**
 * A name the page keeps as it is wherever saves come in (a backup, a keyphrase's version, a refill, the PC game's
 * profiles): 1 to NAME_MAX of letters, digits, - and _, with one space between words (none first or last), and never
 * DVD or Magazine (any case) with a digit right after them, as a cover shoot's folder ends (coverOf).  The names the
 * game's box will make (NFSU2 Extra Options' longer names, the next module), so a browser on this page never renames
 * one another browser made; every name the game's own box makes (isGivenName) is one of these.
 */
export const NAME_MAX = 15;
export const isProfileName = (s: string) => s.length <= NAME_MAX && /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+( [A-Za-z0-9_-]+)*$/.test(s) &&
  !/(^| )(dvd|magazine) [0-9]/i.test(s);

/**
 * A name the page gives a profile itself (Rename, a broken name mended, a first profile's Your name): one the game's
 * own name field makes, letters and digits, up to GIVE_MAX of them (tests/scripts/kb_profile.txt: the field at
 * 0x4ff310 keeps nothing else), until this game's box takes the longer ones.
 */
export const GIVE_MAX = 7;
export const isGivenName = (s: string) => /^[A-Za-z0-9]+$/.test(s) && s.length <= GIVE_MAX;

/**
 * What a first profile's name field starts with instead of the game's NAME (shell.ts NFSU2_NEW_PROFILE_NAME,
 * runtime/overrides.c sub_004ff3b0): the letters and digits of Your name, the first GIVE_MAX.  '' for none, and for
 * the game's names for nobody (NAME, Player) or a name that reads as a slur.
 */
export function newProfileName(yours: string): string {
  const n = yours.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9]/g, '').slice(0, GIVE_MAX);
  return !n || UNCLAIMABLE.includes(n.toLowerCase()) || readsAsSlur(yours) || readsAsSlur(n) ? '' : n;
}

/**
 * A cover shoot's save, a folder of its own beside its profile's: "<NAME> DVD 1",
 * "<NAME> Magazine 2" (the game puts "DVD %d" or "Magazine %d", 0x79acc0 and
 * 0x79acb4, after the profile's name).  Its file (1,048,612 bytes) does not
 * hold the name, so the folder's name is all that ties it to the profile.
 * A profile's name never has DVD or Magazine with a digit after them
 * (isProfileName), so no profile looks like one.
 */
export function coverOf(folder: string): { profile: string; cover: string } | null {
  const m = /^(.+) ((?:DVD|Magazine) [0-9]+)$/.exec(folder);
  return m ? { profile: m[1], cover: m[2] } : null;
}

export interface RenameFiles extends SaveFiles {
  /** a file, or a folder with everything in it */
  remove(path: string): Promise<void>;
}

/** Delete a profile: its cover shoots' folders, then its own (the game's own names, any case), so one that stops
 *  halfway leaves the profile and never a cover without one.  (Its line in
 *  AUTOSAVE_SEEN goes at the next Play, turnOnAutosave.) */
export async function deleteProfile(fs: RenameFiles, profilesDir: string, name: string): Promise<{ folders: number }> {
  const same = (a: string, b: string) => lowerAscii(a) === lowerAscii(b);
  const folders = new Set<string>();
  for (const { path } of await fs.listFiles()) {
    const p = path.split('/');
    if (p.length >= 3 && p[0] === profilesDir && (same(p[1], name) || same(coverOf(p[1])?.profile ?? '', name))) folders.add(p[1]);
  }
  const order = [...folders].sort((a, b) => Number(same(a, name)) - Number(same(b, name)));   // its own folder last
  for (const f of order) await fs.remove(`${profilesDir}/${f}`);
  return { folders: folders.size };
}

/**
 * Rename a profile as if the game had made it under the new name: its folder and
 * file, the name inside (checksums made again), its cover shoots' folders, and
 * its line in AUTOSAVE_SEEN (so a Save choice made in the game stays).  Refused,
 * with nothing written, when the new name is not one the page gives (isGivenName),
 * when another save has it (the I/O worker finds names in any case), or when the
 * file fails readSaveMode's checks but the name inside (a name the game's field
 * does not make is what a rename mends).  A change of case only is a rename too.  The
 * new folders are written in full before the old ones go: a rename that stops
 * halfway leaves the profile as it was, under its old name.
 */
export async function renameProfile(fs: RenameFiles, profilesDir: string, from: string, to: string):
    Promise<{ files: number } | { refused: string }> {
  if (!isGivenName(to)) return { refused: t('A profile\'s name is 1 to {n} letters and digits, as in the game.', { n: GIVE_MAX }) };
  if (to === from) return { files: 0 };
  const folders = new Map<string, string[]>();      // each folder in profilesDir: its files
  for (const { path } of await fs.listFiles()) {
    const p = path.split('/');
    if (p.length >= 3 && p[0] === profilesDir) folders.set(p[1], [...folders.get(p[1]) ?? [], path]);
  }
  const same = (a: string, b: string) => lowerAscii(a) === lowerAscii(b);
  const own = (folder: string, path: string) => { const p = path.split('/'); return p.length === 3 && same(p[2], folder); };
  const main = folders.get(from)?.find(path => own(from, path));
  if (!main) return { refused: t('There is no profile {name} in this browser.', { name: from }) };
  const file = await fs.readBytes(main);
  const bad = checkFile(file);
  if (bad) return { refused: t('{name} cannot be renamed here: {why}.', { name: from, why: t(bad.t, bad.v) }) };
  const moves: [string, string][] = [[from, to]];
  for (const f of folders.keys()) { const c = coverOf(f); if (c && same(c.profile, from)) moves.push([f, `${to} ${c.cover}`]); }
  const moving = new Set(moves.map(m => m[0]));
  for (const f of folders.keys()) {
    if (moving.has(f)) continue;
    if (same(f, to)) return { refused: t('There is a profile {name} already.', { name: f }) };
    if (same(coverOf(f)?.profile ?? '', to)) return { refused: t('There is a cover shoot {name} of that name already.', { name: f }) };
  }
  // (read before anything is written: one that does not read refuses the rename whole, never half of it)
  const seen = await fs.readText(AUTOSAVE_SEEN);
  let files = 0;
  try {
    for (const [old, now] of moves) for (const path of folders.get(old)!) {
      const rest = path.slice(profilesDir.length + old.length + 2);
      await fs.writeFile(`${profilesDir}/${now}/${own(old, path) ? now : rest}`, path === main ? withName(file, to) : await fs.readBytes(path));
      files++;
    }
  } catch (e) {
    for (const [, now] of moves) await fs.remove(`${profilesDir}/${now}`).catch(() => {});
    throw e;
  }
  const renamed = seen?.split('\n').map(l => l.trim() === from ? to : l).join('\n');
  // (not written: the page's Autosave comes to the new name once more, at most; the rename itself goes on)
  if (seen !== null && renamed !== seen) await fs.writeFile(AUTOSAVE_SEEN, renamed!).catch(() => {});
  for (const [old] of moves) await fs.remove(`${profilesDir}/${old}`);
  return { files };
}

// The cloud saves passphrase in the browser's own passwords, so that it outlives this site's data: cleared browsing
// data, or a disk running low, takes the saves and the link (vault-ui.ts, localStorage) with them, but not the
// passwords, which the browser may also sync to the player's other devices.  One entry per site, user name ID.
//
// Chrome, Edge and the other Chromium browsers have the Credential Management API's PasswordCredential (Chromium's
// components/password_manager CredentialManagerImpl and CredentialManagerPendingRequestTask; checked in Chrome 156
// over CDP with chrome://password-manager-internals, 2026-10-31):
// - store() of a new entry shows the browser's "Save password?" (nothing is kept until the player says Save); one with
//   the same user name is updated without a question, so a new passphrase replaces the old one.  No user gesture
//   needed; nothing in incognito, with "Offer to save passwords" off, or under --enable-automation (so no test
//   browser of ours ever shows it).
// - get() with mediation 'silent' hands the entry back without a question only when it is the site's only one, the
//   browser signs in by itself ("Sign in automatically", on by default) AND its one-time auto sign-in introduction was
//   shown before; on most profiles it was not, and the answer is empty.  With 'optional' the browser then shows its
//   own chooser ("Cloud saves"), which turns automatic sign-in on once picked; with no entry for the site it shows
//   nothing and answers empty at once.
// - Either way, a page whose box (index.html #vault-form: a hidden user name field and a password field) has a saved
//   entry is filled in by the browser as it loads.
// Firefox and Safari have no such API: their password managers, and extensions, fill that box, and may offer to save
// what the player typed or pasted there for Load.  A passphrase the page made is never typed, so it stays with Copy
// and Download there.

/** the entry's user name, in every language (a translated one would be a second entry) */
export const ID = 'Cloud saves';

const api = () => (window as unknown as { PasswordCredential?: new (o: { id: string; password: string }) => Credential }).PasswordCredential;

/** this browser can be asked to keep it */
export function canKeep(): boolean { return isSecureContext && typeof api() === 'function' && !!navigator.credentials; }

/** The browser asked to keep the phrase (its "Save password?"); false: no such API here, or it failed. */
export async function keepPhrase(phrase: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const P = api();
  if (!canKeep() || !P) return false;
  try { await navigator.credentials.store(new P({ id: ID, password: phrase })); return true; } catch { return false; }
}

/** The phrase the browser keeps for this site (null: none, the player closed the browser's chooser, or no such API).
 *  ask: the browser may show its chooser ('optional'); without, only what it gives without a question ('silent'). */
export async function keptPhrase(ask: boolean): Promise<string | null> {
  if (!canKeep()) return null;
  try {
    const c = await navigator.credentials.get({ password: true, mediation: ask ? 'optional' : 'silent' } as CredentialRequestOptions) as { type?: string; password?: unknown } | null;
    return c?.type === 'password' && typeof c.password === 'string' ? c.password : null;
  } catch { return null; }
}

/** a short mark of a phrase, kept to know it was offered to the browser (FNV-1a, not the phrase itself) */
export function markOf(phrase: string): string {
  let h = 0x811c9dc5;
  for (let i = 0; i < phrase.length; i++) { h ^= phrase.charCodeAt(i); h = Math.imul(h, 0x01000193); }
  return (h >>> 0).toString(16);
}

/** a stopwatch: what marks the countdown, a special phrase (in the picker, and its line over the car) */
const WATCH = '<svg class="qc-watch" viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="8" cy="9.2" r="5.3"/><path d="M6.2 1.6h3.6M8 1.6v2.3M8 9.2V6.4M12.3 4.4l1-1"/></svg>';

/** the countdown: COUNT_S seconds, then GO! for GO_MS; big for the players within NEAR_M (m) of the one who said it;
 *  after it, GAP_MS before another (10 s until 2026-11-03: players started one after another at a car meet) */
const COUNT_S = 5, GO_MS = 1000, NEAR_M = 50, GAP_MS = 30000;

/** what the game sends (roam_game.c say_page; racehorn.c qc_page, with race); d: a friend's distance (m); no: the
 *  player's own countdown not started (not theirs to start here) */
interface Said { id: number; name: string; p: number; me?: number; lobby?: number; race?: number; d?: number; no?: number }

export interface QuickChatDeps {
  /** a line in the chat log (the notices' place): the name, what was said, whether it is the player's own */
  line(name: string, text: string, me: boolean): void;
  /** the race lobby's card: what a player said, beside their name */
  lobby(name: string, text: string): void;
  /** the picker's place (the notices', placed again for the picture's size now: place()) */
  place(): void;
  /** messages between friends (messages.ts): whether the touch sheet offers "Message a friend", and opening it */
  message?: { on(): boolean; open(): void };
  log(s: string): void;
}

type Mode = 'keys' | 'pad' | 'touch';
/** the picker's open: all sixteen (touch), the four groups (the controller's click) */
const ALL = 4, GROUPS = 5;
const KEYS: Record<string, number> = { Digit1: 0, Digit2: 1, Digit3: 2, Digit4: 3, Numpad1: 0, Numpad2: 1, Numpad3: 2, Numpad4: 3 };
/** a player's name as a block compares it: trimmed, capitals not counting (the server's: roam hub.rs) */
const nameKey = (n: string) => n.trim().toLowerCase();

export class QuickChat {
  private session: GameSession | null = null;
  private on = false;
  /** free roam with others on (settings.ini roam): else free roam is the career's alone, with nobody to say it to */
  private roam = false;
  private layer: HTMLElement;
  private picker: HTMLElement;
  /** the lines over cars by the player's id (until: performance.now() it goes; out: fading) */
  private lines = new Map<number, { el: HTMLElement; until: number; me: boolean; shown: boolean; out: boolean }>();
  /** the countdown on now: who said it, since when (performance.now()), its big number (near) or the text of its
   *  line over the car, the step shown (0..COUNT_S-1 the numbers, COUNT_S GO!) */
  private count: { id: number; at: number; big: HTMLElement | null; text: HTMLElement | null; step: number } | null = null;
  private countTimer = 0;
  /** no countdown of another player shown, nor the player's own said, before this (performance.now()): after one
   *  big (the player's own, or one within NEAR_M) */
  private countFree = 0;
  /** no countdown of a player past NEAR_M shown before this: after one over a car (one far away holds back no near
   *  one, nor the player's own: a player just outside a car meet could keep its start waiting) */
  private farFree = 0;
  /** the picker: closed (-1), a group open (0-3), all of them (ALL, touch), the groups to flick to (GROUPS, the
   *  controller) */
  private open = -1;
  private mode: Mode = 'keys';
  private closeTimer = 0;
  private sent: number[] = [];
  private drive = 0;
  /** the game's status "netrace" (runtime/racehorn.c qc_status): 1 driving in a race between players, 2 on its
   *  results, 0 not (also a game without it: no picker in races) */
  private netrace = 0;
  /** the game's status "nocount" (runtime/web/status_web.c): 1 while the player's countdown would not start here */
  private nocount = 0;
  /** the game's status "rstick" (runtime/dinput_pad.c): 1 while the game's controls read the controller's right stick
   *  (the steering or a pedal on it): then its click is the game's, not the picker's (pressed in by accident while
   *  steering, it took the stick from the game) */
  private rstick = 0;
  private driveAt = 0;
  private armed = true;
  /** the stick is out from a flick the picker took: it stays the picker's until back at rest, also once that flick said
   *  the phrase and closed it (given back still up, the game took the stick up from rest and back as a tap of the
   *  headlights, runtime/lightkey.c, and the view looked round: a Discord report, 2026-11-05) */
  private tail = false;
  /** the player's sixteen: the phrase in each slot (group * 4 + place), and each group's name */
  private layout: readonly number[] = DEFAULT_PHRASES;
  private groups: readonly CatId[] = DEFAULT_GROUPS;
  /** the names of the players this one blocks (settings.ini roam_block), as the server compares them: their phrases
   *  are not shown (the server keeps them out of free roam; a race's go round it) */
  private blocked = new Set<string>();

  constructor(stage: HTMLElement, private deps: QuickChatDeps) {
    this.layer = document.createElement('div');
    this.layer.className = 'qc-lines';
    this.picker = document.createElement('div');
    this.picker.className = 'ov-card qc-picker';
    this.picker.hidden = true;
    this.picker.dataset.nfsu2Ui = '';
    this.picker.addEventListener('click', e => {
      const b = (e.target as HTMLElement).closest<HTMLElement>('[data-slot]');
      if (b) this.pick(+b.dataset.slot!);
    });
    this.picker.addEventListener('pointerdown', e => e.preventDefault());    // the canvas keeps the focus (and the keys)
    stage.append(this.layer, this.picker);
    // caught before the game's input (attached later, at each Play): the keys the picker uses go to it alone
    window.addEventListener('keydown', e => this.key(e), { capture: true });
    stage.addEventListener('pointerdown', e => {
      if (this.open === ALL && !this.picker.contains(e.target as Node) && !(e.target as Element).closest?.('[data-ctl="chat"]')) this.close();
    }, { capture: true });
  }

  /** a game started: quick chat on (the setting) or off, free roam with others on or off, with the player's sixteen
   *  (phrases.ts phrasesOf, groupsOf), and the names the player blocks (settings.ts blockList) */
  start(s: GameSession, on: boolean, roam: boolean, layout: readonly number[], groups: readonly CatId[], blocked: readonly string[] = []) {
    this.session = s; this.on = on; this.roam = roam; this.drive = 0; this.netrace = 0; this.nocount = 0; this.rstick = 0;
    this.driveAt = 0;
    this.layout = layout; this.groups = groups;
    this.blocked = new Set(blocked.map(nameKey));
  }
  stop() {
    this.session = null; this.on = false;
    this.close();
    this.endCount();
    this.countFree = 0; this.farFree = 0;
    for (const l of this.lines.values()) l.el.remove();
    this.lines.clear();
  }

  /** the picker's place: the notices' (shell.ts placeNotices), u: CSS px per HUD unit */
  place(left: number, top: number, u: number) {
    const s = this.picker.style;
    s.left = `${left}px`; s.top = `${top}px`;
    s.setProperty('--u', `${u}px`);
    this.layer.style.setProperty('--u', `${u}px`);
  }

  /** driving in free roam with others (the game's status: runtime/web/status_web.c "drive" 2, not in a cutscene; it
   *  says 2 in the career's free roam with free roam off too); messages.ts asks too */
  driving(): boolean {
    return this.on && this.roaming();
  }
  /** driving in free roam with others, quick chat on or off (shell.ts: the crews' counts) */
  roaming(): boolean {
    if (!this.session || !this.roam) return false;
    this.readStatus();
    return (this.drive & 3) === 2 && (this.drive & 8) === 0;
  }
  /** in a race between players, driving or on its results (racehorn.c's "netrace"): the picker opens there too */
  private racing(): boolean {
    if (!this.session || !this.on) return false;
    this.readStatus();
    return this.netrace > 0;
  }
  /** the picker may open: driving in free roam with others, or in a race between players */
  private can(): boolean { return this.driving() || this.racing(); }
  private readStatus() {
    const s = this.session, now = performance.now();
    if (!s || now - this.driveAt <= 100) return;
    this.driveAt = now;
    const st = s.status?.read();
    if (st) {
      this.drive = st.get('drive') ?? 0; this.netrace = st.get('netrace') ?? 0; this.nocount = st.get('nocount') ?? 0;
      this.rstick = st.get('rstick') ?? 0;
    }
  }
  /** a countdown of the player's would start now: in free roam (not in a race), and not at a car meet where the
   *  player has not stayed */
  private countOk(): boolean { return this.driving() && !this.nocount; }

  private key(e: KeyboardEvent) {
    if (!this.session || e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.altKey) return;
    const el = e.target as HTMLElement | null;
    // (the page's own things over the game take their keys: messages.ts's card picks a friend with 1-9)
    if (el?.closest?.('input, textarea, select, dialog[open], [data-nfsu2-ui]') || document.querySelector('dialog[open]')) return;
    const k = KEYS[e.code];
    if (k === undefined && !(e.code === 'Escape' && this.open >= 0)) return;
    if (!this.can()) { if (this.open >= 0) this.close(); return; }
    // the game binds none of 1-4 by default (its driving key maps: dinput_kbd.c DIMAP=1; nor do its menus, the
    // results': the front end's key table), and gets them all the same; one the player put a control of the game's on
    // is the game's alone (its status "keys": gamekeys.ts).  Esc closes the picker instead of pausing the game (or
    // leaving the results)
    if (k !== undefined && gameHas(this.session, chatBit(e.code))) return;
    if (e.code === 'Escape') { e.preventDefault(); e.stopImmediatePropagation(); }
    if (e.repeat) return;
    if (e.code === 'Escape') this.close();
    else if (this.open < 0 || this.open >= ALL || this.mode !== 'keys') this.group(k, 'keys');
    else this.pick(this.open * 4 + k);
  }

  /** the right stick, every time the controller is read (gamepad.ts PadPage.stick); true: the picker has it (opened
   *  by the stick's click), else the game looks round with it */
  stick(x: number, y: number): boolean {
    const r = Math.hypot(x, y), mine = this.open >= 0 && this.mode === 'pad';
    if (r < REST) { this.armed = true; this.tail = false; return mine; }
    if (!mine) return this.tail;
    this.tail = true;
    if (r < FLICK || !this.armed) return true;
    this.armed = false;
    if (!this.can()) { this.close(); this.tail = false; return false; }
    const dir = Math.abs(x) > Math.abs(y) ? (x > 0 ? 1 : 3) : (y < 0 ? 0 : 2);
    if (this.open === GROUPS) this.group(dir, 'pad');
    else this.pick(this.open * 4 + dir);
    return true;
  }

  /** the right stick pressed in (gamepad.ts PadPage.click): the four groups, or the picker closed again; true: the
   *  picker took it (where it can open), else it is the game's (also wherever the game's controls read the stick, or
   *  have another control than Hydraulic Bounce on its click: the game's "rstick" 2) */
  click(): boolean {
    this.readStatus();
    if (this.rstick > 0) return false;
    if (this.open >= 0) { this.close(); return true; }
    if (!this.can()) return false;
    this.armed = false;                              // (a flick counts once the stick was back at rest)
    this.group(GROUPS, 'pad');
    return true;
  }

  /** the touch controls' chat button: all sixteen, or closed again */
  toggle() {
    if (this.open === ALL) { this.close(); return; }
    if (!this.can()) return;
    this.mode = 'touch'; this.open = ALL;
    this.draw();
  }

  private group(g: number, mode: Mode) {
    this.mode = mode; this.open = g;
    this.draw();
  }

  private close() {
    clearTimeout(this.closeTimer);
    this.open = -1;
    this.picker.hidden = true;
    this.picker.replaceChildren();
  }

  /** at most BURST in WINDOW_MS: the time until the next may go (0: now) */
  private wait(now: number): number {
    this.sent = this.sent.filter(at => now - at < WINDOW_MS);
    return this.sent.length < BURST ? 0 : this.sent[0] + WINDOW_MS - now;
  }

  /** the slot picked (group * 4 + place): says the phrase the player put there */
  private pick(slot: number) {
    const s = this.session, now = performance.now(), p = this.layout[slot];
    if (!s || p === undefined || !PHRASES[p]) return;
    // (in free roam the free-roam mailbox's game says it, in a race the LAN mailbox's; the countdown: free roam's only,
    // and not while one is on near)
    const race = !this.driving() && this.racing();
    if (p === COUNTDOWN && race) { this.close(); return; }
    if (p === COUNTDOWN && !this.countOk()) { this.refuse(); return; }
    const hold = Math.max(this.wait(now), p === COUNTDOWN ? this.countFree - now : 0);
    if (hold > 0) { this.draw(hold); return; }
    if (!s.net?.say?.(p, race)) { this.close(); return; }
    this.sent.push(now);
    this.deps.log(`[chat] said ${p} (${PHRASES[p].text})${race ? ' in the race' : ''}`);
    this.close();
  }

  /** a slot's phrase in the page's language */
  private text(slot: number): string { return t(PHRASES[this.layout[slot]]?.text ?? ''); }
  /** a slot's phrase into el: its text, the countdown with its stopwatch (dimmed where it would not start: in a race,
   *  where it does nothing, and at a car meet where the player has not stayed) */
  private slotText(el: HTMLElement, slot: number) {
    el.textContent = this.text(slot);
    if (this.layout[slot] !== COUNTDOWN) return;
    el.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin', WATCH);
    if (!this.countOk()) el.classList.add('qc-off');
  }

  /** the player's countdown not started here: the picker says so (not why: who stayed how long stays the game's) */
  private refuse() {
    this.deps.log('[chat] the countdown: not allowed here');
    this.draw(0, t('You are not allowed to start a countdown here'));
  }

  /** the picker as a card (cards.ts): its title, then the four (a key cap and the phrase; with the controller its
   *  arrows), then "Esc closes"; waiting or refused, why; on a touch screen all sixteen, four columns of buttons */
  private draw(hold = 0, no = '') {
    clearTimeout(this.closeTimer);
    const p = this.picker, wait = no ? 0 : Math.max(hold, this.wait(performance.now()));
    this.deps.place();
    p.dataset.mode = this.mode;
    p.hidden = false;
    const kids: HTMLElement[] = [], title = (text: string) => block(el('div', 'ov-title', text));
    if (no || wait > 0) {
      kids.push(title(t('Quick chat')), block(el('div', no ? 'ov-dim qc-wait qc-no' : 'ov-dim qc-wait', no || t('Wait a moment'))));
      this.closeTimer = window.setTimeout(() => this.close(), no ? PICK_MS : Math.min(wait, PICK_MS));
    } else if (this.open === GROUPS) {
      const rows = [0, 1, 2, 3].map(g => { const r = act(ARROWS[g], t(catName(this.groups[g]))); r.classList.add('qc-row'); return r; });
      kids.push(title(t('Quick chat')), block(...rows));
      this.closeTimer = window.setTimeout(() => this.close(), PICK_MS);
    } else if (this.open === ALL) {
      for (let g = 0; g < 4; g++) {
        const col = el('div', 'qc-group');
        col.append(el('div', 'ov-title', t(catName(this.groups[g]))));
        for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
          const b = el('button', 'qc-say');
          this.slotText(b, g * 4 + i);
          b.type = 'button'; b.dataset.slot = String(g * 4 + i);
          col.append(b);
        }
        kids.push(col);
      }
      const m = this.deps.message;
      if (m?.on() && this.driving()) {               // (messages go in free roam: messages.ts)
        const b = el('button', 'qc-say qc-msg', t('Message a friend'));
        b.type = 'button';
        b.addEventListener('click', () => { this.close(); m.open(); });
        kids.push(b);
      }
    } else {
      const rows = [0, 1, 2, 3].map(i => {
        const tx = el('span', 'qc-text');
        this.slotText(tx, this.open * 4 + i);
        const r = act(this.mode === 'pad' ? ARROWS[i] : String(i + 1), tx);
        r.classList.add('qc-row'); r.dataset.slot = String(this.open * 4 + i);
        return r;
      });
      kids.push(title(t(catName(this.groups[this.open]))), block(...rows));
      if (this.mode === 'keys') kids.push(block(el('div', 'ov-small', t('Esc closes'))));
      this.closeTimer = window.setTimeout(() => this.close(), PICK_MS);
    }
    p.replaceChildren(...kids);
  }

  /** a phrase said (roam_game.c say_page, racehorn.c qc_page: NET_KIND_SAY): its line over the car (free roam), the
   *  log, the lobby's card (free roam) */
  said(json: string) {
    let s: Said;
    try { s = JSON.parse(json) as Said; } catch { this.deps.log(`[chat] not JSON: ${json.slice(0, 80)}`); return; }
    if (!this.on || typeof s.id !== 'number' || typeof s.p !== 'number') return;
    if (s.p === COUNTDOWN && s.me && s.no) { this.refuse(); return; }      // (the game's: picked as the status changed)
    if (s.p === COUNTDOWN) { if (!s.race) this.counted(s); return; }       // (said in free roam only)
    if (!(s.p >= 0 && s.p < PHRASES.length)) return;
    const text = t(PHRASES[s.p].text), me = !!s.me, name = String(s.name ?? ''), where = s.race ? ', in the race' : s.lobby ? ', in our lobby' : '';
    if (!me && this.blocked.has(nameKey(name))) { this.deps.log(`[chat] ${name} said ${s.p}${where}: not shown (blocked)`); return; }
    this.deps.log(`[chat] ${me ? 'you' : name} said ${s.p} (${PHRASES[s.p].text})${where}`);
    // a race: the log only (the game tells nobody where its racers' names are drawn)
    if (s.race) { this.deps.line(name, text, me); return; }
    this.overCar(s.id, text, me, SHOW_MS);
    this.deps.line(name, text, me);
    this.deps.lobby(name, text);
  }

  /** a line over the car of player id for ms (in place of the one there), the countdown's with its stopwatch: its
   *  text */
  private overCar(id: number, text: string, me: boolean, ms: number, icon = ICON): HTMLElement {
    this.lines.get(id)?.el.remove();
    // the place on .qc-line (every frame), the look and its pop on .qc-b
    const el = document.createElement('div'), b = document.createElement('div');
    const span = Object.assign(document.createElement('span'), { textContent: text });
    el.className = 'qc-line' + (me ? ' me' : '');
    b.className = 'qc-b';
    b.innerHTML = icon;
    b.append(span);
    el.append(b);
    el.hidden = true;
    this.layer.append(el);
    this.lines.set(id, { el, until: performance.now() + ms, me, shown: false, out: false });
    return span;
  }

  /** a countdown said (the player's own, or a friend's): big for the one who said it and the players within NEAR_M,
   *  else over the car; not while another is on, nor GAP_MS after it (a far one: after a far one only) */
  private counted(s: Said) {
    const me = !!s.me, name = String(s.name ?? ''), now = performance.now();
    if (!me && this.blocked.has(nameKey(name))) { this.deps.log(`[chat] ${name}'s countdown: not shown (blocked)`); return; }
    const near = me || (typeof s.d === 'number' && s.d <= NEAR_M);
    if (!me && now < (near ? this.countFree : Math.max(this.countFree, this.farFree))) {
      this.deps.log(`[chat] ${name}'s countdown: not shown (one was on)`); return; }
    const was = this.count;                                // (a far one's number over its car: gone with it)
    if (was?.text) { this.lines.get(was.id)?.el.remove(); this.lines.delete(was.id); }
    this.endCount();
    if (near) this.countFree = now + COUNT_S * 1000 + GO_MS + GAP_MS;
    else this.farFree = now + COUNT_S * 1000 + GO_MS + GAP_MS;
    this.deps.log(`[chat] ${me ? 'you' : name} started the countdown${me ? '' : ` (${s.d ?? '?'} m${near ? '' : ': over the car'})`}`);
    let big: HTMLElement | null = null, text: HTMLElement | null = null;
    if (near) {
      big = document.createElement('div');
      big.className = 'qc-count';
      this.layer.append(big);
    } else text = this.overCar(s.id, String(COUNT_S), me, COUNT_S * 1000 + GO_MS, WATCH);
    this.count = { id: s.id, at: now, big, text, step: -1 };
    this.countTick();
    this.countTimer = window.setInterval(() => this.countTick(), 100);
    const said = t('Countdown');
    this.deps.line(name, said, me);
    this.deps.lobby(name, said);
  }

  /** the countdown's number now (its pop at each), GO!, and its end */
  private countTick() {
    const c = this.count;
    if (!c) return;
    const ms = performance.now() - c.at, step = Math.min(Math.floor(ms / 1000), COUNT_S);
    if (ms >= COUNT_S * 1000 + GO_MS) { this.endCount(); return; }
    if (c.big) {
      if (step !== c.step) {
        const n = document.createElement('span');
        n.textContent = step < COUNT_S ? String(COUNT_S - step) : t('GO!');
        c.big.replaceChildren(n);
      }
      if (!c.big.classList.contains('out') && ms >= COUNT_S * 1000 + GO_MS - FADE_MS) c.big.classList.add('out');
      this.placeCount();
    } else if (c.text && step !== c.step) c.text.textContent = step < COUNT_S ? String(COUNT_S - step) : t('GO!');
    c.step = step;
  }

  /** the big number: in the picture's middle across, a quarter down (over the road ahead, above the cars) */
  private placeCount() {
    const b = this.count?.big, v = this.session?.viewRect();
    if (!b || !v || !(v.w > 0 && v.h > 0)) return;
    b.style.left = `${(v.x + v.w / 2).toFixed(1)}px`;
    b.style.top = `${(v.y + v.h * 0.24).toFixed(1)}px`;
  }

  private endCount() {
    clearInterval(this.countTimer);
    this.count?.big?.remove();
    this.count = null;
  }

  /** every frame drawn (the renderer's onMarks): the lines over the cars where this frame has their names */
  marks(n: number, m: Float32Array, ids: Uint32Array) {
    if (this.count?.big) this.placeCount();
    if (!this.lines.size) return;
    const s = this.session, now = performance.now();
    const v = s?.viewRect();
    for (const [id, l] of this.lines) {
      if (now >= l.until) { l.el.remove(); this.lines.delete(id); continue; }
      let i = 0;
      while (i < n && ids[4 * i] !== id) i++;
      const show = i < n && !!v && v.w > 0 && v.h > 0;
      if (show) {
        // its bottom middle on the name's top (the game's point is the name's middle), scaled with the name
        const u = Math.min(v.w / 640, v.h / 480), sc = m[4 * i + 3], ls = Math.max(sc, LINE_MIN);
        const x = v.x + m[4 * i + 1] * v.w, y = v.y + m[4 * i + 2] * v.h - (l.me ? 0 : NAME_H / 2 * u * sc);
        l.el.style.transform = `translate(${x.toFixed(1)}px, ${y.toFixed(1)}px) scale(${ls.toFixed(3)}) translate(-50%, -100%)`;
      }
      if (show !== l.shown) { l.el.hidden = !show; l.shown = show; }
      if (!l.out && now >= l.until - FADE_MS) { l.out = true; l.el.classList.add('out'); }
    }
  }

  /** quick chat is on in this game (its setting): the touch controls' chat button shows (touch.ts) */
  get enabled() { return this.on; }

  /** for the page's test hooks */
  state() {
    const c = this.count;
    return { on: this.on, open: this.open, mode: this.mode, lines: [...this.lines.keys()], sent: this.sent.length, netrace: this.netrace,
      count: c ? { id: c.id, big: !!c.big, text: (c.big ?? c.text)?.textContent ?? '' } : null };
  }
}

// The one place that knows the layout of the radio's words after the status table (HostStatusRadio in
// runtime/web/radio_proto.h, same order): the page writes the switch, the tags and the sound, the runtime (runtime/radio.c)
// reads them.  RadioLink.open() gives a link only to a game whose block has the radio's magic and version.
import type { GameMemory } from '../host/memory';
const WORDS = ['radio_magic', 'radio_version', 'on', 'tag_seq', 'places', 'req_seq', 'req_index', 'ready_seq', 'failed_seq', 'total', 'written', 'ring', 'ring_frames', 'read', 'skip',
  'listen', 'song_seq', 'song_kind', 'song_ms', 'song_end'] as const;
type Word = typeof WORDS[number];
export const RADIO_WORDS: readonly string[] = WORDS;
/** What the runtime writes into the first two words at its start (RADIO_MAGIC, RADIO_VERSION in radio_proto.h). */
export const RADIO_MAGIC = 0x31444152, RADIO_VERSION = 3;
const W = Object.fromEntries(WORDS.map((n, i) => [n, i])) as Record<Word, number>;
const CTL = 16 + 48 * 24,   // the status table before them (status.ts: HEAD + MAX * ITEM)
  PLACES = 2, TAG = 44, TEXT = WORDS.length * 4;

export interface Lines { artist: string; title: string; album: string }
/** The song playing as the runtime tells it (radio_proto.h song_*): seq counts the songs the game started; kind: 'game' an EA Trax
 *  song, 'folder' the Radio's track, 'none' no song; ms: how long it has been heard; ended: it played to its end. */
export interface Song { seq: number; kind: 'none' | 'game' | 'folder'; ms: number; ended: boolean; lines: Lines }
const KINDS = ['none', 'game', 'folder'] as const;
/** 0 menus, 1 driving */
export type Place = 0 | 1;

const ascii = (s: string, to: Uint8Array) => {
  to.fill(0);
  [...s].slice(0, TAG - 1).forEach((ch, i) => { const c = ch.codePointAt(0)!; to[i] = c >= 0x20 && c < 0x7f ? c : 63; });
};

export class RadioLink {
  constructor(private memory: GameMemory, private ptr: number) {}

  /** The link to the radio's words at the status block, or null: the block is too short, or it is another build's (an older game in the cache). */
  static open(memory: GameMemory, ptr: number): RadioLink | null {
    const end = ptr + CTL + TEXT + (PLACES + 1) * 3 * TAG;
    if (!Number.isInteger(ptr) || ptr < 0 || end > memory.buffer.byteLength || (ptr + CTL) % 4) return null;
    const w = new Int32Array(memory.buffer, ptr + CTL, 2);
    return Atomics.load(w, W.radio_magic) === RADIO_MAGIC && Atomics.load(w, W.radio_version) === RADIO_VERSION ? new RadioLink(memory, ptr) : null;
  }
  private words() { return new Int32Array(this.memory.buffer, this.ptr + CTL, WORDS.length); }

  /** False once the runtime switched the radio off (memory that does not look right). */
  isOn(): boolean { return (Atomics.load(this.words(), W.on) & 1) === 1; }

  /** The runtime adds one to the word too: the page swaps only the value it read, and a lost swap is read again by isOn(). */
  setOn(on: boolean) {
    const w = this.words(), now = Atomics.load(w, W.on);
    if (((now & 1) === 1) !== on) Atomics.compareExchange(w, W.on, now, now + 1);
  }

  /** The next track of each place (0 menus, 1 driving) with its tags, null: no track suits the place. */
  setPlaces(next: readonly [Lines | null, Lines | null]) {
    const w = this.words(), bytes = new Uint8Array(this.memory.buffer, this.ptr + CTL + TEXT, PLACES * 3 * TAG), s0 = Atomics.load(w, W.tag_seq) & ~1;
    Atomics.store(w, W.tag_seq, s0 + 1);
    next.forEach((t, p) => [t?.artist, t?.title, t?.album].forEach((line, k) => ascii(line ?? '', bytes.subarray((p * 3 + k) * TAG, (p * 3 + k + 1) * TAG))));
    Atomics.store(w, W.places, next.reduce((mask, t, p) => mask | (t ? 1 << p : 0), 0));
    Atomics.store(w, W.tag_seq, s0 + 2);
  }

  /** The game's latest track start: its number and its place. */
  request(): { seq: number; place: Place } {
    const w = this.words();
    return { seq: Atomics.load(w, W.req_seq) >>> 0, place: (Atomics.load(w, W.req_index) & 1) as Place };
  }

  /** The track the game asked for is decoded: total frames, none written yet.  Nothing is published while the runtime has no rings. */
  serve(seq: number, total: number): boolean {
    const w = this.words();
    if (!Atomics.load(w, W.ring_frames) || !Atomics.load(w, W.ring)) return false;
    Atomics.store(w, W.written, 0); Atomics.store(w, W.total, total); Atomics.store(w, W.ready_seq, seq);
    return true;
  }
  fail(seq: number) { Atomics.store(this.words(), W.failed_seq, seq); }

  /** Ends the track where the game has read it: the runtime sees the end of the stream and the game goes on to its next song. */
  cut() { const w = this.words(), at = Atomics.load(w, W.read); Atomics.store(w, W.written, at); Atomics.store(w, W.total, at); }

  /** The next-song key (F7): the runtime stops the song playing, so the game starts its next one (EA Trax's, or with the
   *  radio on the folder's next track).  Each press counts once; with no song playing (a drift or drag race, the pause
   *  menu) the runtime lets it go. */
  skip() { Atomics.add(this.words(), W.skip, 1); }

  /** The page wants the song playing told (song()), radio on or off: Last.fm's scrobbles (lastfm.ts). */
  listen(on: boolean) { Atomics.store(this.words(), W.listen, on ? 1 : 0); }

  /** The song playing, null while the runtime writes it (asked again a moment later) or before it told one. */
  song(): Song | null {
    const w = this.words(), seq = Atomics.load(w, W.song_seq) >>> 0;
    if (!seq || seq & 1) return null;
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(this.memory.buffer, this.ptr + CTL + TEXT + PLACES * 3 * TAG, 3 * TAG);
    const line = (k: number) => { const b = bytes.slice(k * TAG, (k + 1) * TAG), nul = b.indexOf(0); return new TextDecoder('latin1').decode(nul < 0 ? b : b.subarray(0, nul)).trim(); };
    const kind = KINDS[Atomics.load(w, W.song_kind)] ?? 'none', lines = { artist: line(0), title: line(1), album: line(2) };
    const ms = Atomics.load(w, W.song_ms) >>> 0, ended = (Atomics.load(w, W.song_end) >>> 0) === seq;
    return (Atomics.load(w, W.song_seq) >>> 0) === seq ? { seq, kind, ms, ended, lines } : null;
  }

  /** Frames the rings take now (the counters wrap at 32 bits, their difference does not). */
  room(): number {
    const w = this.words(), size = Atomics.load(w, W.ring_frames);
    return Math.max(0, Math.min(size, size - ((Atomics.load(w, W.written) - Atomics.load(w, W.read)) | 0)));
  }

  /** Appends frames to the rings (left, right) and tells the game they are there.  False: the rings are not where the page can trust them. */
  push(left: Float32Array, right: Float32Array): boolean {
    const w = this.words(), size = Atomics.load(w, W.ring_frames), at = Atomics.load(w, W.written), base = Atomics.load(w, W.ring) >>> 0;
    const buf = this.memory.buffer;
    if (!size || (size & (size - 1)) || !base || base + 8 * size > buf.byteLength) return false;
    [left, right].forEach((src, ch) => {
      const ring = new Float32Array(buf, base + 4 * size * ch, size), from = at & (size - 1), first = Math.min(src.length, size - from);
      ring.set(src.subarray(0, first), from);
      ring.set(src.subarray(first), 0);
    });
    Atomics.store(w, W.written, at + left.length);
    return true;
  }
}
